article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem quase 80% na Baixada Santista; veja números
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall by nearly 80% in Baixada Santista; see numbers.
article.articleSummary: Baixada Santista, Brazil, reports 2,642 dengue cases from January to September 2026, down 79.6% from 12,961 in the same period of 2025, with four dengue deaths (down from 13). Guarujá leads with 1,081 cases (-64.7% vs 2025), Santos 604 (-86.6%), São Vicente 433 (-83.7%), Praia Grande 112 (-90.7%), Cubatão 41 (-73.2%), Itanhaém 347 (-57.8%), Mongaguá 8 (-90.2%), Peruíbe 8 (-98%), Bertioga 8 (-83.7%). Some cities still reported deaths: São Vicente 1 this year; Cubatão 2; Mongaguá 1 each year; Itanhaém 1 last year. Authorities emphasize vector-control campaigns, house inspections, larviciding, and community education; Guarujá hotels were inspected ahead of summer, with mutirões and larval-density surveys used across the nine municipalities to curb Aedes aegypti spread.

triage.headline_ja: バイシャーダ・サンティスタ地域、デング熱症例が約80%減少〜最新データ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例・死亡数は前年比で大幅減少傾向にあり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。通常の季節性監視報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱症例数の減少を報告する定例の地域統計記事であり、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Donors assess response measures at N'djili Airport - ACP
article.articleSummary: Donors and partners assessed Ebola virus disease preparedness at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa on 29 September 2026 amid the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak. Led by Mireille Lembwadio of the National Border Hygiene Program, the visit included the U.S. State Department, CDC, IOM, WHO, AFNET, Expertise France, Médecins Sans Frontières, the Congolese government, Kinshasa Provincial Health Division, and MONUSCO. Airport measures feature health corridors, hand-washing facilities, pre-positioned essential supplies, medical ambulances, and isolation containers across domestic, international, and MONUSCO terminals. Officials aimed to assess system performance and identify additional needs at the province, airport, and entry points, delivering a positive appraisal and outlining plans to enhance infrastructure, personnel protection and equipment, and motivation. Emphasis on multisectoral coordination with security services and support from Airways Management Authority RVA; the response is framed within the ongoing Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ドナーがンジリ空港で対応策を評価 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する国際機関・ドナーの空港対応評価であり、重症度の高い疾患かつ国際的な支援体制が既に稼働している継続的な公衆衛生イベントであるため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC第17次エボラ流行における空港での予防対応策（健康回廊、隔離設備等）の評価に関する内容で、進行中の既知流行への国際支援活動の報告。新規発生情報ではないが、エボラの重大性とマルチセクター対応の継続性からPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, viral fever outbreak, allege GNLU students, boycott classes
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak and other infections on Gujarat National Law University (GNLU) campus, Gandhinagar, prompted student protests. About 10% of the roughly 1,100 students have dengue and nearly 20% have fallen ill. A survey tallies 193 illnesses as of September 29: 102 dengue, 11 typhoid, 77 viral infections, 28 food poisoning and 19 other infections. Students allege unhygienic hostel conditions; Sept 10 water tests found green algae and worms in mess water. No fogging occurred Sept 11–23, during which 36 new dengue cases were recorded. Test reports were released Sept 28; treatment costs average Rs 3,000–5,000 and are borne by students. GNLU says fogging was conducted and water sources cleaned; neighboring PDEU also saw dengue. Students demand an independent monitoring committee to oversee water quality, sanitation, vector control, medical facilities and emergency preparedness; registrar Nitin Malik says a meeting will be held Wednesday; protest suspended pending talks.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱・ウイルス性発熱の集団発生、GNLU学生が授業ボイコットを主張
triage.triage_reason: 単一大学キャンパス内での集団感染だが、衛生環境の不備・媒介生物対策の欠如により感染拡大の可能性があり、学生による抗議活動など社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: インド・グジャラート州の大学キャンパス内でのローカルなデング熱・各種感染症の集団発生。衛生環境（水質汚染、害虫駆除の中断）が主因とされ、学生による抗議活動が発生している。インド国外への拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは報告されていない。重症度（入院・死亡者数）については記事に明記されておらず不明。

article.articleHeadline: El aumento de casos de dengue en Florida muestra la creciente amenaza del virus en Estados Unidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rise in dengue cases in Florida shows the growing threat of the virus in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever surges along Florida’s Gulf Coast, triggering emergencies in three counties. Hillsborough County (Tampa) reports 169 locally acquired cases since July, part of Florida’s record total of 190 locally transmitted infections and one death. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, present year‑round in Florida; most infections are mild or asymptomatic, but about 1 in 20 progress to severe dengue with bleeding and potential organ failure. Four dengue serotypes circulate, and prior infection with one may worsen infection with another. High‑risk groups include young children, older adults, and people with asthma, diabetes, or anemia. Contributing factors cited: warm, humid climate, climate change, and urban development; 2024 hurricanes Milton and Helene may have expanded breeding sites. Some infections are likely travel‑related from the Caribbean, Brazil, Mexico and Southeast Asia. Tampa General Hospital reports ~6–7 dengue patients daily; no specific antiviral exists—management is supportive, aided by rapid tropical‑fever testing. Occasional locally acquired cases also appear in California, Texas, and other states.

triage.headline_ja: フロリダ州でのデング熱症例増加、米国におけるウイルスの脅威拡大を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は主に米国フロリダ州における地域内デング熱流行を扱っており、対象国（ブラジル等）は旅行関連感染の文脈で言及されているのみで、当該国での発生が主題ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は米国フロリダ州（タンパ、ヒルズボロ郡）における記録的なデング熱流行を報じており、ブラジル・メキシコ等は渡航関連感染の由来として言及されるのみで、当該国内での発生を主題としていないため、CEPR対象国としてのverified_locationsには該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: 경기도, 12월 중 구제역 백신 보강 접종
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gyeonggi Province to Conduct Booster Vaccination for Foot-and-Mouth Disease in December.
article.articleSummary: Gyeonggi Province announced a winter 2026–2027 special quarantine period for three major livestock diseases: foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), and African swine fever (ASF), from October through February. The plan emphasizes risk-area management, farm containment, and movement controls, with a December third booster vaccination targeting farms with low antibody positivity to counter the SAT1 serotype of FMD potentially introduced from China or Mongolia. Earlier 1st–2nd rounds were completed in June in border regions such as Goyang, Paju, Gimpo, and Yeoncheon. During the period, manure movements outside designated zones will be restricted, and movements tracked via location systems. For HPAI, high-risk poultry sites, large farms, and farms with past outbreaks will see strengthened biosecurity, including controls on transport vehicles and personnel. The province is piloting digital twin–based surveillance near Namyang Bay in Hwaseong and Pyeongtaek, plus AI-driven disinfection centers and enhanced farm/testing. Farmers are urged to follow biosecurity rules and report suspected symptoms promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 京畿道、12月中に口蹄疫ワクチン追加接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 韓国京畿道における家畜疾病の予防的防疫計画（ワクチン接種・検疫強化）に関する内容であり、対象国（ヒト感染症・対象国リスト）には該当しない行政対応情報のため見送り。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国（対象国リスト外）における家畜防疫計画に関する行政発表であり、ヒトへの感染や対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）における発生は確認されない。中国・モンゴリアは侵入経路として言及されるのみで発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Mengganas, Melonjak 2.000 Kasus dalam Sebulan!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo rages, surging to 2,000 cases in a month!
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged to 8,116 confirmed cases, up more than 2,000 in the past month. As of 28 September 2026, 3,924 deaths have been recorded since the outbreak began. On 1 September, INSP logged 6,100 cases and 2,950 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 49 new cases, 23 deaths, and 18 recoveries were reported. The rapid rise indicates a continuing, expanding outbreak. Health authorities warn the Ebola virus poses a threat to neighboring countries. Jean Kaseya, Director General of Africa CDC’s Center for Disease Prevention and Control, cited cross-border risk. The figures come from INSP, reported via Sputnik and carried by Antara News, highlighting the ongoing regional crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が激化、1か月で2,000例急増！
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が急速に拡大し、8,000例超・4,000人近い死者を記録。国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが近隣国への越境リスクを警告しており、地域的な感染拡大の懸念が高い。死亡者数・症例数ともに急増傾向にあり、継続的な監視と迅速なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo capai 8.116 kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo reaches 8,116 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 8,116 confirmed cases, a rise of more than 2,000 in about a month, according to INSP. On September 1, INSP logged 6,100 confirmed cases and 2,950 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 49 new cases were reported, with 23 deaths and 18 recoveries, bringing the total fatalities to 3,924 since the outbreak began. The article documents ongoing transmission in the DRC but provides no further detail on laboratory confirmation rates, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. Publication cites Sputnik as a source, via ANTARA. Current date reference: 2026-09-30. Key takeaways: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with rapid escalation in confirmed cases and mortality over the past month.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、症例数8,116件に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が大規模に拡大し死亡者数も多数（致死率約48%）で、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 1ヶ月で2,000例以上増加、致死率約48%と非常に高く、継続的な感染拡大が示唆される。詳細な感染経路や国際的な症例輸出入の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 发现首发重大传染病疫情 安徽每人奖励1万人民币
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Discovery of the first reported major infectious disease outbreak; Anhui to reward 10,000 yuan to each person.
article.articleSummary: Anhui Province, China, issued guidelines to reward institutions and individuals who first report a major infectious disease outbreak globally or within China. The policy, titled Implementation Rules for Notification and Reward for First Reports of Major Infectious Disease Outbreaks (Trial), aims to strengthen early detection and rapid reporting by healthcare institutions and personnel to improve risk assessment and outbreak response. Rewards are 10,000 yuan per person for the discovery of a first global or national major outbreak, with funding provided by the provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention. For reporting specific high‑risk diseases, rewards are 8,000 yuan per person. The list includes plague, infectious atypical pneumonia, pulmonary anthrax, smallpox, and poliomyelitis. The rules emphasize that prompt discovery and reporting enable timely control, with authorities including the Anhui CDC, Health Commission, and Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 重大感染症の初報発見で安徽省が1人当たり1万元を報奨
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイク発生ではなく、安徽省による疾病早期報告・通報を奨励する政策発表であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、安徽省の報奨制度に関する行政施策の発表である。疑似症例や発生事例への言及はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza Naik 15 Persen, Pramono Sebut Jakarta Masih Aman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases rise 15 percent, Pramono says Jakarta is still safe.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases in Jakarta (DKI Jakarta) rose about 15%, with acute respiratory infections (ARIs) up around 15.7% per health data, but officials deem the rise mild and not an outbreak, given a threshold of >150%. Governor Pramono Anung states Jakarta remains safe for influenza. Data from Puskesmas show ARI increases align with seasonal patterns; not all ARIs attributed to influenza A, per Health Department Head Ani Ruspitawati. Hospital visits via the SIRS Online system show no significant spike. The DKI Health Department emphasizes continuity of care: Puskesmas and hospitals remain open, and residents with flu-like symptoms should seek medical attention. No details on imported/exported cases are reported as of 2026-09-30.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ症例が15%増加、プラモノ氏はジャカルタはまだ安全と述べる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの軽度な増加であり、当局は流行閾値（150%増）を大幅に下回るとして「安全」と明言しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性変動の範囲内であり、当局自ら『流行ではない』と公式に否定している通常の季節性報告記事。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Hujan di Medan, Waspadai Penularan Influenza A, Kenali Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season in Medan: Beware of Influenza A transmission and recognize its symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A transmission in Medan, Indonesia, is a concern during the rainy season as residents report sudden fever and muscle aches. Experts say humid, crowded indoor settings with limited ventilation facilitate spread, especially in homes, schools, offices, and enclosed public transport. While no case counts are given, authorities emphasize prevention: annual flu vaccination (prioritized for high-risk groups), regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with the sick, covering coughs or sneezes, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle to boost immunity. The piece notes that rainy conditions may hasten spread and references the influenza A H1N1 PDM09 variant, citing guidance from the Ministry of Health and Radjiman Wediodiningrat Hospital. Influenza A symptoms are abrupt and can be more severe than typical flu.

triage.headline_ja: メダンの雨季:インフルエンザAの感染に注意、症状を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、症例数や異常な流行の報告はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・集団発生・異常な重症度の記述はない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gyeonggi Province to administer booster vaccines for foot-and-mouth disease in December.
article.articleSummary: Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, will run a winter special quarantine period Oct 2026–Feb 2027 targeting foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI), and African swine fever (ASF). To counter potential introduction of SAT1-type FMD from neighboring China and Mongolia, the province plans a third booster vaccination in December for farms with low antibody positivity. For ASF, farm surveillance and increased carcass and environmental testing will focus on high-risk areas near ASF outbreak zones and along border regions. The package emphasizes strengthened quarantine, monitoring, and targeted testing as part of winter preparedness for these major livestock diseases.

article.articleHeadline: PH bans UK beef imports over mad cow disease
article.articleSummary: Philippines' Department of Agriculture banned imports of live cattle, beef products and processed animal proteins derived from cattle from the United Kingdom after an outbreak of classical C-type bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE) in North Ayrshire, Scotland. The ban, through Department Circular 50 signed Sept 21 by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. and posted Sept 30, takes effect upon publication on the DA website. It follows confirmation by Eurofins and the UK Animal and Plant Health Agency (Weybridge) of BSE. BSE is a fatal neurological disease in cattle caused by prions; infected animals may be asymptomatic for years. The circular suspends sanitary and phytosanitary import clearances (SPSICs) for UK cattle and related products, revokes prior clearances for shipments not yet at ports, and orders stringent port inspections by veterinary quarantine officers. The measure mitigates human VCJD risk linked to beef consumption.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン、狂牛病（BSE）を理由に英国産牛肉の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 英国スコットランドでの牛海綿状脳症（BSE）確認を受け、フィリピンが英国産牛肉・牛由来製品の輸入を全面禁止する貿易制限措置を発表しており、IHR基準（異常性・貿易制限）に複数該当するため初期スクリーニングとして拾い上げる。
triage.notes: BSEの実際の発生地は英国スコットランド（North Ayrshire）であり、対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは輸入禁止措置を講じた側であり、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。人間へのvCJD感染は報告されておらず、動物衛生・貿易上の対応が主眼のイベント。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza Jakarta Naik 15 Persen, Pramono: Masih Sangat Ringan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases in Jakarta rise by 15 percent; Pramono: Still very mild.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases in Jakarta have risen about 15%, according to Governor Pramono Anung, based on data from the Jakarta Health Department and the Ministry of Health. He spoke during the 2026 National Transportation Day at Balai Samudera, Kelapa Gading, North Jakarta, and said the increase is still mild and not a cause for concern. The threshold for declaring an extraordinary event (KLB) or outbreak is above 150%; the current 15% rise is described by experts as mild. Pramono urged residents with flu or acute respiratory infection symptoms to seek evaluation at health facilities, noting that services at government and state-owned hospitals are available for diagnosis and treatment. The report underscores that Jakarta remains safe regarding influenza at present, with no indication of an imminent outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタのインフルエンザ症例が15%増加、プラモノ知事「まだ非常に軽微」
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザの軽微な増加であり、当局も「懸念なし」と明言。異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 知事が公式に『アウトブレイク閾値(150%増)には程遠く、軽微』と説明しており、KLB(非常事態)宣言の対象ではない。通常の季節性変動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Terdeteksi di Depok, Dinkes Catat 7 Kasus Positif Sejak September 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Detected in Depok, Department of Health Records 7 Positive Cases Since September 2026.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A detected in Depok, Indonesia, with seven laboratory-confirmed cases reported by the Depok City Health Office as of mid-September 2026. Health official Devi Maryori notes cases began appearing in September 2026, with potential for higher numbers in the community due to under-testing, as many patients do not seek laboratory confirmation. The symptoms described include high fever, body aches, fatigue, and prolonged illness beyond typical flu recovery, with more extended convalescence. Children are the most vulnerable, though adults remain at risk. Preventive guidance emphasizes adherence to clean and healthy living (PHBS), adequate rest, nutritious diet, regular exercise, and keeping distance from people with coughs or colds. Transmission is via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking, which can be inhaled or contaminate surfaces. Authorities urge vigilance but not panic.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア・デポック市でインフルエンザA検出、2026年9月以降7件の陽性確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの小規模クラスター（7例）であり、重症度や異常性の情報が乏しいため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むほどの根拠は不足しているが、検査不足による過小報告の懸念があり経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インフルエンザAの亜型（H1N1、H3N2等）や重症度詳細が不明。検査不足により実際の症例数がより多い可能性が指摘されているが、現時点では地域の公衆衛生当局による通常の監視対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza Melonjak di Beberapa Daerah, Pramono: Jakarta Masih Aman-Aman Saja |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Cases Surge in Several Regions, Pramono: Jakarta Remains Perfectly Safe
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases in Jakarta, Indonesia, have risen modestly but remain well below outbreak thresholds. Governor Pramono Anung reported about a 15% increase in influenza-like illness (ILI) with the overarching acute respiratory infection (ISPA) up about 15.7%, a pattern aligned with seasonality. He stressed that an outbreak would require a rise of 150% or more, and Jakarta is not currently in that range, noting the city remains safe regarding influenza. The surge has been discussed with the DKI Health Office and the Ministry of Health, and all puskesmas (community health centers) and hospitals are available to treat patients. There is no significant surge in influenza A. Authorities urge residents to seek medical care promptly if displaying flu-like symptoms. Published date: 2026-09-30.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ感染者が各地で増加、プラモノ氏「ジャカルタは依然として安全」
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の範囲内の軽微な増加であり、知事が安全宣言し行政も通常対応中のため、基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: ジャカルタ知事が公式にアウトブレイク基準（150%以上の増加）に達していないと説明しており、現時点で懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ai dễ chuyển nặng khi mắc sốt xuất huyết?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Who is more likely to progress to severe dengue after contracting dengue fever?
article.articleSummary: Infants, older adults, pregnant women, obese individuals, and people with chronic conditions are at higher risk of progression to severe dengue. In Vietnam's Ho Chi Minh City, authorities emphasize distinguishing risk factors from warning signs: risk factors cue closer monitoring, while warning signs indicate possible transition to the dangerous phase. Dengue typically unfolds in three stages—febrile, critical (danger), and recovery—with plasma leakage potentially causing hypovolemic shock, severe bleeding, or organ impairment. Notably, severe progression can occur even after fever subsides; fever resolution does not guarantee recovery. Warning signs requiring urgent medical assessment include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, mucosal bleeding, cold extremities, reduced urine output, and agitation. Management hinges on timely follow-up and clinical evaluation, especially for high-risk groups. The guidance from Ho Chi Minh City’s Disease Control Center and the Ministry of Health underlines early recognition and close monitoring to avert severe outcomes.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Meningkat, Allianz Catat Kasus Rawat Inap Naik 47%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases rise, Allianz records inpatient admissions up 47%.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity in Indonesia rose in week 37 of 2026, with influenza-positive results at about 59% of respiratory infection surveillance (ILI), up from 54% the prior week. Of 198 specimens tested, 105 were positive for A(H1N1)pdm09 and 7 for A(H3N2); overall activity remained moderate and aligned with the seasonal pattern per Ministry of Health sentinel surveillance. Subclade K infections were predominantly in children: 0–4 years 37%; 5–9 years 23%; 10–17 years 21%; 18–59 years 17%; 60+ years 2%. Symptoms typically include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, headache, myalgia; in children, nausea/vomiting or diarrhea may occur. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic or immunocompromised conditions; complications may include pneumonia, bronchitis, and pharyngitis. Allianz Life Indonesia reports inpatient influenza care up 47% Jan–Aug 2026 vs year prior, with claims over Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 cases through mid-September 2026. Preventive measures emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の症例が増加、アリアンツは入院症例が47%増加したと記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1pdm09中心)の活動増加で入院が増えているが、通常の季節パターンの範囲内とされ、国際的な異常性や渡航制限等の兆候はない。経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 保健省のサーベイランスでは季節性パターンに沿った中程度の活動とされており、重症度や国際的拡大のエビデンスは記事内に明示されていない。入院増加・保険金請求増加という社会的関心は見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow logs 144 dengue cases this month, up from 120 last year
article.articleSummary: Lucknow dengue cases rise this year, with 144 reported from September 1–26 and 111 in August, compared with 120 and 97 in the same periods of 2025; 2024 saw higher activity (257 cases by Sept 26). District malaria officer Ritu Srivastava says the situation is under control, with most patients recovering and hospitalisation remaining low. Persistent rains have washed away some larvae, and cooler temperatures with lower humidity may suppress transmission; the post-monsoon period is crucial for vector control. Authorities intensified source reduction, anti-larva spraying, and fogging across the city’s 110 wards, led by five malaria inspectors. After the rains, focus shifts to case-based surveillance; fogging and spraying continue per PK Srivastava. Dr. Sheetal Verma notes that repeated rainfall and waterlogging may boost Aedes breeding, with warm, humid conditions aiding survival; residents are urged to remove standing water, regularly empty containers, and use nets and repellents.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウで今月144件のデング熱症例、前年の120件から増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱の軽微な増加であり、当局は状況をコントロール下にあると述べている。重症例や入院の増加、異常な拡大の証拠はない。
triage.notes: 例年通りの季節性デング熱の報告で、2024年と比較すると今年の症例数はむしろ少ない。当局は媒介蚊対策（薬剤散布、発生源除去）を継続的に実施しており、特段の懸念材料は見当たらない。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو تتجاوز 8 آلاف - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in the Congo exceed 8,000 - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's National Institute for Public Health reports 8,116 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 3,924 deaths since the outbreak began. This marks an increase of over 2,000 cases in the past month. On 1 September, authorities cited 6,100 confirmed cases and 2,950 deaths. In the most recent 24-hour period, 49 new cases were recorded, 23 deaths, and 18 recoveries. The totals reflect ongoing transmission based on laboratory-confirmed diagnoses by national health authorities. The briefing originates from Kinshasa and concerns the Democratic Republic of the Congo. No specific details are provided on infection sources, hospitalizations, or imported/exported cases within this update.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染者数が8000人を超える - Urdu Point

triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、感染拡大が継続中。感染源や病院での院内感染、越境感染の有無など詳細情報が不足しているため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vaksin Anti-rabies di Bali Belum Mencangkup Jumlah Hewan Penular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The rabies vaccine in Bali has not yet reached the number of transmitting animals.
article.articleSummary: As of September 2026 in Bali, 56,081 rabies exposure cases have been reported. Of the exposed animals, 41,354 were vaccinated (74%). The highest counts are Badung Regency (10,474), Karangasem (7,007), and Denpasar City (6,903). The average monthly incidence is 6,446 cases (about 216 per day). Vaccine stock stands at about 40,000 anti-rabies vaccine (VAR) vials. The Bali Health Office urges districts and cities to include VAR procurement in their APBD-perubahan budgets and seeks grant aid from the Ministry of Health to secure stock into early 2027. For 2027, the Ministry has pledged 169,000 VAR vials, in addition to local procurement. In Buleleng, a male dog sterilization program aims to curb population growth. Rabies deaths through September 2026 total 7, led by Buleleng with 3; others in Jembrana, Tabanan, Karangasem, and Gianyar have one each. All Puskesmas are rabies centers; about 90% of hospitals operate as rabies centers.

triage.triage_reason: バリ島で狂犬病による死亡例（9月までに7名）と大量の曝露例が継続的に報告されており、ワクチン供給不足が懸念されるが、既知の風土病的状況であり新規性・国際的拡大の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: バリ島は狂犬病の風土病地域であり、本記事は地方保健当局によるワクチン供給状況の定期報告。動物媒介の継続的曝露と死亡例があるが、ヒトーヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。ワクチン在庫確保のため保健省への予算・グラント要請があり、国内的な管理体制強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Mars Impact Fund Commits $3M to Worldwide Veterinary Service for Rabies Elimination in Thailand
article.articleSummary: Rabies elimination in Thailand is boosted by a $3 million philanthropic grant from Mars, Incorporated through the Mars Impact Fund to Worldwide Veterinary Service (WVS) on World Rabies Day. Over three years, the program will support final-mile efforts by providing specialist veterinary field support and strengthening integrated rabies surveillance to reach free-roaming and hard-to-reach dogs, while building capacity of veterinary and public health teams at WVS’s International Training Centre in Chiang Mai. The initiative complements Thailand’s Department of Livestock Development and provincial offices, aiming to sustain vaccination campaigns, enable early outbreak detection, and reinforce One Health systems to protect millions of people and animals. Dr. Luke Gamble notes the final mile entails street-by-street work, with sharper surveillance and expanded training enabling a regional blueprint. Mars also announced a THB 7 billion investment in Thailand earlier this month.

article.articleHeadline: Growing Food Insecurity Amid the Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) Outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, part of the 17th EVD outbreak (May 2026–present). As of Sep 13, 2026, 7,258 confirmed cases and 3,510 deaths across 62 health zones in Ituri and neighboring eastern provinces (North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, South Ubangi). Movement restrictions and outbreak response measures are undermining food security, with rising prices limiting market access. By the lean season (late Sep), food security could deteriorate further unless community mutual aid is strengthened and emergency assistance targets the most isolated populations. June 2026 data show 10% of Ituri’s population in severe food insecurity (IPC AFI P4) and about 291,302 children under five malnourished (IPC AMN P3-P4). A July 13–15, 2026 REACH qualitative study in Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Nyankunde interviewed 30 informants to assess livelihoods impacts amid the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州におけるエボラウイルス病（EVD）流行下での食料不安の拡大

triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州および周辺東部州（北キブ、南キブ、オートウエレ、チョポ、バスウエレ、南ウバンギ）でのEVD流行を主題としている。Rwanda（キガリ州）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文では流行国としての言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 男孩被猫咬伤未及时处理 医生提醒 狂犬病预防不容忽视
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy bitten by a cat did not receive timely treatment; a doctor warns that rabies prevention should not be neglected.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-30, a single case in Henan: a 12-year-old boy in Zhengzhou was bitten on the cheek by his family's pet cat. He presented at Zhengzhou Central Hospital's ER with facial swelling and fever; within 24 hours the wound became purulent, risking surgical drainage if infection progressed. Dr. Pan Xiaoli emphasized that rabies prevention after animal bites is essential. Zhengzhou CDC immunization experts said bites from small pets like hamsters or rabbits do not require rabies vaccination, as rabies virus not detected in these species. Tetanus vaccination should be considered based on wound depth and immunization history. Rabies is 100% fatal, so thorough wound irrigation with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and prompt medical care are crucial. Misconceptions include that vaccination after 24 hours is useless; re-exposures are not restarted; boosters on day 0 and day 3 are advised if exposure occurs after 3 months.

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Latest News Today on September 30th, 2026: CM-PM Meeting, School Fraud & Dengue Alert
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, Chennai records a dengue surge with 1,775 cases, prompting the Greater Chennai Corporation to intensify mosquito-control efforts citywide. The outbreak has triggered a dengue alert in Tamil Nadu’s capital, with public-health authorities emphasizing source-reduction, vector surveillance, and community awareness to curb transmission amid warm, possibly rainy conditions. No death toll is indicated in the report, and details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources are not provided. The response centers on reducing breeding sites, larviciding, and public compliance to interrupt transmission chains, underscoring Chennai as the epicenter of the current outbreak within Tamil Nadu. Dengue emerges as the key infectious-disease highlight for Chennai on 30 September 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Fallecimientos por cólera subieron un 30 % en 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera deaths rose by 30% in 2025.
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths rose 30% in 2025 to 7,870, the highest toll since 1999, while global cholera cases fell to 451,499, per the World Health Organization. Seven countries—including Sudan, Yemen, Nigeria, and the Democratic Republic of Congo—accounted for about 90% of cases. About one in five fatalities occurred outside healthcare facilities due to lack of timely access to care. Despite higher lethality linked to sanitation and drinking-water failures, preventive supplies improved after doubling oral cholera vaccine production from 30 million to roughly 80 million doses annually, enabling distribution of more than 70 million vaccines to the hardest-hit regions and the resumption of vaccination campaigns after more than three years of suspension, strengthening the response to this treatable bacterial infection.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年のコレラによる死者数が30%増加
triage.triage_reason: 世界的なコレラ致死率上昇を報じるグローバル統計記事であり、DRC単独の具体的な発生状況の記述がないため、続報・地域別詳細を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOのグローバルコレラ統計を報じるもので、DRCは主要流行国の一つとして言及されているが、国別の詳細情報は本文に含まれない。スーダン・イエメン・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。IHR基準は複数該当しWHO通知相当の重大性があるが、記事自体が特定国の個別イベントというよりマクロ統計の報告であるため、PICKUPではなくWATCHとした。続報でDRC固有の状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Khánh Hòa đã ghi nhận 3.688 ca tay chân miệng, bác sĩ khuyến cáo điều cần làm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Khanh Hoa has recorded 3,688 cases of hand-foot-mouth disease; doctors advise on what needs to be done.
article.articleSummary: Hand-foot-mouth disease in Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam, has reached 3,688 cases from the start of the year through September 28, 2026. Hotspots include Cam Lam commune (276), Dien Khanh commune (151), Dien Dén commune (152), Bac Nha Trang ward (260), Tay Nha Trang ward (373), and Nam Nha Trang ward (198). The provincial CDC is conducting active surveillance, rapid response to cases and outbreaks, and distributing supplies to health units. Dr. Ton That Toan, Deputy Director of Khanh Hoa CDC, urges comprehensive prevention: frequent soap-and-water handwashing (before food prep, before meals, before feeding, after toilet/diaper changes, after handling children), cooking food thoroughly, cleaning utensils, and avoiding shared towels, utensils, or sucking on objects. Regular cleaning of toys and surfaces is advised. Transmission occurs via droplets from saliva/nasal secretions, fecal matter, and contaminated objects. Preschools should reinforce hygiene and cleaning; report suspected cases (fever, sore throat, drooling, mouth ulcers, crying, rashes) promptly. Reinfection is possible; severe complications can be life-threatening.

triage.headline_ja: カインホア省で手足口病3,688例を記録、医師が対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・カインホア省で手足口病（EV71含む）の季節性流行が継続しているが、重症度や異常な拡大傾向を示す情報はなく、地域の保健当局が通常対応を行っている段階のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 手足口病（HFMD）はベトナムで毎年季節的に流行する疾患であり、本記事は地域CDCによる通常のサーベイランス・啓発活動の報告。前年同期比較や重症例・死亡例の具体的データがなく、異常性の判断材料が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: He Urged People To Prevent Ebola. Hours Later, He Was Beaten To Death
article.articleSummary: A concise summary of the Ebola outbreak in Congo, focusing on Butembo in North Kivu and nearby Beni. The outbreak, declared May 15, has infected 8,067 people and killed 3,901 (government data released on Monday). Marie-Celestin Karondwa, acting president of the UDPS federation in Butembo, was beaten to death after promoting Ebola prevention on a radio show; attackers looted his belongings and set his house on fire, and he died from injuries. The incident underscores persistent mistrust and attacks on Ebola response teams. Separately, armed men attacked a hand-washing checkpoint in Beni territory, killing at least one person and wounding several. No motive or perpetrators for Karondwa’s assault are confirmed. The outbreak remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 彼はエボラ予防を呼びかけた。数時間後、彼は撲殺された

triage.notes: 記事は北キブ州ブテンボおよびベニ準州での出来事を報告しており、発生地域はすべてDRC国内に限定される。エボラ対応要員への暴力事件（予防啓発者の撲殺、手洗いチェックポイントへの武装襲撃）はコミュニティの抵抗とアウトブレイク管理の困難さを示す重要な兆候。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Naik 15 Persen di Jakarta, Pramono Ungkap Kondisinya: Masih Aman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Up 15 Percent in Jakarta, Pramono Reveals His Condition: Still Safe.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases in Jakarta have risen by about 15 percent, according to Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung after coordinating with the DKI Jakarta Health Department and the Ministry of Health. He notes the increase is small and not indicative of an outbreak, which would be declared if rises reached about 150 percent. Residents with influenza-like symptoms, including Influenza A or ISPA, are urged to seek medical care promptly. The provincial health facilities and clinics are prepared to provide examinations and treatment, with all government hospitals and public health centers open to serve residents. Authorities emphasize staying vigilant without panic as Jakarta monitors influenza activity.

article.articleHeadline: 경기도, 겨울철 가축전염병 특별방역...AI·ASF·구제역 차단 강화 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gyeonggi Province strengthens special winter quarantine measures for livestock diseases to curb Avian Influenza, African Swine Fever, and Foot-and-Mouth Disease - Shin A Ilbo
article.articleSummary: Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, will launch winter special quarantine measures Oct 2026–Feb 2027 to curb high-pathogenic Avian Influenza (AI), African Swine Fever (ASF), and Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD, SAT1). Approved Sept 29 at the 10th Gyeonggi-do Livestock Quarantine Council, the plan tightens AI controls at migratory-bird sites, strengthens wild-bird management, and focuses biosecurity on layer-hen hubs, large poultry farms, and farms with prior outbreaks; livestock-vehicle and personnel biosecurity is intensified. In Hwaseong and Pyeongtaek Namyang Bay areas, high-risk farms will deploy digital twin technology and a smart quarantine system linked to base centers and disinfection facilities. ASF measures include intensified farm surveillance, carcass and environmental testing, and universal tests of pig farms, plus concentrated culling and fencing in wild boar hotspots. For FMD, SAT1 risk from China and Mongolia is met with vaccination in border areas (Goyang, Paju, Gimpo, Yeoncheon) and a planned December 3 booster after two rounds in May–June.

triage.headline_ja: 京畿道、冬季家畜伝染病特別防疫を実施...AI・ASF・口蹄疫の遮断強化

triage.notes: 記事は韓国京畿道における冬季の予防的防疫対策（検疫強化、ワクチン接種、監視体制強化）についてのものであり、実際の疾病発生事例を報告するものではない。対象国リストに韓国は含まれておらず、中国・モンゴルへの言及もFMDリスク源としての言及に留まり、実際の発生事実ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 厚労省、インドネシアで入国前結核スクリーニングを開始　11月2日から
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare to begin pre-entry tuberculosis screening in Indonesia from November 2.
article.articleSummary: Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare expands pre-entry tuberculosis screening (JPETS) to Indonesia, with operations starting November 2, 2026. JPETS requires individuals from designated countries who intend to reside medium- to long-term in Japan to undergo a chest X-ray at a designated medical facility before entry to confirm they are not actively ill with tuberculosis, enabling early detection and treatment to curb domestic spread. Since 2024, the program has covered the Philippines, Nepal, and Vietnam; Indonesia was designated but without a fixed start date until now. From November 2, Indonesian designated screening facilities will begin accepting screenings. The obligation to submit a certificate of non-active tuberculosis at the time of applying for a Residence Status Certificate or a visa is planned to begin on January 4, 2027. The list of approved Indonesian facilities will be announced as soon as prepared.

triage.notes: 記事は結核そのもののアウトブレイクではなく、日本の入国管理制度（JPETS）のインドネシアへの拡大を報じるもの。フィリピン・ベトナム・ネパールは既存プログラム対象国として背景説明に挙げられているのみで、本記事の主題ではないため除外した（ネパールは対象国リスト外でもある）。

article.articleHeadline: 在校园里容易"扎堆"，肺炎支原体感染要当心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mycoplasma pneumoniae infections can easily cluster on campuses.
article.articleSummary: Mycoplasma pneumoniae infections can easily cluster on campuses, as students return to classrooms, dormitories, and canteens. Mycoplasma pneumoniae is a wall-less bacterium causing respiratory infections, transmitted mainly by droplets; infections occur in all ages but are more common among school-aged children and adolescents. Incubation is about 1–3 weeks; infected individuals, even with mild or no symptoms, can spread the organism. Infections typically present with sore throat, fatigue, fever, headache, and a cough that may last several weeks; a subset develops Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia with lung inflammation. Most patients recover without antibiotics, but beta-lactams (penicillins, cephalosporins) are ineffective due to no cell wall. Management requires clinician judgment and appropriate antibiotics when indicated. Preventive measures on campuses include ventilation, hand hygiene, masking when symptomatic, and avoiding close contact; emphasize sleep, nutrition, and exercise. Sources: China CDC and National CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 校内で集団感染しやすい、マイコプラズマ肺炎感染に注意
triage.triage_reason: マイコプラズマ肺炎は季節性・既知の呼吸器感染症であり、一般的な予防啓発記事であって異常な流行や重症化の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は学校向けの一般的な健康啓発・予防情報であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な増加、重症例の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Marak Kasus Influenza di Jakarta hingga Banten, Begini Himbauan Kemenkes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Widespread influenza cases in Jakarta and Banten, here is the Ministry of Health's advisory.
article.articleSummary: By late September 2026, Indonesia reports 1,527 influenza-positive cases, with the majority clustered in DKI Jakarta, West Java, and Banten. The Ministry of Health urges the public not to panic or hoard oseltamivir, noting influenza is typically self-limiting and that taking antivirals without a prescription can be harmful, especially for children. Rumors of a so-called 'super flu' linked to influenza A H3N2 subclade K are denied; the term is not used by WHO or Kemenkes, and in 2026 this subclade has only 22 cases (166 in 2025). The seasonality trend is described as the normal ASEAN September cycle. National positivity rate stands at 17% in 2026, down from 24% in 2025. Influenza A H1N1 PDM09 is the most common subtype; the outbreak remains centered in Jakarta, West Java, and Banten, with authorities addressing rising antivirals demand.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタからバンテンまでインフルエンザ症例が拡大、保健省からの注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の流行とされ、保健省も『スーパーフル』の噂を否定しているが、症例数増加と抗ウイルス薬需要の高まりが見られるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事は通常の季節性インフルエンザ流行であり、H3N2サブクレードKによる『スーパーフル』の噂は保健省により否定されている。陽性率は前年より低下（24%→17%）。公衆の過剰な抗ウイルス薬使用（オセルタミビルの買い占め）への懸念が中心的内容。

article.articleHeadline: 한국서 익숙한 '이 균'... 전 세계 감염 관련 암 원인 1위
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This bacterium familiar in Korea... the world's leading cause of infection-related cancer.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-30, the Lancet Oncology study from IARC under WHO estimates that in 2024 about 2.3 million of the world’s newly diagnosed cancers were linked to infectious agents, roughly 12% of all new cancers. Helicobacter pylori infection accounts for the largest share (roughly 760,000 cases in 2024), with East Asia showing substantial burden including Korea, Japan, and China; Korea’s H. pylori-related healthcare visits rose from 22,000 in 2014 to 73,000 in 2024. Human papillomavirus (HPV) links to about 750,000 cancers, chiefly cervical cancer but also anal, vaginal, vulvar, penile, and some head-and-neck cancers. HBV and HCV contribute to liver cancer, while Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) relates to nasopharyngeal cancer, a subset of gastric cancers, and Hodgkin lymphoma. HIV and Merkel cell polyomavirus are also considered. Prevention through HPV and HBV vaccination, H. pylori testing/treatment, and HCV antivirals can reduce risk; disparities exist between high- and low-income regions.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国でおなじみの『この菌』...世界的な感染関連がんの原因第1位
triage.triage_reason: 感染症と発がんリスクに関する学術研究の紹介記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: IARC/WHOによる感染関連がんの疫学研究報告。韓国・日本・中国の既知の慢性感染症（H.pylori, HBV, HCV, HPV, EBV, HIV等）の長期的ながんリスクに関する内容で、急性のアウトブレイクではない。対象国の中では中国のみ言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Itt a figyelmeztetés: évtizedek után visszatért a járvány Magyarországra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: After decades, the epidemic has returned to Hungary.
article.articleSummary: Isolated fowl pest outbreaks have appeared in Hungary, with no generalized epidemic yet. The Hungarian Food Chain Safety Office (Nébih) confirmed avian influenza on 8 September 2026 in two broiler flocks on the outskirts of Fülöpháza, totaling about 220,000 birds. A second outbreak followed in mid‑September near Kerekegyháza in a 20,400‑bird broiler operation. Symptoms included increased mortality, reduced feed and water intake, lethargy, and greenish diarrhea. Csorbai Attila of the Poultry Product Council warns against complacency; strict biosecurity and professional vaccination where available are essential for both large and small producers. Transmission occurs via fomites and contaminated objects or people; entry to farms must involve disinfection. Trade restrictions have been imposed by Ukraine and Brazil, with regionalization seen as key to limiting sector-wide disruption. Waterfowl may be asymptomatic carriers, underscoring broad surveillance and farmer education.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：数十年ぶりに伝染病がハンガリーに戻ってきた
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリーで数十年ぶりに高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（家禽疫）が再発し、ウクライナ・ブラジルによる貿易制限が既に発動されているため、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大・貿易制限）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本事例はハンガリーの家禽（ブロイラー）農場で確認された鳥インフルエンザであり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。発生国（ハンガリー）および貿易制限国（ウクライナ）は対象国リストに含まれず、ブラジルは発生国ではなく貿易制限を課した側であるためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: อย่า! ซื้อยาป้องกัน 'โรคฉี่หนู'กินเอง มีอาการรีบไปพบแพทย์ แจ้งประวัติสัมผัสน้ำ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't self-medicate with leptospirosis preventive medicine—if you have symptoms, see a doctor and report your water-exposure history.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-30, Thailand’s Department of Disease Control warns of leptospirosis after floods and cautions against self-medicating with preventive drugs, which do not fully prevent infection. Leptospira can enter the body through wounds, abrasions, or unprotected skin, and via the eyes, nose, or mouth after contact with floodwater or mud. Prevention during flooding includes avoiding unnecessary wading; wearing boots; covering wounds with waterproof dressings, especially when in water for 3 hours or more. After immersion, wash hands and feet with soap and clean water. Keep food and drinking water sealed; secure waste to reduce rodent habitats. When moving items or cleaning a flooded area, wear boots and gloves to prevent contact with contaminated water or sharp objects. If symptoms appear, seek medical care and report any water exposure to aid diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 「予防薬」の自己服用は禁物！レプトスピラ症（鼠咬症）の症状があればすぐ受診し、水への曝露歴を申告してください
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症に関する注意喚起記事であり、具体的な患者数・死亡者数など規模を示す情報がなく、既知の季節性感染症対策の広報に留まるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: タイ保健当局による洪水後のレプトスピラ症予防啓発記事。症例数・死亡数など定量情報が記事中に記載されておらず、公衆衛生上の重大性評価は不明。季節性・既知の疾患であり突発的異常性は低いが、洪水による曝露継続のリスクがあるためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: "晚上翻个身，疼痛钻心鲜血直流！"这两天不少人中招，有人不得不打破伤风-青田网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turning over at night, the pain is piercing and blood flows freely! In the past two days, many people have fallen prey; some have had to get tetanus shots — Qingtian Net.
article.articleSummary: Manicure-related nail injuries have surged in Shanghai and Ningbo, with patients arriving in the past two days after nail extensions caused nail plate tearing, nail bed inflammation, and bleeding. In Shanghai, Renji Hospital Jiading Branch treated a patient with nail avulsion and tetanus vaccination; similar injuries are increasingly seen in area hospitals. Jiading District Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital dermatology notes that long, opaque nail extensions and chemical products create a humid, irritant environment that promotes infections, including fungal nail disease (onychomycosis) and Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection. In Ningbo, Zhenhai District People’s Hospital Emergency Department treated a patient with detached nail and nail bed injury, reflecting rising cases over the past two to three years. Guidance includes disinfecting wounds, avoiding forceful tearing, allowing nails to rest for at least three months between manicures, choosing well-equipped salons, and seeking prompt care for bleeding or severe pain.

triage.headline_ja: 「夜寝返りを打ったら激痛で出血が止まらない！」ここ数日多くの人が被害に、中には破傷風の注射を受ける人も―青田網
triage.triage_reason: ネイルケアによる外傷・感染症の個別事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はネイルサロンでの外傷・感染（真菌感染、緑膿菌感染等）および破傷風予防接種に関する個別の医療事例報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: В приграничных с РФ и КНР регионах Монголии из-за ящура уничтожили более 4 тыс. животных
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mongolia's border regions with Russia and China, more than 4,000 animals were culled due to foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks in Mongolia’s border regions with Russia and China (Bayan-Ölgii and Khovd aimags) during summer 2026 led to culling of over 4,000 domestic animals: 2,764 cattle in Bayan-Ölgii and 1,391 in Khovd. Mongolia signed a June 12, 2026 agreement with Russia to procure a vaccine, and more than 2.3 million animals in Bayan-Ölgii, Khovd, Gobi-Altai, Uvs, and Zavkhan were vaccinated as the August outbreak ended. A new Russian vaccine purchase targets serotypes O and SAT-1. Immunization of about 2.6 million cattle, small ruminants, and pigs in eight central/eastern districts began on September 15 and runs to October 15, 2026. Domestic vaccine development with Russia and China (first experimental dose) is planned for October 2026, with autumn 2027 vaccination using a Mongolian vaccine. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease of ruminants; humans can acquire via raw milk products. It had not been detected in Mongolia since the 1960s, with reappearance in 2000; serotypes O and A are most common.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア・中国との国境地帯であるモンゴルにおいて、口蹄疫により4,000頭以上の家畜が殺処分された
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾患であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）での発生ではなくモンゴルでの事案であるため対象外。
triage.notes: 本事案はモンゴルにおける家畜の口蹄疫発生であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とする。ヒトへの感染は生乳製品を介した稀な経路とされるが、本記事では人への感染報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Lashkar Commander Killed | Ganjam Diarrhoea Outbreak | Odisha Bandh | 9AM Headlines
article.articleSummary: 30 September 2026: Kanak News’ 9AM Headlines report a Lashkar commander has been killed, alongside news of a diarrhoea outbreak in Ganjam district, Odisha, and coverage of an Odisha bandh. The brief notes Odia News and weather updates from Kanak News (Eastern Media Limited) but provides no case counts, deaths, symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or source details for the diarrhoea outbreak. The summary focuses on two items: a security incident resulting in a killed commander, and a public health event (Ganjam diarrhoea outbreak) in Odisha with a concurrent Odisha bandh. No further epidemiological details are supplied. Keywords: Lashkar Commander killed; Ganjam diarrhoea outbreak; Odisha bandh; Odisha news; 9AM Headlines.

triage.headline_ja: ラシュカル司令官殺害 | ガンジャム地区で下痢アウトブレイク | オディシャ州バンド（ゼネスト） | 午前9時ヘッドライン
triage.triage_reason: オディシャ州ガンジャム地区での下痢アウトブレイクが報じられているが、症例数・死亡者数・検査確認などの詳細情報が全くなく、現時点では評価不能。続報を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はニュース速報の一部であり、下痢アウトブレイクに関する詳細（症例数、死亡者数、原因病原体、対応状況）が全く記載されていない。関連する公式発表や続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ಭದ್ರಾವತಿ ತಾಲ್ಲೂಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಚ್‌1ಎನ್1 ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಳ, ಜನರ ಆತಂಕ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in H1N1 cases in Bhadravati taluk, public anxiety.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) cases are rising in Bhadravati taluk, Shivamogga district, Karnataka. An eight-bed isolation ward has been opened at the taluk hospital for patients with fever, severe cold, cough, and breathing difficulties. Patients with H1N1-like symptoms are tested; nasal and throat swabs are sent to Shimoga Medical Sciences University for confirmation. Stocks of Tamiflu and diagnostic tools are adequate at the taluk hospital, with masks and hand hygiene promoted. Climate variability—heavy rains in July–August, drought earlier in the year, and September heat—is linked to the outbreak. In 2026, 72 patients were tested; 32 were confirmed H1N1. In 2025 (Jan 1–Sept 10), 107 tested, 15 positive. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; crowded places accelerate spread. No imported or exported cases are reported.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州バドラーヴァティ郡でH1N1（豚インフルエンザ)症例増加、住民に不安
triage.triage_reason: インド国内の季節性H1N1症例が顕著に増加し、住民の不安（社会的関心）が高まっているため、WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、社会的関心もありフルRRAへの移行基準を満たす。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザであり国際的な異常事象ではないが、地域内での症例急増と住民の不安から継続監視の対象とする。医療資源（タミフル等）は十分とされ、輸出入症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria among worst-hit countries as cholera deaths rise 30%
article.articleSummary: Cholera in 2025 hit Nigeria hard, with 548 deaths from 24,354 cases. Globally, 7,870 died and 451,499 cases were reported in 47 countries, the highest toll since 1999. Nigeria, Angola, Bangladesh, DRC, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen accounted for about 90% of reported cases and deaths. Africa saw cases rise 34% and deaths 58% from 2024; the true burden remains higher due to underreporting. Cholera is caused by Vibrio cholerae and spreads via contaminated food and water, causing severe diarrhoea and rapid dehydration; death can occur within hours if untreated. More than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities; among those treated, the global case fatality rate stayed below 1%, though 12 countries were above that benchmark. WHO urged investments in safe water, sanitation and hygiene, surveillance, vaccination and broader healthcare access; oral cholera vaccine production nearly doubled from 30 million doses in 2022 to 80 million in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: コレラ死者数30%増加、ナイジェリアが最も深刻な被害国の一つに
triage.triage_reason: 世界的にコレラ症例・死者数が1999年以来最悪の水準に達し、47カ国に拡大、DRCを含む複数国が主要被害国とされており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は主にナイジェリアおよび世界全体のコレラ流行状況を扱うグローバル報告。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが『主要被害国』として言及されているが、DRC固有の詳細データ（症例数・死者数）は記載されていない。ナイジェリア、アンゴラ、バングラデシュ、南スーダン、スーダン、イエメンは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk đã có 3 người chết vì sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak records 3 deaths from dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dak Lak Province reports its third dengue-related death in 2026, an 11-year-old boy from Krông Búk commune. Dengue IgM/IgG was positive. Fever began Sept 20; by Sept 21 he had abdominal pain and vomiting and was treated at Hoa Binh Hospital. On Sept 25 he was transferred to Tay Nguyen General Hospital with dengue fever, shock and severe organ failure, GI bleeding and respiratory failure. At 14:30 on Sept 28 he was sent home with respiratory failure stage IV, severe dengue with shock, severe organ failure, GI bleeding, anemia and coagulopathy, and died at 16:05 the same day at home. An epidemiological investigation and samples were sent to Tay Nguyen Institute for confirmation; initial checks found no suspected dengue cases around the home. Nationwide, 78,300 dengue cases and 13 deaths were recorded in the first eight months, up 1.2x vs 2025. Authorities urge prompt medical care for fever and vector-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でデング熱により3人目の死者
triage.triage_reason: 全国的にデング熱症例・死亡が増加傾向（前年比1.2倍）にあり、重症化・死亡例が続いていることから、公衆衛生上の懸念とベクター媒介感染症の流行しやすさの観点でフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの季節性風土病だが、2026年の全国症例数・死亡数が前年を上回っており、重症例（ショック、多臓器不全）の発生が続いている点に注意。地域（Đắk Lắk省）レベルでの個別症例報告であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Guwahati schools see HFMD cases as doctors stress hygiene and hydration
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases emerge in a Guwahati school, Assam, where two initial children developed hand rashes and five are now affected after three more classmates; two returned to school after about 15 days. Some families mistook symptoms for chickenpox. Dr Nayanmoni Deka (Pratiksha Hospital) notes HFMD causes painful mouth ulcers and vesicular rashes on palms, fingers, soles and toes, with mouth pain and dehydration risk; lesions may appear on buttocks, legs and arms. Distinguishing from chickenpox: HFMD lesions are not in successive crops and mouth involvement is common; no specific antiviral exists; fluid intake is priority. Advice: cold fluids and soft foods; avoid spicy, salty, acidic, very hot foods; if fluids are refused, IV fluids may be required. The infection is most contagious in the first week and can shed via respiratory secretions for 1–3 weeks and in stool longer; return to school when fever-free and well, not necessarily after all spots disappear. Clusters may trigger stricter exclusion. HFMD shows seasonality in Sept–Oct and Feb–Apr, with most cases in under-fives.

triage.headline_ja: ガウハティの学校でHFMD（手足口病）の症例が発生、医師が衛生管理と水分補給を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド・アッサム州の一学校における軽症の手足口病（HFMD）の小規模クラスター（5例）であり、季節性のよくある小児疾患で重症例・死亡例の報告もなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: HFMD（手足口病）は5歳未満の小児に多い季節性の一般的な感染症で、9〜10月に流行することが知られている。今回は1校5例という小規模クラスターで、特異な病原性変異や重症化の報告もないため、通常の経過観察対象にも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Νέος ιός από τσιμπούρια στην Κίνα: Τι αποκαλύπτει η ανακάλυψη του παθογόνου ALTNV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New tick-borne virus in China: What the discovery of the ALTNV pathogen reveals.
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), a newly identified tick-borne pathogen in China, is transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis and belongs to the Nairoviridae family. In a study of 3,163 patients with tick exposure across 15 Chinese provinces, ALTNV RNA or IgM was detected in 10.4% overall; among Dabie bandavirus (DBV)-negative patients, ALTNV positivity reached 15.1%. ALTNV-only illness mainly featured fatigue (84%) and gastrointestinal symptoms (80%), with thrombocytopenia (38%) and elevated aminotransferases (36%); all ALTNV-only patients recovered fully. Co-infection with DBV occurred in 38 patients, associated with higher severity: 61% respiratory issues vs 38% in DBV-only cases, 84% renal dysfunction vs 66%, and seven deaths (18.4%). Tick surveillance of 47,428 ticks from 15 provinces found ALTNV RNA in 1.3%, highest in Haemaphysalis longicornis (1.8%), which transmitted ALTNV to mice in lab tests. Authors call for improved differential diagnosis in SFTS-endemic areas where ALTNV and DBV co-circulate.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でマダニ媒介の新型ウイルス発見：病原体ALTNVが明らかにしたこと
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規マダニ媒介ウイルス(ALTNV)が学術的に同定されたとの報告であり、現時点では急性アウトブレイクではないが、SFTS(Dabie bandavirus)との共感染で重症化・死亡例が確認されているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（15省・3,163名の患者及び47,428匹のマダニ調査）に基づく新病原体の発見報告であり、進行中のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。ALTNV単独感染は軽症で全例回復したが、DBV(SFTS)との共感染では重症化率・死亡率(18.4%)が高く、鑑別診断の重要性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 31 Kasus Influenza A Terdeteksi di Bandung Barat, Dinkes Minta Warga Lakukan Hal Ini |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 31 Cases of Influenza A Detected in West Bandung Regency, Health Office Urges Residents to Do This | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: West Bandung Regency's Health Office reports 31 laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases, identified via swab tests at Cahya Kawaluyaan General Hospital (RSCK). As of 28 September, 31 individuals are infected, indicating local transmission activity. Influenza A spreads through respiratory droplets from coughs or sneezes, direct contact with contaminated hands, and contaminated surfaces. Symptoms include fever or chills, cough, runny or blocked nose, sore throat, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, and may involve nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Health facilities, including Puskesmas and hospitals, are prepared and provide uniform care irrespective of insurance status (BPJS or public). Authorities urge vigilance, especially for infants, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases. Preventive measures emphasize hygiene (handwashing with soap), masking when sick or in crowds, healthy living, and influenza vaccination for seniors, pregnant women, children, and at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 西バンドン県でインフルエンザA型31例を検出、保健局が住民に対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常規模の国内発生であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの記載がなく、基準該当なし。
triage.notes: 地域の保健局による通常の季節性インフルエンザ対応であり、重症例や死亡者数の記載なし。地方レベルの公衆衛生対応として管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: إصابات فيروس "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتجاوز 8 آلاف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus infections in the Congo exceed 8,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 8,116 confirmed infections, up more than 2,000 in the past month, according to the National Institute of Public Health. The toll stands at 3,924 deaths since the outbreak began. In the last 24 hours, 49 new cases and 23 deaths were recorded, with 18 recoveries. A Sept. 1 bulletin reported 6,100 cases and 2,950 deaths, underscoring the ongoing severity of transmission. The figures highlight persistent transmission and the need for sustained surveillance, case management, and public health measures to curb spread and reduce fatalities. No details on imported or exported cases were provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス感染、8,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の感染者数・死者数が急増しており（1ヶ月で2000人以上増加）、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 致死率が約48%と高く、感染者数も増加傾向にあるため継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de influenza sobem 94% e de Covid caem 88% em Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases rise 94% and COVID-19 cases fall 88% in Cuiabá.
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Brazil, reports opposite trends in respiratory viruses in 2026: COVID-19 notifications down 88.13% (n=148; 116 residents, 32 non-residents) through week 37 (Jan 4–Sep 19), with 5 deaths (2 residents, 3 non-residents) and overall mortality 0.72 per 100k; residents 0.29 per 100k. Influenza A and B total 2,820 cases (2,214 residents, 606 non-residents); resident cases up 94.89% from 1,136 in 2025 to 2,214 in 2026. Influenza deaths total 23 (16 residents, 7 non-residents); 60+ account for 14 of 16 resident influenza deaths. Age distribution among Cuiabá residents: 0–6 years 1,164; 7–14 years 691; 15–59 years 774; 60+ years 191. July peak reached 2,386 influenza cases (1,858 residents). Vaccination drive expanded to 72 Family Health Units; coverage low: 37.72% (6 months–<6 years), 40.13% elderly, 61% pregnant; targets 90%.

triage.headline_ja: クイアバ市でインフルエンザ症例94%増加、COVID-19症例88%減少
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランスデータであり、異常性・国際拡大リスクは認められず、ワクチン接種体制等で国内対応中のため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による季節性呼吸器疾患の定例統計報告。インフルエンザ症例増加は季節的変動の範囲内と考えられ、ワクチン接種率向上の取り組みも行われている。

article.articleHeadline: ÇARPICI KANSER ARAŞTIRMASI: Her 8 Vakadan 1'inde Rastlandı! Milyonlarca Vakanın Arkasında Bu Enfeksiyonlar Var!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking Cancer Study: Found in one in eight cases! These infections are behind millions of cases!
article.articleSummary: In 2024, infections from viruses, bacteria, and parasites were linked to about 2.3 million new cancer cases worldwide, roughly 12% of all new cancers. Helicobacter pylori was the leading infectious cause, tied to about 760,000 gastric cancer cases; human papillomavirus (HPV) accounted for about 750,000 cancers, including cervical, penile, and laryngeal cancers. Hepatitis B virus (HBV) also featured as a notable contributor. About three-quarters of infection-related cancers occurred in low- and middle-income countries. East Asia registered around 990,000 infection-related cancers in 2024 (42% of the global total), while Sub-Saharan Africa showed higher regional shares of infection-related cancers, largely linked to HPV. The findings emphasize vaccination, screening, and early diagnosis as key preventive measures, with HPV vaccination and gastric cancer screening and H. pylori detection discussed in some regions.

triage.headline_ja: 衝撃的ながん研究：8例に1例で発見！数百万件のがんの背後にあるこれらの感染症！
triage.triage_reason: 感染症とがんリスクに関する一般的な疫学研究の報道であり、特定の国での急性アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界的な感染症関連がんの統計研究（2024年データ）を紹介するもので、中国上海の具体的な発生事例ではない。発生地域として付与されたShanghai/Chinaは記事の主題と無関係であり、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: New Tick-Borne Virus Found in China: What Scientists Know About ALTNV
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, Asian longhorned tick nairovirus, is a newly identified tick-borne orthonairovirus detected in China. In a NEJM study, ALTNV caused flu-like illness with fatigue, fever, gastrointestinal symptoms and thrombocytopenia; most infections with ALTNV alone recovered. Among 3,163 patients, 10.4% were ALTNV-positive by RNA or IgM; 15.1% of DBV-negative patients were ALTNV-positive. ALTNV RNA was found in ticks (1.3% of 47,428 across 15 provinces), with Haemaphysalis longicornis showing 1.8% prevalence; lab work showed this tick species can transmit ALTNV to mice. Coinfection with ALTNV and DBV occurred in 38 patients; 61% had respiratory symptoms and 84% kidney impairment, with 7/38 deaths (18.4%). Researchers caution these are associations, not causation, and stress differential diagnosis in SFTS-endemic areas; DBV remains linked to SFTS with 10–30% fatality, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスを発見：ALTNVについて科学者が分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規同定されたマダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス（ALTNV）が報告され、重症熱性血小板減少症候群(SFTS)ウイルスとの混合感染例で高い致死率（18.4%）が確認されており、新興感染症として監視が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: NEJM掲載の研究に基づく新興マダニ媒介ウイルスの発見報告。単独感染は多くが回復するが、DBV（SFTS関連ウイルス）との混合感染では死亡率が高い。現時点ではヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、国際的拡大の証拠も不明。続報および公式見解（WHO/中国CDC等）の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Donald Trump Deflects Congo War Evidence by Asking an African Reporter 'How Is Ebola Going?'
article.articleSummary: Congo's Ebola outbreak is the largest in the country's history, with 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths as of 26 September; Ituri province accounts for the majority (6,155 cases, 2,834 deaths). The Bundibugyo virus drives the outbreak, with no approved vaccine or specific treatment and about a 48% case fatality. The crisis sits amid Congo–Rwanda conflict, with Rwanda-backed M23 rebels displacing more than 7 million people per UN data. Washington Accords between Congo and Rwanda, signed 4 December 2025, aim to end the war but enforcement has faltered. U.S. policy is contested: Democrats argue that cuts to USAID weakened surveillance; the U.S. pledged about $886 million by September and mobilized $23 million in emergency aid for Congo and Uganda in May, while seeking roughly $1.4 billion for the wider response. In the Oval Office, Trump deflected an Angolan reporter’s inquiry on the war by asking about Ebola, saying it was ‘under control’ but not addressing the conflict. 2026-09-30.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏、アフリカ人記者からのコンゴ紛争に関する質問を「エボラの状況はどうか？」とはぐらかす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、致死率約48%、ワクチン・特効薬なし、紛争による人口移動で感染拡大・対応困難が深刻化しているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ紛争とエボラ対応を政治的文脈で扱っており、疫学的詳細（8,067症例・3,901死亡、Ituri州が大半）は深刻。ウガンダ・ルワンダ・アンゴラは地理的文脈で言及されるのみで対象国リスト外のため除外。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تُحذّر: تحديات تُعيق تقديم الرعاية لمرضى "إيبولا" بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns: Challenges hindering the provision of care to Ebola patients in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 30 September 2026, 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths (case fatality rate >48%) have been reported across 63 health zones in seven of the country’s 26 provinces. Although transmission is declining in some areas, the number of cases remains high, with many deaths occurring at home or within communities due to limited timely access to care. Delays in seeking care and referral barriers continue to hinder response efforts. WHO and partners have expanded Ebola treatment capacity to over 1,600 beds across 50 treatment centers in the seven affected provinces, with plans to reach above 2,000 beds. Approximately 400 health workers have been trained to provide safe, high-quality care around the clock. No licensed vaccine is available yet; vaccine trials are ongoing, and WHO allocated 20,000 doses of Ervebo for a vaccination research program in Ituri Province."

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告：コンゴのエボラ患者へのケア提供を妨げる課題
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が7州63保健地域に拡大し、致死率48%超、8,067症例・3,901死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHOおよびパートナーが治療能力拡大・ワクチン研究（Ervebo 20,000回分）を実施中。ライセンス済みワクチンは未承認で、依然として対応に課題がある状況。

article.articleHeadline: Bukan Sekadar Flu, Kenali Tanda Bahaya Influenza A yang Bisa Berujung Rawat Inap di RS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not Just the Flu: Recognize the Warning Signs of Influenza A That Could Lead to Hospitalization.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity in Indonesia is increasing. Week 37, 2026 influenza-positive rate among ILI samples reached 58.59%, up from 53.71% the prior week. Of 198 specimens tested, 105 were Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and 7 were Influenza A(H3N2). Influenza A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in Indonesia, with 188 cases across 20 provinces through week 37, 2026, concentrated in DKI Jakarta, East Java, and South Kalimantan. Most cases occur in children aged 0–4, 5–9, and 10–17 years. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, headache, myalgia, fatigue, and reduced appetite; children may also experience nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Allianz Life Indonesia reports a 47% rise in inpatient influenza claims, totaling over Rp13.8 billion. High-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic or immunocompromised conditions; complications can include pneumonia and bronchitis. Early recognition and timely medical care are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 単なる風邪ではない、入院につながる可能性があるインフルエンザAの危険な兆候を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H3N2)の新規サブクレードKがインドネシア20州で検出され、陽性率上昇・入院関連保険金47%増加など拡大傾向が見られるため、WPRO基準で複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: H3N2サブクレードKの詳細な遺伝的特徴や重症度データ、国際的拡大の有無については続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo exceed 8,000
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have climbed to 8,116 confirmed infections with 3,924 deaths as of 30 September 2026, according to Kinshasa's National Institute of Public Health (INSP). The total marks an increase of more than 2,000 cases in the past month. On 1 September, INSP reported 6,100 confirmed cases and 2,950 deaths. Over the last 24 hours, 49 new cases, 23 deaths and 18 recoveries were recorded, underscoring the continuing outbreak since it began. The update traces the trajectory from 6,100 cases/2,950 deaths on 1 September to the current totals of 8,116 cases and 3,924 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱症例数が8,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率が高く大規模なエボラ出血熱の流行が継続拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約48%と非常に高く、月間で2000例以上増加しており、流行が継続・拡大している。国際的な支援と監視の継続が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളം പനിക്കിടക്കയിൽ; ഇൻഫ്ലുവൻസ ബാധിച്ച് ഈ മാസം മരിച്ചത് 20 പേർ; ഡെങ്കി, എലിപ്പനി കേസുകളിലും വർധന
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala in the grip of fever; 20 people have died this month due to influenza; dengue and chikungunya cases also on the rise.
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, India, influenza is surging with 20 influenza-related deaths this month and 251 cases, raising the year-to-date totals to 11,021 infections and 119 deaths. Thiruvananthapuram and other districts are affected; last September recorded 4 deaths and 724 cases, while last year’s totals were 6,182 cases and 40 deaths, signaling a sharp year-on-year rise. Dengue and chikungunya cases are also increasing. Health authorities urge prompt medical care for fever with body pains, avoid self-medication, rest, and ample fluids; elderly and children require extra vigilance, and feverish children should not be sent to school; do not delay taking prescribed medicines. For dengue, prevent mosquito breeding and water stagnation by managing rain-related habitats, adhering to dry-day guidelines, covering water storage tanks, and removing or limiting containers, plant pots, and other items that collect water; take personal precautions to avoid bites, as secondary dengue can be severe.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州が発熱の渦中に；今月インフルエンザで20人死亡；デング熱・チクングニア症例も増加
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザによる死亡者数・症例数が前年比で大幅増加（死亡40→119人、症例6182→11021件）しており、デング熱・チクングニアも同時に増加しているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常な拡大が認められる。
triage.notes: 季節性疾患（インフルエンザ・デング熱・チクングニア）だが、前年比で死亡数・症例数が顕著に増加しており、ケララ州保健当局が注意喚起を行っている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Borrowed gun to Asian Games gold: How Neeru Dhanda battled H1N1, hardship & years of sacrifice to become India's shooting star
article.articleSummary: Neeru Dhanda became the first Indian woman to win an individual trap gold at the Asian Games, in Nagoya, marking India’s first shooting gold there and the first since Randhir Singh in 1978. The victory capped a difficult campaign after illness: three days in a Bhopal hospital with suspected H1N1 flu, a five-day liquid diet, and three-and-a-half weeks without training. She arrived in Nagoya short of practice but focused; coached by Mansher Singh with national coach Peter Wilson urging her to grind it out. Her rise was financed by family sacrifices; mother Sudesh Devi sold buffalo milk to fund the sport; the family lived in Sangatpura, Haryana. The Madhya Pradesh Shooting Academy offered free guns; Neeru trained there after moving to Bhopal in 2019. She dedicated the win to her family, postponing marriage to support them.
