article.articleHeadline: RDC : un cadre de l'UDPS tué à Butembo après une émission sur Ebola - Tchadinfos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a UDPS official killed in Butembo after a program about Ebola - Tchadinfos
article.articleSummary: UDPS official Marie-Célestin Karondwa Mwanaweka Bytaty, interim president of the party’s Permanent Electoral Commission and spokesperson for the Butembo federation, died on September 27 in Butembo, North Kivu, DRC, after being violently assaulted following a Radio Mwangaza program on Ebola awareness. A necrology released September 28 confirms he succumbed to his injuries; the attackers and exact circumstances are under investigation. The incident occurs amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Butembo among affected zones where response teams face mistrust and violence. The UDPS calls for a formal investigation and urged calm among the population. Reuters is cited as reporting on the case. This event underscores security and safety challenges surrounding Ebola communications efforts in outbreak areas of North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ブテンボでエボラに関する番組放送後、UDPS幹部が殺害される
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はエボラ啓発番組放送後に発生した政治家暴行死事件であり、疾患そのものの新規症例情報ではないが、進行中のエボラ流行地域における対応チームへの不信感・治安悪化を示す文脈情報として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの疫学情報ではなく、流行地域における啓発活動を巡る暴力事件・政治的緊張を報じたもの。エボラ対応への支障（住民の不信感・治安悪化）を示す間接的シグナルとしてWATCH指定。フルRRAの対象としては、別途エボラ流行の疫学データ（症例数・死亡数等）を含む記事を参照する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Suy đa phủ tạng do nhiễm liên cầu lợn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Multiorgan failure due to Streptococcus suis infection.
article.articleSummary: From Lang Son, Vietnam, a 61-year-old man developed multiorgan failure due to Streptococcus suis infection. On 30 September he was admitted in critical condition with septic shock and bacteremia, presenting fever, hemorrhagic rash and facial skin necrosis, and respiratory failure. He could not provide a clear history of consuming raw pork products but reportedly drank alcohol heavily. He had been treated at a provincial hospital for septic shock, pneumonia, acute pancreatitis and DIC before transfer to the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi. Chest CT showed pleural effusions, consolidation and lobar collapse. He received intensive care with transfusions of coagulation factors and platelets and continuous renal replacement therapy; he remains critically ill. S. suis, common in pigs, is transmitted via undercooked pork products and pig exposure. Precautions include avoiding raw meat, wearing protective gear, and proper wound care; inform clinicians of exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 豚レンサ球菌感染による多臓器不全
triage.triage_reason: 単発の重症例報告であり、流行の兆候や公衆衛生上の広範な影響を示す情報がないため、現時点ではフルRRAの対象としない。
triage.notes: 単発の個人症例報告。Streptococcus suisは豚由来の既知の散発性人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染は稀。続報があれば集団発生の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO konfirmasi kasus pes pada manusia di enam negara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms human plague cases in six countries.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms human plague cases in six countries. From 2019 through 2025, WHO documented 3,847 suspected plague cases and 423 deaths worldwide, a case fatality rate of 11%. Six countries reported confirmed human plague cases, while ten reported suspected cases. Most cases were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Madagascar, where plague remains endemic in parts of the country; the disease can occur in nations that do not report cases. The agency emphasizes ongoing surveillance of rodent and other animal populations and rapid outbreak response to detect plague early, reduce transmission, and prevent larger outbreaks. This underscores the need for sustained international surveillance, rapid reporting, and continued investments in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、6カ国でヒトペスト感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: WHOが複数国にわたるヒトペスト感染と高い致死率を報告しており、国際的拡大と重篤性の観点からIHR基準を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界的なペストサーベイランス報告（2019-2025年）であり、主要発生国はDRCとマダガスカルだが、マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 吉北加强狂犬病监测行动 采集50份猫狗样本送检|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Northern Jilin strengthens rabies surveillance efforts, collecting 50 cat and dog samples for testing.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-30, Kedah State Veterinary Services in Malaysia intensified rabies surveillance after a rabies death in the area. They collected 50 samples—46 dogs and 4 cats—near the incident; all 46 dog samples tested so far are negative. The suspected biting dog died, leaving no testable sample, so authorities are sampling surrounding dogs. Three consecutive nights of nocturnal street surveys and stray-dog captures are under way. Since January, Kedah has vaccinated 617 owned dogs, via fixed clinics and door-to-door campaigns; after the human case, monitoring of strays and other animals has been strengthened. A 14-day quarantine is observed for biting dogs; if healthy after 14 days, infection is ruled out. Cross-border risk from Thailand is noted, with immune-belt coverage—Perlis, Kedah, northern Perak, and Kelantan. Dog owners are urged to vaccinate and, if bitten, wash wounds with soap and water for 15 minutes and seek care.

triage.headline_ja: 吉北、狂犬病監視活動を強化 猫・犬のサンプル50件を検査に提出
triage.triage_reason: マレーシア・ケダ州での狂犬病は同国において地方流行性であり、今回の対応は通常の監視活動の範囲内。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められず、対象国（マレーシアは対象外）にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマレーシア・ケダ州における狂犬病死亡例を受けた地方獣医当局による通常のサーベイランス活動を報じたもの。タイとの国境地域における免疫ベルト整備への言及はあるが、実際の発生地はマレーシアであり、対象国リスト（タイ等）には該当しない。マレーシア自体も対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: কুকুরের কামড়ে শিশুমৃত্যু বেড়েছে, কেন জলাতঙ্কের টিকা নেওয়া জরুরি জানাল আইসিএমআর, কী কী নিতে হবে?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child deaths from dog bites have risen; ICMR says rabies vaccination is essential; what all should be taken?
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major public health issue in India, with more than 5,000 deaths annually, including many children, driven by bites from street dogs. Data from ICMR and the National Institute of Epidemiology underscore rising pediatric fatalities and urge vaccination for both children and adults, with particular emphasis on high-risk groups. Wound care should start immediately: wash the bite with soap and running water for 15 minutes; if bleedings severe, administer Rabies Immunoglobulin alongside the vaccine. Post-exposure vaccination (ARV) consists of five doses on days 0, 3, 5, 7, and 14, with a final dose on day 28. Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is advised where risk is higher or access to care is limited, delivered in three doses at intervals of 7, 21, or 28 days. Indian Academy of Pediatrics guidelines stress vaccination for children in households with pets or in areas with stray-dog prevalence.

triage.headline_ja: 犬に噛まれて小児の死亡が増加、ICMRが狂犬病ワクチン接種の重要性を指摘。何を接種すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、本記事は新規の異常発生ではなくワクチン接種啓発・一般的な公衆衛生情報を伝えるものである。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドにおいて毎年5000人以上の死亡者を出す既知の風土病であり、本記事は特定の発生イベントではなく、ICMRによるワクチン接種推奨と創傷処置のガイダンスを伝える教育的内容。新規性・異常性がなく、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera Deaths Hit Highest Level Since 1999, Rose By 30% In 2025: WHO
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths rose 30% in 2025 to 7,870, the highest since 1999, with 451,499 cases reported to the WHO from 47 countries; the burden is likely higher. The African Region bore the largest burden, with cases up 34% and deaths up 58% versus 2024. Seven countries—Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen—accounted for about 90% of reported cases and deaths. More than one in five cholera deaths occurred outside health facilities. Among those treated in facilities, the global case-fatality rate stayed below 1%, but exceeded 1% in 12 countries. Oral cholera vaccine production more than doubled from about 30 million doses in 2022 to 80 million in 2025. Cholera is caused by Vibrio cholerae, spread via contaminated food or water; prevention includes rehydration, antibiotics for severe cases, and vaccines. WHO urged investments in safe water, sanitation, surveillance, vaccination, and access to quality care.

triage.headline_ja: コレラによる死亡者数が1999年以来最高水準に、2025年に30%増加：WHO
triage.triage_reason: WHOによるコレラの世界的な死亡率・罹患率の急増報告であり、複数のIHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界全体のコレラ統計報告であり、アフリカ地域（特にアンゴラ、DRC、ナイジェリア、南スーダン、スーダン）とイエメン、バングラデシュが主要7カ国として挙げられているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。特定地域に限定した個別事案ではなくグローバルトレンドの報告である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Maniema : quatre cas de tuberculose confirmés à la prison centrale de Kasongo | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Maniema: Four Confirmed Cases of Tuberculosis at Kasongo Central Prison | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Four tuberculosis cases have been confirmed at Kasongo Central Prison in Maniema Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The confirmation was publicly reported on September 29 by prison director Zakuani Issa Fidèle. All four inmates are undergoing treatment, but their families provide limited support, particularly in food and assistance. The prison’s overcrowded conditions and scarce resources are cited as factors complicating the management and care of ill detainees. The prison chief appealed to Maniema provincial authorities, the Provincial Health Division (DPS), and humanitarian organizations to intervene to strengthen treatment and support for those infected and to help prevent further transmission within the facility. The article highlights concerns about disease spread in overcrowded detention settings and the need for enhanced health interventions in the prison system.

triage.headline_ja: マニエマ州:カソンゴ中央刑務所で結核4例確認
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内の過密状態での結核集団発生であり地域拡大や国際的懸念は限定的だが、感染拡大リスクと支援要請があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 刑務所内の過密状態と資源不足が感染拡大の要因とされ、当局・人道団体への支援要請がある。ただし患者数は4名と限定的で、地域社会への拡大や国際的な影響の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Bhutan Opens New Animal Shelter After Regional Rabies Milestone
article.articleSummary: Bhutan validated elimination of dog-transmitted human rabies as a public health problem by WHO on 4 September 2026, the first country in WHO Southeast Asia Region to achieve this milestone; no human deaths from dog-mediated rabies since June 2023. On World Rabies Day (28 September 2026), Thimphu opened a new RSPCA Bhutan shelter inaugurated by Queen Mother Tshering Yangdon Wangchuck. The Nu 11.7 million (about USD 122,000) facility was funded through India’s Project Tied Assistance Fund, with support from Project Dantak, De-suung and the Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation. It provides dedicated treatment and rehabilitation spaces—day-care, intensive-care unit, incinerator shed—and extended housing for animals awaiting placement. RSPCA Bhutan, active since 1999, conducts sterilisation, vaccination and public education. The shelter strengthens capacity to rescue, medically treat and prevent rabies re-establishment under a One Health framework.

triage.headline_ja: ブータン、地域的な狂犬病撲滅の節目を受けて新動物保護施設を開設
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の排除達成という前向きなニュースであり、新規感染拡大や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。対象国（インド等）も主題ではなく、ブータンは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はブータンにおける狂犬病撲滅達成と動物保護施設開設を報じるポジティブなニュース。インドは資金援助国として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les bailleurs évaluent les dispositifs de riposte à l'aéroport de N'djili - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Donors assess the response mechanisms at N'Djili Airport - ACP
article.articleSummary: Donors and partners in the Democratic Republic of Congo assessed the Ebola response mechanisms at N'djili International Airport in Kinshasa on 30 September 2026, amid the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. The delegation—including the US State Department, the CDC, IOM, WHO, AFNET, Expertise France, and Médecins Sans Frontières, alongside the Congolese government and Kinshasa's provincial health division—reviewed preparedness progress and airport response capacities. Investments highlighted include the installation of sanitary corridors, handwashing facilities, and pre-positioned commodities; medicalized ambulances; and isolation containers deployed in the domestic and international terminals and at the Monusco terminal where UN and humanitarian flights operate. Coordinated, multi-sectoral efforts with security services were noted as essential to the response. RVA, the public airport operator, was acknowledged for its role. Coordinators stressed ongoing improvements to equipment, personnel, and infrastructure in the context of the current Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ドナーがヌジリ空港での対応体制を評価 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する内容であり、致死率が高く国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクを伴う重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はキンシャサのヌジリ国際空港における対応体制の評価を報じており、現行の第17次エボラアウトブレイクの一環。米国はパートナー機関（CDC、国務省）としての関与であり、発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo exceed 8,000
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo – Ebola outbreak remains ongoing. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports 8,116 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,924 deaths since the outbreak began, as of 30 September 2026. This total reflects an increase of more than 2,000 cases over the past month, up from 6,100 confirmed cases and 2,950 deaths reported on 1 September. In the last 24 hours, INSP recorded 49 new cases, 23 deaths, and 18 recoveries, bringing the latest totals to 8,116 cases and 3,924 deaths. The data indicate sustained transmission within the country, underscoring the need for continued surveillance, containment, and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱患者数が8,000人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が8,000人超・死者3,900人超に達し、感染拡大が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と非常に高く、直近1ヶ月で2,000例以上増加しており感染拡大が継続している。国際的な支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 40歲漢外地與人翻雲覆雨　返港後染猴痘下體等出疹
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 40-year-old man who had sex with someone abroad contracts monkeypox and develops genital rashes after returning to Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: A new monkeypox case in Hong Kong involves a 40-year-old man who had high-risk sex abroad; after returning, he developed genital, oral, and limb rashes with fever starting Sept 28 and is now isolated at Queen Mary Hospital, with infection confirmed by the Centre for Health Protection’s Public Health Laboratory Service. Authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations and reporting to the WHO. Hong Kong’s 2026 tally reaches 29 cases (22 locally acquired, 7 imported), with 20 new cases since August. Recent clusters show high-risk sexual behavior, including sex with strangers or multiple partners without condoms; 12 cases used dating apps. Most patients were unvaccinated; about 40% are HIV-positive. Genomic analysis finds identical sequences across some cases, suggesting shared sources and multiple transmission chains among MSM. Some cases remain unlinked to new partners, hindering contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 海外で性交渉を持った40歳の男性、香港帰国後に猴痘（エムポックス）に感染し陰部などに発疹
triage.triage_reason: 香港における2026年のエムポックス集積事例（計29例、MSM間での複数伝播チェーンと高リスク性行動）が継続しており、WPRO基準の複数該当（持続曝露・流行しやすさ）と当局（衛生防護センター）の積極的な疫学調査・WHO報告という行政の関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は香港における既知のエムポックス集団発生（MSM間、HIV陽性者約4割、複数伝播チェーン、出会い系アプリ利用）の最新症例報告。重症度は高くないが、ワクチン未接種者中心の持続的な感染拡大パターンが確認されており、続報・全体動向の精査が望ましい。香港はChina(1814991)に含めて集計。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh's Deadliest Measles Outbreak Claims Over 1,100 Lives: Could Immunity Gaps Leave India Vulnerable?
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces its deadliest measles outbreak in decades. By 30 September 2026, measles- and measles-like illness deaths exceed 1,100, with 101 laboratory-confirmed measles and the rest suspected. Since March, over 211,000 cases and 168,655 hospitalisations have strained paediatric wards; five deaths and more than 1,300 new diagnoses were reported in the 24 hours to 30 September. Most confirmed infections are in unvaccinated children; about 83% of lab-confirmed cases lack prior measles vaccination, with infants under six months highly vulnerable; malnutrition worsens outcomes. Immunity gaps arise from disrupted routine immunisation during COVID-19; an April–May 2026 measles-rubella campaign reached over 19 million children, yet transmission persists due to incomplete coverage and earlier vaccine-supply challenges. WHO reports persistent outbreaks in the SE Asia Region; global two-dose coverage should be 95%, but 2025 figures were 84% (dose 1) and 77% (dose 2). India, while improving vaccination, still has localized pockets of vulnerability, including Delhi’s Kailash Nagar outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで過去最悪の麻疹流行、死者1,100人超：免疫ギャップがインドを脆弱にする可能性は？
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで数十年来最悪規模の麻疹流行が発生し、死者1,100人超・症例21万人超と公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 主たる発生国はバングラデシュだが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドについては記事中でデリー・カイラシュナガルでの実際の麻疹流行が言及されているため対象国として含めた。バングラデシュでの大規模流行は地域全体（東南アジア地域）の免疫ギャップと関連し、インドを含む周辺国への拡大懸念が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: 小卷等海鮮易染這壞菌！松山某國小傳10生嘔吐　醫：5招防中毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Small squid and other seafood easily contaminated by this harmful bacterium! Ten students at a Songshan elementary school vomited; doctor: 5 tips to prevent poisoning.
article.articleSummary: Taipei reports a suspected squid-related gastroenteritis cluster linked to Vibrio parahaemolyticus. On Sept 24, about 10 students at a Songshan District elementary school developed vomiting and gastrointestinal symptoms after squid in school lunch; earlier on Sept 4, students and staff at Jin Hua Junior High School experienced diarrhea and vomiting after squid, with both schools’ squid from the same supplier. Lin Kou Chang Gung Memorial Hospital Clinical Toxicology Center director Yan Zonghai said authorities will test patient stool samples and food samples to identify the pathogen; culture confirmation will define the causative organism and contamination source. The squid may be contaminated with enteric vibrios; high heat kills it. Five prevention tips: keep kitchen clean; separate raw and cooked; cook seafood thoroughly; avoid long room-temperature storage of cooked foods; ill kitchen staff should not prepare food.

triage.headline_ja: 小卷など海鮮はこの悪玉菌に感染しやすい！松山区のある小学校で生徒10人が嘔吐　医師：食中毒予防の5つのポイント
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の学校給食におけるイカを介した腸炎ビブリオ食中毒の疑い事例であり、散発的な食品衛生事案で国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。食品由来の腸炎ビブリオによる学校での集団食中毒疑い事例で、重症例や死亡の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie dépasse les 8 000 cas confirmés - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak surpasses 8,000 confirmed cases - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: By 27 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reported 8,067 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,901 deaths, per ECDC data available 26 September. The Bundibugyo virus drives the outbreak, detected in 63 health zones across seven provinces. Ituri is the epicenter with over 6,000 cases; Nord-Kivu is the second-largest hotspot. Over 2,000 patients have recovered; hundreds remain isolated or hospitalized. Contact tracing remains central to the response. WHO cites conflict, displacement, and limited access as barriers to surveillance, testing, tracing, and care. This is the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, surpassing 2018–2020, driven by Bundibugyo, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists. Frontline vaccination proceeds under research protocols; trials are evaluating treatments. Cross-border surveillance has been strengthened; regional risk is high in DRC, high for neighbors, and low elsewhere. No travel restrictions are advised. Response emphasizes rapid detection, isolation, vaccination under authorized protocols, contact tracing, and border monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ:流行は確認症例8,000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率も高く、ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyoウイルスによるもの。国際的拡大リスクも指摘されており、IHR・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: WHOは紛争・避難民・アクセス制限が監視・検査・追跡・ケアの障壁になっていると指摘。国境を越えた監視体制は強化されたが、近隣諸国へのリスクは高いとされる。治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyoウイルス株による史上最大規模の流行である点が特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: പനിച്ച് വിറച്ച് കേരളം. സെപ്റ്റംബറിൽ മാത്രം 20 ഇൻഫ്ലുവൻസ മരണം. ഈ വർഷം ആകെ മരിച്ചത് 119 പേർ. മരണം കഴിഞ്ഞ വർഷത്തേക്കാൾ ഇരട്ടി. രോഗബാധിതർ പതിനൊന്നായിരം കടന്നു. ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയിലും അതീവ ജാഗ്രത വേണമെന്ന് ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ്. സ്വയംചികിത്സ ഒഴിവാക്കണമെന്നും 'ഡ്രൈ ഡേ' കർശനമായി പാലിക്കണമെന്നും നിർദ്ദേശം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever grips Kerala. 20 influenza deaths in September alone. This year, a total of 119 deaths. Deaths are double those of last year. Infections surpass 11,000. The health department says extreme caution is needed even in dengue. Avoid self-medication and strictly observe the 'Dry Day.'
article.articleSummary: Influenza mortality and infections surge in Kerala, India, in September 2026: 20 influenza deaths this month, bringing the year-to-date toll to 119 and infections to 11,021. By this point last year, Kerala recorded 4 deaths and 724 cases, so current mortality and case counts are markedly higher; September alone has seen 251 cases. Health authorities warn that dengue risk rises with ongoing rains and urge extreme caution, advising against self-medication. A strict Dry Day campaign is recommended: Fridays in educational institutions, Saturdays in workplaces, Sundays at homes to curb mosquito breeding. Preventive actions include eliminating standing water in refrigerators trays, indoor plant pots, water containers, decorative water features, and unused storage areas; removing obstacles on terraces, sunshades, and roof gutters; ensuring water-holding vessels are covered. Fever patients should seek medical care promptly, maintain hydration, and wear masks, with special care for the elderly, pregnant, and young children; do not send feverish children to school.

triage.headline_ja: 熱に震えるケラーラ州。9月だけでインフルエンザ死者20人。今年の累計死者は119人。死者数は昨年の2倍。感染者は1万1千人を突破。デング熱にも最大限の警戒を呼びかけ。保健当局：自己治療を避け、'ドライデー'の厳格な実施を
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザによる死者数・感染者数が前年比で顕著に増加しており（死者119人 vs 前年4人、感染者11,021人 vs 前年724人）、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザとデング熱の両方に言及しているが、主要な統計（死者数・感染者数の大幅増加）はインフルエンザに関するもの。デング熱はリスク上昇の注意喚起レベルで具体的な症例数データは記事内に明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Bangka Belitung dan DKI Jakarta Jadi Provinsi Prioritas Penanganan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangka Belitung Islands Province and the Jakarta Special Capital Region Become Priority Provinces for TB Control
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, Indonesia's Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono identified Bangka Belitung Islands Province and the Jakarta Special Capital Region (DKI Jakarta) as the provinces with the highest tuberculosis (TB) case counts by population density. Bangka Belitung ranks first, Jakarta second, and both will serve as pilot sites for TB control programs. He stressed that TB does not respect rural or urban boundaries, noting Bangka Belitung as a rural area and Jakarta as urban, yet both face substantial transmission. The statement underscored the rapid spread of TB and the importance of preventive therapy to curb incidence, with these two provinces prioritized for demonstration and intervention within national TB control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: バンカ・ブリトゥン州とDKIジャカルタが結核対策優先州に
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、政府の既存対策プログラムに関する通常の政策発表であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性的な風土病であり、国の政策的優先順位付けに関する記事であるため、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera Crisis: Nigeria among seven worst-hit nations as global deaths surge
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths increased by 30% in 2025 despite a decline in reported infections, with the WHO recording 451,499 cases and 7,870 deaths across 47 countries—the deadliest year since 1999. Seven nations—Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen—accounted for about 90% of all reported cholera cases and deaths. Africa saw cases rise 34% and deaths 58% versus 2024; authorities warn underreporting likely understates the true burden. More than 20% of cholera deaths occurred outside health facilities, while the in-facility case-fatality rate remained below 1%; 12 countries reported CFRs above 1% in 2025. Global oral cholera vaccine production expanded from ~30 million doses in 2022 to ~80 million in 2025. The WHO urges prompt medical care and sustained access to clean water, sanitation, and hygiene to prevent deaths; figures may still underrepresent the disease's scale.

triage.headline_ja: コレラ危機:ナイジェリアが世界的な死者数急増の中、最も深刻な影響を受けた7カ国の一つに
triage.triage_reason: WHOが2025年を1999年以降最悪のコレラ流行年と報告し、死亡率が30%増加、47カ国に拡大しているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ・中東・南アジアにまたがる世界的なコレラ流行状況の報告であり、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。ナイジェリア・アンゴラ・スーダン・イエメン・バングラデシュ・南スーダンは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 民族國小學生午餐後腸胃不適　台北市府採檢追原因、中央廚房查出2項缺失 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minzu Elementary School students experience gastrointestinal discomfort after lunch; Taipei City Government conducts tests to trace the cause, central kitchen finds two deficiencies | LIFE生活網
article.articleSummary: Taipei City’s Minzu Elementary School in Songshan District reported gastroenteritis-like illness in nine second-grade students from one class after lunch on Sept 24; 716 students and staff ate that lunch. By Sept 26, the nine exhibited GI symptoms; six sought medical care and three were monitored at home. All have returned to school with no ongoing symptoms. Preliminary assessment points to gastroenteritis; viral etiologies such as influenza or norovirus are not ruled out pending further investigation. The central kitchen serving four schools is under review; only Minzu Elementary reported similar symptoms. Health authorities collected leftover lunch samples on Sept 25 for testing (results expected in about two weeks) and inspected the central kitchen on Sept 26, identifying deficiencies in transport records, sanitation logs, and oil-intercept cleaning. Improvements are mandated, with penalties possible under the Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act. Ongoing health monitoring and supplier oversight are in place.

triage.headline_ja: 民族国民小学の学生、昼食後に胃腸の不調を訴える　台北市政府が検査し原因を追跡、中央厨房で2つの不備を発見
triage.triage_reason: 単一小学校内の限定的な集団胃腸炎事例であり、全員軽快・通学再開済みで、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国リスト外）の単一小学校における食品衛生関連の軽症胃腸炎集団発生。原因病原体（ノロウイルス/インフルエンザ）は未確定で、地方自治体による通常の食品安全対応がなされている。対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Mendadak hingga 40 Derajat Celsius, Kenali Gejala Influenza A yang Mirip Flu Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sudden fever up to 40°C: Know the symptoms of Influenza A that resemble the common flu.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A can manifest abruptly with high fever (38–40°C), severe myalgia/arthralgia, headache, fatigue, dry cough, sore throat, and nasal congestion or discharge. In children, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea may accompany infection. Symptoms resemble other respiratory infections, so clinical presentation alone cannot confirm Influenza A. Diagnosis relies on laboratory testing of respiratory specimens (nasal or nasopharyngeal swabs). Rapid Influenza Diagnostic Tests (RIDT) yield results in about 10–15 minutes but have limited sensitivity, so a negative RIDT does not rule out influenza. RT-PCR testing offers higher accuracy and can differentiate influenza types. Specimen collection is most effective in the first days after onset, particularly around day four. Be alert for signs of severe illness. Source: Indonesian Ministry of Health guidance; article from Bogor, Indonesia, published 2026-09-30.

triage.headline_ja: 突然の40度近い発熱：一般的なインフルエンザに似たインフルエンザAの症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAの一般的な症状解説記事であり、特定の集団感染やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の異常事象としての情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザAの一般的な症状・診断方法に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Kembali Merebak, Kenali Gejala hingga Tanda Perlu ke Dokter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Is Spreading Again: Recognize Symptoms and Signs That Require a Doctor Visit
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is spreading in Indonesia as of 26 September 2026. Weekly surveillance (week 37) shows 58.59% of Influenza-Like Illness samples testing positive, up from 53.71% the previous week. Of 198 specimens, 105 were Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and 7 were Influenza A(H3N2); A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in the country. By week 37, 188 cases had been reported across 20 provinces, including DKI Jakarta, Jawa Timur, and Kalimantan Selatan, with the subclade K predominantly in ages 0–4, 5–9, and 10–17. Symptoms commonly include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion or runny nose, headache, and muscle aches; fatigue and reduced appetite are also noted, with nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea in children. Complications can be pneumonia, bronchitis, and pharyngitis; high-risk groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic illness or immunocompromised status. Health-insurance data show a 47% rise in hospitalizations for influenza in Jan–Aug 2026 versus 2025, and Allianz Life Indonesia paid over Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 influenza claims through the second week of September 2026, underscoring healthcare utilization and the need for early recognition and timely medical care.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが再拡大、受診が必要な症状とサインを知る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1pdm09が主体)の通常の流行拡大であるが、新しいH3N2 subclade Kの検出や入院数の増加がみられるため、情報不足のまま続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インドネシア20州で198検体中105例がH1N1pdm09、7例がH3N2（新subclade K検出、0-17歳に多い）。入院は前年比47%増。季節性インフルエンザのサーベイランス報告であり、新規性・国際的拡大の明確な記載はないが、subclade Kの動向と重症化傾向を継続監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高烧一周不退 元凶竟是鹦鹉-新闻中心-北方网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A week-long fever that wouldn’t subside: the culprit turned out to be a parrot - News Center - Beifang Net
article.articleSummary: One-week fever in a 43-year-old fitness trainer in China was caused by psittacosis (Chlamydia psittaci) pneumonia after contact with an online-purchased parrot. The patient presented with fever up to 39.7°C, fatigue, poor appetite; initial cephalosporin therapy failed, with new rash, diarrhea and dizziness. Chest imaging showed large consolidation in the left lower lobe. Conventional antibiotics failed to improve symptoms, prompting bronchoscopy which found abundant mucopurulent secretions; microbiology detected Chlamydia psittaci. Exposure history confirmed parrot purchase. Psittacosis, a zoonotic respiratory infection, is transmitted via aerosols from infected birds. After switching to anti-Chlamydia antibiotics, fever normalized by day 2; discharge after 15 days. CT later showed >60% resolution, with complete clearance documented by 2026-09-30. Red Bridge Hospital staff urged safe bird-keeping and protective measures when cleaning cages, and to reveal animal exposure if pneumonia with fever persists despite standard therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 高熱が1週間下がらず、原因は飼っていたオウムだった
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の鳥類由来オウム病で、適切な治療により軽快・治癒しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や流行の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の報告なし。ペットの鳥からの感染として既知の人獣共通感染症であり、個別の医療啓発記事に近い内容。

article.articleHeadline: 泉州：一男子常用自来水洗鼻，感染"食脑虫"，差点丧命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quanzhou: A man who regularly rinsed his nose with tap water was infected with the brain-eating amoeba and nearly died.
article.articleSummary: Quanzhou, Fujian Province, China reports two primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) cases caused by Naegleria fowleri linked to nasal rinsing with tap water and outdoor water exposure. Case 1: Wu, 42, who routinely used tap water to rinse his nose, developed fever up to 39°C, severe headache, vomiting, then coma with multi‑organ failure, septic shock, ARDS, and renal failure requiring bedside dialysis in early August. ICU care stabilized his vital signs; laboratory confirmation identified nasal-origin PAM due to N. fowleri. Case 2: Hong sustained a skin abrasion in unknown water and later presented with fever, headache, and vomiting. The report emphasizes a high mortality rate (about 97–98%) for PAM, stressing that warm freshwater and inadequately treated water harbor the amoeba. Preventive measures include using sterile saline, distilled or boiled water for nasal rinsing, avoiding head immersion in unknown waters, wearing protective nasal devices, and seeking prompt medical care with water-exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 泉州：水道水で鼻をすすいだ男性が「脳を食う虫」(フォーラーネグレリア)に感染し、死にかけた
triage.triage_reason: フォーラーネグレリアによる原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎の個別症例報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染がなく、公衆衛生上の拡大リスクは低いため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: フォーラーネグレリアは水系環境中に存在する病原体で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。致死率は高いが個別の環境曝露によるもので、公衆衛生対応としては予防啓発（水道水での鼻洗浄を避ける等）が中心。アウトブレイクやクラスター化の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Meningkat, Wamenkes: Tak Berbahaya Bisa Sembuh Sendiri : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases on the rise, Deputy Health Minister: Not dangerous, can recover on their own: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: September 30, 2026, JAKARTA — Indonesian Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono states Influenza A is not dangerous and is self-limiting, typically resolving without special treatment. Speaking at Kantor Bakom RI, Jakarta, he confirms no deaths have been recorded due to Influenza A and that cases resemble an ordinary flu. He notes the A strain is new but not harmful. National and global influenza activity reportedly follows a seasonal pattern, rising before the rainy season and decreasing in February–March, with no significant uptick to fear. He warns against sensationalized coverage and emphasizes that the situation aligns with expected seasonal trends rather than a dangerous outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型の症例が増加、保健副大臣「危険ではなく自然に治る」:Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 当局がインフルエンザAは危険ではなく季節性のパターンに沿ったものであり死亡例もないと明言しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 当局は季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と説明しており、報道の過熱を牽制している。感染症危機シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Curso avalia ações contra a prevalência de enterobacteriaceae no abatedouro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Course evaluates actions against the prevalence of Enterobacteriaceae in the slaughterhouse.
article.articleSummary: Online six-hour course from Agroqualità and Instituto Innovare Plus (November 10–12, 2026) titled Enterobacteriaceae in the Slaughterhouse: what MAPA is evaluating, addressing current requirements and changes introduced by Portaria SDA/MAPA n. 1.273/2025 in Brazilian slaughterhouses. Targets QA, QC, laboratory personnel, production, veterinarians, consultants, and Serviço de Inspeção staff. Enterobacteriaceae, including Salmonella, are presented as a hygienic-sanitary indicator with quantification guiding corrective actions, not merely presence/absence. The program emphasizes unit-level risk analysis, regulatory demonstration of process control, and robust sampling plans: collection points, timing, identification, traceability, preservation, transport, and suitable analytical methods. It highlights translating lab numbers into process intelligence, illustrating how results should be interpreted in the context of the entire abattoir process, avoiding misinterpretations and focusing on what the results reveal about the production line.

article.articleHeadline: Belum ditemukan kasus Influenza di Lombok Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No influenza cases detected yet in East Lombok
article.articleSummary: East Lombok (Lombok Timur) in Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB) has not detected any positive cases of 'super influenza' to date, according to the Lombok Timur Health Office. Officials urge residents to maintain clean living habits (PHBS) to prevent influenza, noting viruses including influenza can be fought by a strengthened immune system through hygiene, adequate rest, and nutritious meals. People with cough, fever, runny nose, or dizziness are advised to seek care at puskesmas or other health facilities promptly. The health office has ordered puskesmas to intensify preventive education and for health workers to be ready to provide care. While influenza cases rose in 2025, all those cases were managed at puskesmas, with inpatient services at selected facilities increasing but still under control; referrals would be made if capacity limits are reached.

triage.headline_ja: 東ロンボクではまだインフルエンザ症例は確認されていない
triage.triage_reason: 記事は東ロンボクで『スーパーインフルエンザ』の症例が確認されていないことを伝える予防啓発の内容であり、実際の異常な感染拡大や重症例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は『症例未確認』という否定的内容であり、実際の発生事例ではないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。保健当局による予防的注意喚起の範疇。

article.articleHeadline: 531 Kasus Ditemukan, Dinkes Kabupaten Bekasi Tepis Kusta Penyakit Kutukan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 531 Cases Found, Bekasi Regency Health Office Denies Leprosy as a Curse Disease
article.articleSummary: Bekasi Regency DHO reports 531 cumulative leprosy cases, with 259 new detections, driven by active community tracing across villages. In this urban, mobile district, cross-district movement is suspected to fuel transmission; Danau Indah-Cikarang Barat, Cibarusah, and Setu host the highest case counts. Four strategic pillars: (1) exhaustive case finding and contact tracing to uncover hidden infections; (2) free, uninterrupted six-month multidrug therapy until cure; (3) chemoprophylaxis for close contacts; (4) early treatment to prevent nerve damage and disability. Stigma remains a major barrier, despite messages that leprosy is curable and not a curse. Poor sanitation and damp housing may aid spread. A cross-sector initiative, Desa Siaga Kusta in Danau Indah, engages camats, village heads, and health workers to educate that leprosy is an infectious disease like flu and fully curable. Suspected lesions (white patches with numbness) should seek evaluation at Posyandu cadres, Puskesmas, or dermatology-equipped hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: 531件確認、ブカシ県保健局がハンセン病は呪いの病気ではないと否定
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病はインドネシアの既知の風土病であり、地域保健局による通常の症例発見・啓発活動の報告であって、急性公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブカシ県（インドネシア）における既存の地域保健プログラムの活動報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。対象国リストにIndonesiaは含まれるが、本件は風土病の通常報告でありピックアップ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 96 Hewan Sudah Divaksin, Karantina Sumsel Kejar Target Bebas Rabies 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 96 Animals Vaccinated, South Sumatra Quarantine Seeks Rabies-Free Status by 2030.
article.articleSummary: 96 pets vaccinated against rabies in Palembang, South Sumatra, as part of a drive by the Balai Karantina Hewan, Ikan, dan Tumbuhan (Quarantine Office). The campaign on September 28–29, 2026 vaccinated 24 dogs and 72 cats, using 200 doses with two more days of service planned. The effort supports Palembang and Sumatra Selatan’s goal to become rabies-free by 2030. Head of the South Sumatra Quarantine, Sri Endah Ekandari, said the vaccination campaign also commemorates World Rabies Day, Indonesia’s 149th Quarantine Day, and the agency’s third anniversary. In addition to vaccination, attendees receive education on animal health and free consultations with a veterinarian, reinforcing vaccine importance and strategies to reduce rabies transmission from animals to humans.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS appelle à renforcer l'accès à l'oxygène et aux soins en RDC [Matin Infos] https://www.matininfos.net/ebola-loms-appelle-a-renforcer-lacces-a-loxygene-et-aux-soins-en-rdc/90513/
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO calls to strengthen access to oxygen and care in the DRC [Matin Infos]
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, the article's headline addresses Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and a World Health Organization call to strengthen access to oxygen and essential care. The body text provided, however, is a standard disclaimer from Africain.info explaining that it aggregates articles from independent African journals and that opinions belong to the authors, not the portal, with readers urged to consult the original journals for content disputes. The excerpt offers no outbreak statistics, dates, case or death counts, or laboratory details. Consequently, the piece functions as a portal notice rather than a full report, albeit the headline signals ongoing Ebola-related concerns in the DRC and a described emphasis on improving oxygen supply and clinical care as part of the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOがコンゴ民主共和国での酸素供給とケアの強化を呼びかけ[Matin Infos]
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)Annex2で即時通知対象となる疾患であり、WHOがコンゴ民主共和国での医療支援強化を呼びかけている事実から、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念および国際的拡大リスクが示唆されるため。
triage.notes: 記事本文は実質的にポータルの定型免責事項のみで、症例数・死亡者数・発生日などの具体的データは含まれていない。WHOの声明内容（酸素供給・ケア強化の呼びかけ）からエボラ流行が継続中であることが示唆されるため、続報の確認とフルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza Meningkat, Jabar Masuk 3 Besar, Kemenkes Ungkap Kondisi di Rumah Sakit Bandung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases on the rise, West Java among the top three, Health Ministry reveals conditions at Bandung hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases in Indonesia are rising, with West Java among the top three provinces. As of week 38 in 2026, the Health Ministry says the increase follows a seasonal pattern and has not reached extraordinary levels; Jakarta, West Java, and Banten report the highest case counts and positive rates. Surveillance shows influenza A H1N1 pdm09 remains the most dominant subtype; the so‑called 'superflu' term is non‑official and refers to influenza A H3N2 subclade K, which decreased this year. In 2025, H3N2 subclade K had 166 cases; by week 16 of 2026 there were 22 cases, with no detections after week 16 through week 38. No evidence yet of higher severity. In Bandung, hospital monitoring at Bandung Kiwari Hospital and Hasan Sadikin Hospital shows emergency department occupancy within normal limits.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ症例が増加、西ジャワ州が上位3位に、保健省がバンドン市内病院の状況を発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性パターン内の増加であり、保健省も「異常なレベルには達していない」と明言。重症化や医療逼迫の証拠もなく、既知の季節性インフルエンザの範囲内と評価される。
triage.notes: いわゆる「スーパーフル」という用語は非公式であり、H3N2亜系統Kを指すが、2026年は前年より症例数が減少（2025年166例→2026年週16時点で22例、以降検出なし）。重症度上昇の証拠なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Mataram mengimbau warga waspada penyebaran influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mataram Health Office Urges Residents to Be Vigilant Against the Spread of Influenza A
article.articleSummary: Influenza A prompts vigilance in Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. Data from Kemenkes as of 12 September show influenza positivity at 38% in week 35, up from 22% a week earlier. Of 175 specimens tested, 66 were positive for influenza, with influenza A predominating; 33% of detections involve children aged 0–4 years. No separate influenza A tally was kept, but acute respiratory infection (ARI) cases rose 46% during the prolonged dry season, driven by extreme heat, dust, and drought under El Niño. Officials note influenza A is not COVID-19 and tends to be localized rather than pandemic. Symptoms can be heavier and last up to two weeks: high fever, prolonged cough, sore throat, congestion, fatigue, headache, myalgia, and shortness of breath in severe cases. Prevention emphasizes immune-strengthening through nutrition, regular exercise, adequate sleep, frequent handwashing, avoiding close contact with the sick, and staying hydrated.

triage.headline_ja: マタラム保健局、インフルエンザAの拡散に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの陽性率上昇が報告されているが、重篤例や異常な拡大の明確な証拠はなく、地域限定的な注意喚起にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 陽性率上昇（22%→38%）と小児感染の増加が報告されているが、重症度や死亡例についての具体的データはなく、地元当局は季節性変動・乾季要因（El Niño）によるものとしている。パンデミックではなく局地的流行との認識が当局から示されている。

article.articleHeadline: 简易四针法、5针法与2-1-1法：狂犬病暴露后免疫程序优化与全程接种管理
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four-Injection Regimen, Five-Injection Regimen, and the 2-1-1 Regimen: Optimization of Post-Exposure Rabies Immunization Protocol and Full-Wcourse Vaccination Management.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in China remains a fatal public-health challenge. From January–August 2026, nationwide cases reached 215 with 203 deaths, a marked increase vs 2025. Rabies virus damages the central nervous system; case fatality is nearly 100% and there is no proven cure after onset. Prompt, full post-exposure vaccination is essential. China currently approves three post-exposure schedules: Essen five-dose (0,3,7,14,28); Zagreb 2-1-1 (two injections on day 0, then day 7 and 21); and a simplified four-dose (1-1-1-1) program (0,3,7, plus a fourth dose between days 14–28). As of August 2026, a lyophilized Vero cell rabies vaccine for the simplified regimen has been approved. A 2026 randomized trial in Vaccine (n=2000, ages 10–60) showed 100% seropositivity after the first dose by day 14 and >97% at six months for both four- and five-dose regimens. The three regimens coexist to improve access; clinicians should ensure full completion and not delay treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 簡易4回法・5回法・2-1-1法：狂犬病曝露後免疫プログラムの最適化と全過程接種管理
triage.triage_reason: 中国における狂犬病は従来からの風土病であり、本記事はワクチン接種レジメンの最適化に関する医学解説記事である。新規・異常なアウトブレイクを示すものではなく、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクもない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病曝露後の予防接種プロトコル（Essen法、Zagreb法、簡易4回法）に関する医学教育的解説が主眼。2026年1-8月の症例数・死亡者数増加の統計は含まれるが、狂犬病は中国で既知の風土病でありヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചപ്പനി; പ്രതിരോധ പ്രവർത്തനങ്ങളിലെ പോരായ്മകളിൽ അതൃപ്തി അറിയിച്ച് ആരോഗ്യമന്ത്രി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Smallpox; Health Minister expresses dissatisfaction with deficiencies in immunization activities.
article.articleSummary: Thiruvananthapuram: Health Minister K. Muraleedharan expresses dissatisfaction with deficiencies in smallpox immunization activities, asking district medical officers to explain district-level efforts. He notes that field-level activities are not taking place in Thiruvananthapuram and demands a detailed briefing from the DMO; health workers must ensure home visits. Noting rising fever cases, the state reports ongoing influenza activity: this month, 20 deaths and 2,349 infections, with yesterday recording 98 new cases. This month the influenza patient count has risen to 251. The year-to-date totals reach 11,021 infections and 119 deaths. Last September recorded 4 deaths and 724 infections. Last year influenza totals were 6,182 cases and 40 deaths, making this year’s influenza deaths more than double. The minister urged seriousness in controlling the outbreak and not to downplay its spread.

triage.headline_ja: 伝染性発熱；予防対策の不備に保健大臣が不満を表明
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でインフルエンザ（発熱性疾患）による死亡者数が前年の2倍以上に増加しており、保健大臣が予防活動の不備に強い懸念を表明していることから、WPRO基準の複数該当および行政的関心の高まりが確認されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 疾患タグに『Smallpox（天然痘）』とあるが、マラヤーラム語原文『പകർച്ചപ്പനി』は『伝染性発熱』を意味し、記事内容はインフルエンザ（H1N1等季節性）に関するものと考えられる。天然痘は根絶済みであり、Bluedotの自動分類誤りの可能性が高い。今年のインフルエンザ死亡者数（119人）は昨年（40人）の2倍以上であり、州保健当局への注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Người bị đái tháo đường, thận mạn tăng nguy cơ mắc các bệnh nhiễm trùng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People with diabetes and chronic kidney disease have an increased risk of infections
article.articleSummary: Two-thirds of people aged 60 and older in Vietnam have underlying diseases, with over half having multiple chronic conditions. At the 20th National Congress of the Vietnamese Association of Urology and Nephrology in Ninh Bình (Sept 2026), experts note that diabetes and chronic kidney disease weaken immunity and raise infection risk. In diabetics, respiratory infections and pneumonia are more common; herpes zoster risk increases by about 38%, and RSV infections can be more severe in the elderly. CKD raises herpes zoster risk by 29% and elevates RSV risk and progression to severe disease. The American Diabetes Association recommends vaccination as part of diabetes care, and KDIGO 2024 treats vaccination as an active intervention for CKD. Vietnam’s August 2026 CKD vaccination guideline and MOH’s July 1, 2026 decision authorize vaccination against hepatitis B, HPV, RSV, influenza, pneumococcus, and herpes zoster. By 2030, about 18 million Vietnamese will be 60+, up nearly 4 million since 2024, underscoring preventive care and integrated management.

triage.headline_ja: 糖尿病・慢性腎臓病患者は感染症リスクが増加
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、慢性疾患患者における感染リスクとワクチン接種推奨に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクイベントではなく、基礎疾患患者への予防接種推奨に関する医学会議報告であるため、感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota Yogyakarta Catat 73 Kasus Positif Campak, Imunisasi Digencarkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yogyakarta City Health Office Records 73 Measles-Positive Cases, Immunization Intensified.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak response intensified in Yogyakarta City, Indonesia, after laboratory confirmation of 73 measles cases from 372 suspected infections between January and September 2026. Despite localized increases, the overall trend shows declines in both suspected and positive cases. The City Health Office (Dinkes Kota Yogyakarta) has deployed Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) to rapidly interrupt transmission, administering vaccines regardless of prior immunization history. ORI activities have targeted areas including Kotagede, where a case was identified in a kindergarten. City-wide measles immunization coverage stands at 96.64%, but several kelurahan remain below 95% and are monitored to prevent new transmission pockets. No specific infection source is detailed in the report. Data reflect status as of September 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ市保健局、麻疹陽性73例を記録、予防接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は既知の疾患で地域的な対応（ORI）が進行中、全体傾向は減少傾向にあるため緊急性は低いが、一部地域でワクチン接種率が95%未満で感染拡大の可能性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 地域の保健当局が既に予防接種強化（ORI）で対応中。一部地域でワクチン接種率が95%未満のため新たな感染クラスター発生の可能性に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Meski Kasus DBD di Ciamis Menurun Signifikan Sepanjang Januari-Agustus 2026, 5 Orang Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Although dengue fever cases in Ciamis declined significantly throughout January–August 2026, five people have died.
article.articleSummary: West Java's Ciamis Regency reports 322 dengue fever (DBD) cases and five deaths from January–August 2026, despite a notable decline versus the previous year. The monthly pattern peak occurred in April (51 cases) with a gradual fall to 12 cases in August. Most infections affect children and adolescents, with 164 male and 147 female cases. The Health Office warns that fatalities persist even as incidence drops, indicating ongoing transmission risk from Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. Preventive measures emphasized include the One House One Jumantik (G1R1J) program to appoint at least one household member as larvae monitor, and intensified vector control via 3M Plus—drain, close, and recycle—across the district. Authorities highlight sustaining G1R1J and PSN efforts to curb transmission and reduce future deaths.

triage.headline_ja: チアミスのDBD（デング熱）症例は2026年1月〜8月にかけて大幅に減少したが、5名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアの地方都市で例年発生する地域流行であり、症例数も減少傾向にあるため国際的な異常事態とは言えないが、死亡例の継続は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの季節性デング熱の年次報告であり、症例数は前年より減少。死亡例の継続はあるが、地域の保健当局が既存の対策（G1R1J、3M Plus）で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Beni : l'ICCN confirme le charbon bactéridien chez les hippopotames morts dans la rivière Semuliki | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Beni: ICCN confirms anthrax in hippopotamuses that died in the Semuliki River | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Anthrax has been confirmed as the cause of death for several hippopotamuses found in the Semuliki River in Virunga National Park, Nord-Kivu, DR Congo. Analyses by Virunga Doctors with the Institut Congolais pour la Conservation de la Nature (ICCN) confirmed the disease, in an ICCN communiqué issued Sept 29, 2026, after a Sept 24 alert. A response protocol is in place to contain the outbreak. Anthrax can transmit to humans via contact with a dead or sick animal or through consuming its meat. Residents are urged to refrain from touching, moving, cutting, burying or burning carcasses, and not to eat, buy, sell or transport meat from dead or sick animals; keep children, livestock and pets away from carcasses; avoid water near affected zones. Report new carcasses or unusual mortalities to authorities, veterinary services, community relays, or ICCN; seek care if symptoms appear after exposure. Ongoing monitoring with forthcoming directives.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：ICCNがセムリキ川で死亡したカバの炭疽菌感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（カバ）における炭疽感染が確認され、ヒトへの感染リスクが注意喚起されているが、現時点でヒト感染例の報告はなく情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 炭疽は自然環境中に芽胞として残存するため長期曝露リスクがあり、動物死体との接触を介したヒトへの感染可能性が指摘されている。現時点でヒト感染の確認報告はなく、ICCNによる対応プロトコルが進行中。続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: 北市民族國小9名學生腸胃不適！教育局確認中央廚房另供三校　小卷來源與通報時間待釐清
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 9 students at Taipei City's Minzu Elementary School with gastrointestinal discomfort! Education Bureau confirms central kitchen also supplied three other schools; source of the squid and notification time to be clarified.
article.articleSummary: Nine students at Minzu Elementary School in Taipei's Songshan District reported gastrointestinal discomfort after lunch on Sept 24, including vomiting and abdominal symptoms. The Taipei Education Bureau confirmed the central kitchen serves four schools, with the same squid supplier as Jin Hua Junior High cited, though whether the same batch was used is unconfirmed. The other three schools have not reported similar symptoms. The bureau conducted notification on Sept 25, collected samples, and carried out epidemiological surveys and site inspections. Some affected students are vegetarians; preliminary assessments suggest gastroenteritis, with influenza or norovirus also possible. Authorities are reviewing procurement, inspection, and distribution records to determine the source and batch. No confirmed cause yet; details on notification timing, sampling, specimen types, and cross-school scope are to be disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 北市民族國小9名學生腸胃不適！教育局確認中央廚房另供三校　小卷來源與通報時間待釐清
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の一校における9名の軽度な胃腸症状事例であり、他校への拡大は確認されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国リストに含まれない）の小学校における食中毒疑い事例。原因は未確定だが、ノロウイルスやインフルエンザは確定診断ではなく可能性として言及されているのみ。影響範囲は限定的で9名のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - September 30, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tops 8,000 confirmed cases, with about 7,900 cases and 3,800 deaths reported as the virus spreads to new zones in South Ubangi and Haut-Uele; North Kivu shows a 73% surge over three weeks, straining an already short-staffed treatment network. Africa CDC warns only about 30,000 Ebola contacts have been identified vs an estimated 400,000; the outbreak is described as the fastest-growing in Africa by sources including Reuters. In the United States, the CDC’s 25 September 2026 trend snapshot shows 14 states with rising infections, 5 declining, 18 unchanged; the COVID wastewater benchmark has been raised, reclassifying some levels as moderate. FDA approved updated COVID vaccines; the CDC opened states to order free vaccines for vulnerable children. Older adults hospitalized with COVID face higher stroke risk; vaccination remains protective. More than 1 in 10 US healthcare workers report ongoing long‑COVID. Canada extends Ebola-related travel restrictions for 60 days.

triage.headline_ja: バルーン・ジュース - 感染症・パンデミック最新情報 - 2026年9月30日
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8000例・3800人死亡を超え、アフリカで最速拡大との報告があり、接触者追跡の大幅な不足とカナダによる渡航制限延長など国際的対応も見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク拡大とカナダ・米国での対応（渡航制限延長、COVID動向）を扱う複合記事。米国・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。COVID-19関連情報は主に米国内の疫学動向であり、DRCのエボラが主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: PGI Chandigarh Sees Sharp Rise in Flu Cases Amid Weather Change, 50% Recorded in August
article.articleSummary: Between January 1 and August 26, 2026, PGI Chandigarh reported 170 positive cases of swine flu, H3N2, and Influenza-B, with nearly 50% in August. Of these, 83 men and 87 women; 36 children under 14; 134 adults. Punjab recorded the most cases (68), followed by Haryana (34), Chandigarh (28), Himachal Pradesh (20), Uttar Pradesh (10), and other places (10). This indicates a substantial pediatric share and near-equal gender distribution among infected individuals, reflecting ongoing influenza activity across northern states during seasonal weather changes. The report focuses on PGI Chandigarh, highlighting influenza activity in Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh and neighboring states, with August driving the surge as weather shifts.

triage.headline_ja: PGIチャンディーガル、気候変動の中でインフルエンザ症例が急増、8月だけで50%を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（豚インフルエンザ、H3N2、インフルエンザB）の症例増加が報告されているが、重症度や異常性を示す情報が不足しており、通常の季節的変動の範囲内とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インド北部（パンジャブ、ハリヤナ、チャンディーガル、ヒマーチャル・プラデーシュ、ウッタル・プラデーシュ）での季節性インフルエンザ（豚インフルエンザ、H3N2、インフルエンザB）の症例報告。重症度（入院率・死亡率）に関する情報がなく、季節性の変動範囲内と考えられる。小児の感染割合が高い点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Beni : l'ICCN confirme le charbon bactéridien chez les hippopotames morts dans la rivière Semuliki et appelle la population riveraine à maintenir les mesures de précaution | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Beni: ICCN confirms anthrax in hippopotamuses that died in the Semuliki River and calls the riverine population to maintain precautionary measures | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Anthrax confirmed in hippopotamuses found in the Semuliki River, within Virunga National Park, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. Joint analyses by Virunga Doctors veterinarians and the Institut congolais pour la conservation de la nature (ICCN) established that several hippos died due to Bacillus anthracis infection. The confirmation followed an initial Sept 24 ICCN alert urging riverine communities to stay vigilant; a Sept 29 provincial ICCN communiqué formalized the finding and activated a response protocol to contain the situation. Anthrax can transmit to humans via contact with dead or sick animals or by consuming their meat, so residents are urged to avoid touching, moving, cutting, burying, or burning carcasses, and to refrain from consuming, buying, selling, or transporting meat from affected animals. Report new carcasses or unusual mortalities and seek medical care if symptoms arise after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:ICCNがセムリキ川で死亡したカバの炭疽菌感染を確認、流域住民に予防措置の維持を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ヴィルンガ国立公園でカバの炭疽菌感染による大量死が確認され、人獣共通感染症としてヒトへの感染リスクがあり、当局が予防措置を呼びかけるなど行政関心が高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒトの感染例は報告されていないが、死骸や食肉を介した曝露リスクが継続しており、ICCNが対応プロトコルを発動している。続報でヒト症例の有無・規模を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 8 Warga Positif Influenza A di Tangsel, Dinkes Ungkap Gejalanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8 Residents Test Positive for Influenza A in South Tangerang, Health Office Reveals Their Symptoms
article.articleSummary: Influenza A detection in South Tangerang City, Indonesia, with eight confirmed cases reported between Aug 19 and Sep 15, 2026, after evaluations at Serpong 1 Health Center. All samples analyzed at the Jakarta Public Health Laboratory and recorded in the New All Record sentinel system from mid-August to mid-September 2026. Cases: 1 on Aug 19; 3 on Sep 1; 2 on Sep 14; 2 on Sep 15. All patients exhibited Influenza Like Illness symptoms: fever ≥38°C, cough, runny nose, sore throat. Health authorities tightened surveillance across primary care facilities to monitor for potential outbreak and transmission, which occurs via respiratory droplets. Officials urge symptomatic individuals to seek care at nearby health centers promptly, especially high-risk groups: children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic conditions, while avoiding panic.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン市で8人がインフルエンザA陽性、保健局が症状を公表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常のサーベイランス報告で、重症例や異常な拡大の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の保健当局によるルーチンのサーベイランス強化が報告されているのみで、季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の事例と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: People living with chronic kidney disease and diabetes should be aware of infectious disease risks
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, at a VUNA conference on Sept 29, GSK Vietnam outlined infectious-disease risks for older adults with diabetes and chronic kidney disease (CKD) and urged preventive vaccination. By 2030, Vietnam’s population aged 60+ will approach 18 million, with roughly two-thirds harboring underlying conditions and over half with multiple. Diabetes weakens immunity, elevating risks of respiratory infections, pneumonia, shingles (38% higher), and severe RSV in older adults. CKD raises shingles risk by 29% and compounds RSV risk and severity. The American Diabetes Association recommends vaccination as part of diabetes care; KDIGO 2024 endorses an immunisation programme for CKD. Vietnam’s VUNA 2026 vaccination recommendations for CKD align with these guidelines. Vo Tam notes integration of risk assessment and vaccination history into long-term follow-up. MOH Decision No.1983/QD-BYT (July) supports vaccination against hepatitis B, HPV, RSV, influenza, pneumococcal disease, shingles to control risk factors in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 慢性腎臓病と糖尿病を持つ人々は感染症リスクに注意すべき
triage.triage_reason: これはワクチン接種啓発に関する会議報告であり、実際の疾病アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクではなく、基礎疾患を持つ高齢者への予防接種推奨に関する会議内容の報告である。感染症イベントのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Sleman Gelar Vaksinasi Rabies Gratis Peringati Hari Rabies Internasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sleman Regency Government Holds Free Rabies Vaccination to Commemorate World Rabies Day.
article.articleSummary: On September 30, 2026, Sleman Regency in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia, held a free rabies vaccination for pets at the DP3 premises to mark World Rabies Day. The event, part of Rabies Vaccination Week, aims to preserve DIY’s rabies-free status. Organizers report 340 pet owners registered, vaccinating 340 animals (cats and dogs). Deputy Regent Danang Maharsa stressed that vaccination carries broader public-health, animal-welfare, environmental, and social responsibilities, urging a shift in pet ownership norms. He cautioned that mobility of pets from outside the region poses a risk to rabies control even in a rabies-free area and called for sustained herd immunity via surveillance and periodic vaccination. The One Health approach underpins these efforts, integrating human, animal, and environmental health. The program, led by DP3 via UPTD Veterinary Health Service, also included education, recreation, a cat contest, a fashion show, and children’s activities.

triage.headline_ja: スレマン県政府、世界狂犬病デーを記念して無料狂犬病ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デー記念の予防啓発イベントであり、狂犬病流行や症例報告ではない。公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病の発生・流行を報じたものではなく、予防接種啓発イベントの告知記事であるため、対象国リストへの発生地域登録は不要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 부러진 뼈 빨리 붙으라고"... '이것' 짓이겨 마신 40대男, 폐흡충증 진단
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man in his 40s diagnosed with paragonimiasis after crushing and drinking "this" to speed up healing of a broken bone.
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary paragonimiasis diagnosed in a Chinese man after ingesting raw freshwater crab to speed healing of a rib fracture. A truck driver from Runhuaishi, Guizhou Province, crushed and drank raw freshwater crab and some was applied to his chest. In May, routine health screening showed pleural effusion and marked eosinophilia (39%). Sichuan Province CDC referred him to its parasitology clinic, confirming paragonimiasis caused by lung fluke larvae migrating from the gut to the lungs. Early symptoms can include abdominal pain or diarrhea; later, cough, chest pain, fever, and often blood-tinged sputum that may resemble tuberculosis. Praziquantel is used for treatment. Prevention requires fully cooking freshwater crabs/crayfish, as alcohol or salt methods are ineffective; even drinking valley water contaminated with larvae can cause infection. This report highlights a single case linked to folk remedies and raw shellfish consumption in China (as of 2026-09-30).

triage.headline_ja: 「骨折が早く治るように」...『これ』を潰して飲んだ40代男性、肺吸虫症と診断
triage.triage_reason: 個人の民間療法（生の淡水カニ摂取）による単発の肺吸虫症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性もなく公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 寄生虫症（肺吸虫症）は食品由来の個別症例で、結核との鑑別が話題の中心。感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza Naik, Kemenkes Ingatkan Warga Jangan Borong Oseltamivir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases rise, Health Ministry reminds the public not to hoard Oseltamivir.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Ministry warns against panic buying Oseltamivir as influenza activity rises since September 2026. Oseltamivir should not be used en masse or as a preventive without medical evaluation; prescriptions are based on physician judgment, especially for hospitalized patients with severe influenza. Most influenza infections resolve on their own, so antivirals are not needed for all cases. The government notes a seasonal upsurge similar to other ASEAN countries, including Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Thailand. Current surveillance shows influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 as the dominant circulating strain in Indonesia. The term 'super flu' is not in WHO or Kemenkes nomenclature; it locally refers to influenza A(H3N2) subclade K, though cases of that variant have declined. Conference remarks were delivered in Jakarta on September 28, 2026 by Lucia Rizka Andalucia, Director General of Pharmacy and Medical Devices, and by acting Director General Andi Saguni.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ症例増加、保健省がオセルタミビルの買い占めをしないよう国民に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09主体）の増加であり、ASEAN地域全体での季節的上昇と説明されているが、流行動向や医薬品供給への影響があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア国内のインフルエンザ季節性流行とオセルタミビルの買い占め防止に関する保健省の注意喚起が主題。シンガポール・マレーシア・フィリピン・タイは比較対象として言及されているのみで、各国での発生事実が記述されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Camarines Sur placed under state of calamity due to alarming increase in dengue cases
article.articleSummary: As of Sep 24, 2026, the province of Camarines Sur reports 1,233 confirmed dengue cases and 18 deaths, prompting a state of calamity approved by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (Resolution No. 286, Series of 2026). The declaration cites a sharp rise in morbidity and mortality that threatens public safety and overwhelms local health resources, calling for immediate, comprehensive containment interventions. The provincial government urges all local government units, barangay officials, rural health units, hospitals, schools, and community organizations to participate in dengue prevention and control activities. Residents are advised to practice the 4Ts against dengue: Taob, Takip, Tuyo, at Tapon, and to seek medical attention promptly if dengue signs appear. The move signals heightened public health response and coordinated measures across municipalities and component cities.

triage.headline_ja: カマリネス・スル州、デング熱症例の急増により非常事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性の2項目に該当し、州レベルで非常事態宣言が出されるなど公式対応が取られているためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節性に発生する風土病だが、1,233症例・18死亡という急増を受けて州が非常事態を宣言しており、地域の公衆衛生体制への深刻な負荷が示唆される。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera deaths rise 30% in 2025, Seven countries account for 91% of deaths
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths rose 30% in 2025 to 7,870, while cases declined to 451,499 across 47 countries, territories, and areas—the highest annual cholera deaths reported to WHO since 1999. Seven countries accounted for 89% of cases and 91% of deaths: Yemen (93,463 cases; 246 deaths), South Sudan (79,480; 1,258), Sudan (73,597; 2,161), DR Congo (71,168; 2,071), Angola (36,341; 895), Nigeria (24,354; 548), and Bangladesh (22,709; 0). All seven faced conflict- or disaster-related internal displacement; Angola was the only country to exceed 10,000 cases in 2025 after none in 2024. Africa registered 245,501 cases and 5,338 deaths from 22 countries (up 34% and 58% vs 2024). Eastern Mediterranean reported 176,654/2,438. Ten 2024-reporting countries had zero in 2025, led by Comoros (10,692 in 2024), then Iraq (596), Liberia (340), Togo (281), Syrian Arab Republic (169). In total, 81 countries submitted zero reports for 2025, up from 58 in 2024; data from 77 countries were not received.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年、コレラによる死者数が30%増加、死亡者の91%を7カ国が占める
triage.triage_reason: 世界的なコレラ流行で2025年の死者数が1999年以来最多となり、紛争・災害による人口移動を背景に複数国で感染拡大が継続しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOへの報告に基づく世界全体のコレラ動向報告であり、対象国の中で明確に数値が示されているのはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみ。他の対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）は言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Potensi Penularan Influenza A Cepat, Dinkes Tangsel Minta Warga Perketat Prokes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Potential Rapid Transmission of Influenza A, South Tangerang Health Office Urges Residents to Tighten Health Protocols
article.articleSummary: Influenza A poses rapid transmission risk in South Tangerang City (Tangsel), Indonesia, prompting the local Health Office to tighten daily health protocols, including vaccination, mask use, cough etiquette, isolation, hygiene, and indoor ventilation. Eight residents were confirmed positive for Influenza A after visits to Puskesmas Serpong 1, with detections recorded by the sentinel New All Record (NAR) system from August 19 to September 15, 2026. All samples were tested at the Jakarta Public Health Laboratory. Health officials urge residents to seek medical care if symptoms worsen and to rely on official sources for information. The response includes ongoing case monitoring and intensified public education to limit spread amid high mobility, though no hospitalizations or fatalities are detailed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAの急速な感染拡大の可能性、南タンゲラン保健局が住民に健康プロトコル強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の国内発生事例であり、重症例・死亡は報告されていないが、地域当局が注意喚起をしているため継続監視とする。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra mais uma morte por gripe neste ano - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas records another flu death this year - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil reports an influenza-associated SRAG death in 2026: a 92-year-old vaccinated woman who died July 22. Since January, the city recorded 377 SRAG cases and 34 influenza deaths. In 2025, 561 cases and 69 deaths were recorded, with 54 deaths among the unvaccinated. Health authorities urge vaccination, available to anyone 6 months or older at 69 health centers; no appointment needed—bring photo ID and vaccination card if available. The 2026 vaccine protects against influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and B and can be given with other vaccines. Preventive measures include handwashing, ventilation, hydration, a healthy diet, and masking when symptomatic. By Sept 1, Campinas had administered 363,664 flu vaccine doses since March 28: elderly 128,757 (57.6%), children 37,020 (54.2%), pregnant women 7,145 (83.1%). Access expanded to all ages from June 1; details at vacina.campinas.sp.gov.br/vacinas/gripe.
