triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる通常の死亡事例と予防接種キャンペーンの報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1/H3N2/B型）に関する地方自治体の公衆衛生報告で、ワクチン接種推進が主目的。通常の季節性流行の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: India needs to step up its game on rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains India’s top public health threat, with millions of dog bites annually and thousands of deaths; India accounts for about 36% of global rabies deaths, and outcomes are nearly 100% fatal after symptoms appear, especially harming rural children. Bhutan’s WHO-validated elimination of dog-mediated human rabies on Sept 4, 2026, with zero human deaths since June 2023, underscores the effectiveness of ending mass dog shelters and pursuing vaccination and sterilization. In India, debates still emphasize removal and shelters over source-control, though proof of concept exists in mass humane spay/neuter plus vaccination with community engagement (Dehradun, Lucknow, Vadodara) and Goa’s 2017 vaccination model. With ~70 million street dogs, a nationwide one-time vaccination/sterilization drive would cost ~₹8,400 crore/year, while building shelters across 800 districts could cost ~₹1,600 crore upfront plus ongoing care. A unified One Health approach, political will, and sustained vaccination/sterilization are needed until transmission ends.

triage.headline_ja: インドは狂犬病対策を強化する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける狂犬病の慢性的・既知の公衆衛生問題に関する政策論評記事であり、新規の異常発生や突発的イベントではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の既知の流行状況とブータンの撲滅成功例を踏まえた政策提言記事であり、新たな発生・急増を報告するものではない。ブータンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Người mắc bệnh thận mạn, đái tháo đường cần lưu ý nguy cơ bệnh truyền nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People with chronic kidney disease and diabetes mellitus should be aware of the risk of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: By 2030, Vietnam is projected to have about 18 million people aged ≥60, with roughly two‑thirds having underlying conditions and over 50% with multimorbidity. At the 20th National Scientific Conference of the Vietnamese Association of Urology–Nephrology, held with GSK Vietnam, experts updated care for chronic patients at risk of infectious diseases and discussed preventive measures. Diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease weaken immunity; diabetics show higher rates of respiratory infections and pneumonia, a 38% higher risk of herpes zoster, and increased risk of severe RSV in older adults; CKD raises herpes zoster risk by about 29% and predisposes to infections and severe acute respiratory infections. Dr. Nguyen Khoa Diep Van emphasizes vaccination as part of an immune shield, as vital as glycemic, blood pressure, and lipid control. KDIGO 2024 CKD guidelines advocate vaccination programs; in Vietnam, VUNA’s August 2026 CKD vaccination guidelines align with this. MOH Decision 1983/QD-BYT (July 1, 2026) supports vaccination against HBV, HPV, RSV, influenza, pneumococcus, and herpes zoster to prevent non-communicable disease risks. Integrated prevention and treatment aim to sustain health and quality of life for older patients with comorbidity.

triage.headline_ja: 慢性腎臓病・糖尿病患者は感染症リスクに注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクを報告する記事ではなく、慢性疾患患者へのワクチン接種推奨に関する医学会議・政策解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定のアウトブレイクイベントではなく、慢性疾患患者向けワクチン接種推奨に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であるため、感染症危機シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance strengthens the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease–driven Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has intensified surveillance to rapidly detect alerts, investigate suspected cases, and monitor contacts across seven provinces and 63 health zones, reporting 7,773 cases and 3,759 deaths (case fatality rate 48.4%) as of 30 Sep 2026. Strengthened surveillance enables rapid isolation and transmission interruption; daily alerts rose from ~10 in May 2026 to ~2,000 currently with 90% verified, and contact tracing improved from <15% to >85%. Community volunteers (680 across 17 health zones by 17 Sep 2026; goal 1,603 by end-Oct) underpin early detection, particularly in Bunia (Ituri). WHO-supported activities include training 36 zone chief medical officers and 36 community agents, plus deployment of ~97 epidemiologists, 22 field coordinators, and 5 provincial coordinators. Challenges remain, including access, limited human resources, and ongoing community reluctance; cross-border vigilance noted in Rwampara and Kabarole areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対応をサーベイランス強化が支える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7province・63保健ゾーンにわたるエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が継続し、致死率48.4%、死者3,759人と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、ウガンダとの国境地帯での警戒も報告されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Rwampara、Kabarole）は国境地帯での警戒対象として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。致死率48.4%・死者3,759人と非常に深刻で、WHOによる大規模な支援（疫学者97名等）が展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Fakta-Fakta Penyakit Pes yang Disebut WHO sedang Kembali Mewabah di 6 Negara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facts About the Plague That WHO Says Is Reemerging in Six Countries
article.articleSummary: Plague (Yersinia pestis), a zoonotic infection historically known as the Black Death, is reemerging, with WHO monitoring six countries facing endemic or active outbreaks as of 2026-09-30. Affected nations include Madagascar; the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Peru; the United States; and cross-border cases in China and Mongolia linked to contact with wild rodents such as marmots. Transmission occurs through flea bites from infected small mammals, direct contact with infected animal tissue, or respiratory droplets in pneumonic plague. Incubation is 1–7 days. Three forms exist: Bubonic Plague (painful, swollen lymph nodes called buboes), Septicemic Plague (fever, chills, abdominal pain, bleeding, possible gangrene), and Pneumonic Plague (rapid respiratory symptoms; highly fatal if untreated; can spread between people). Early antibiotic treatment is effective; prevention emphasizes sanitation and prompt medical care, especially in endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが6カ国で再流行していると指摘するペストに関する事実
triage.triage_reason: WHOがペストの再流行を6カ国で監視中と報じており、肺ペストはヒト-ヒト感染も可能で致死率が高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる複数国（マダガスカル、コンゴ民主共和国、ペルー、米国、中国、モンゴル）でのペスト再流行に関する一般的な解説記事であり、具体的な症例数や発症時期などの詳細は記載されていない。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCと中国のみ（他は対象国リスト外）。続報での具体的な症例情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Konfirmasi Kasus Penyakit Pes di Enam Negara, 423 Kematian Dilaporkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Confirms Plague Cases in Six Countries, 423 Deaths Reported.
article.articleSummary: WHO confirms human plague cases in six countries, with 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths from 2019–2025 (case fatality rate 11%). Of these, six countries reported laboratory-confirmed cases, with the majority in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Madagascar, endemic regions for plague. WHO cautions that the disease could emerge in other nations due to movement of animals carrying vectors, underscoring the need for routine rodent and wildlife surveillance and rapid outbreak response to curb transmission. Plague is caused by Yersinia pestis and is typically transmitted via fleas from rodents; early antibiotic treatment is crucial to reducing fatalities. Gennady Onishchenko of the Russian Academy of Sciences notes plague remains a major global health threat, alongside influenza, acute respiratory infections, coronavirus, exotic fevers, and cholera. The report provides no details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがペスト（黒死病）症例を6カ国で確認、423人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが6カ国でのペスト確認と423人の死亡（CFR11%）を公式発表し、動物媒介者の移動による他国への拡大リスクを警告しているため、国際的関心と公衆衛生上の深刻性からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとマダガスカルが主要発生地域と述べているが、マダガスカルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシアは専門家コメントの発信元であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Le charbon bactéridien, cause de la mort des hippopotames sur la rivière Semuliki (Institut congolais pour la conservation de la nature) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterial anthrax, the cause of the deaths of hippos on the Semuliki River (Congolese Institute for Nature Conservation) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax has been confirmed as the cause of hippo deaths along the Semuliki River in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, following joint analyses by Virunga Doctors veterinarians and the Congolese Institute for Nature Conservation (ICCN). The outbreak centers on the Semuliki stretch of Virunga National Park, with multiple hippo carcasses found in the river. A response protocol is in place. A Sept 24 signal preceded a confirmed Aug 14 case in the Vitshumbi fishing enclave, after an Aug 8 carcass in Kibirizi Health Zone. Human infection risk exists through contact with sick or dead animals or consumption of their meat. Precautions: do not touch or move carcasses; do not consume or transport meat; keep children and livestock away from carcasses; avoid using nearby water. Residents urged to stay calm and vigilant as monitoring continues and directives may follow.

triage.headline_ja: 炭疽菌、セムリキ川沿いのカバ大量死の原因と判明（コンゴ自然保護研究所）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州のヴィルンガ国立公園内セムリキ川でカバの炭疽感染死が確認されたが、人への感染例は現時点で報告されておらず、情報が限定的なため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 人への感染例は未報告だが、死骸との接触や肉の摂取によるズーノーシスリスクが指摘されており、監視体制の継続が必要。ルワンダ（Western Province）は記事の主題ではなく、位置情報の誤りの可能性があるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Trois décès liés au choléra signalés en une semaine à Fizi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three cholera-related deaths reported in one week in Fizi.
article.articleSummary: Cholera confirmed in multiple localities within Fizi Territory, South Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The provincial health division reports three cholera-related deaths between 14 and 20 September 2026 and notes a rise in diarrheal cases in several areas, particularly along the Lake Tanganyika shore. As of 30 September, territory administrator Samy Kalondji reported about a dozen patients. Health authorities urge communities to reinforce hygiene measures to curb transmission, including washing hands with soap before meals, after using the toilet, and after handling food; ensure food is covered and thoroughly cooked before consumption. The report underscores local transmission in lake-edge communities; no details on laboratory confirmation methods or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: フィジ(南キブ州)で1週間にコレラ関連死3名が報告される

article.articleHeadline: मवेशियों को खुरहा-मुंहपका से कैसे बचाएं? एक्सपर्ट ने बताया आसान तरीका
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to protect cattle from foot-and-mouth disease? An expert explains an easy method.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in cattle in Sitamarhi, Bihar, is described as a contagious viral illness causing mouth ulcers and hoof lesions. Infected animals should be promptly isolated from healthy stock to prevent spread. Initial relief can be sought by cleaning the mouth with a solution of alum and water, but reliance on home remedies alone is discouraged; if wounds worsen, veterinary care is essential. The disease can also affect hooves, causing lameness and chewing difficulties; farmers are advised to avoid home treatments that may allow infection to worsen. Infected animals are not vaccinated; treatment is based on symptoms. Recovery may take roughly four days to a week with proper care. Vaccination is emphasized for prevention, particularly for dairy and pregnant animals. Farmers are urged to participate in vaccination programs and contact a veterinarian if symptoms appear; maintain hygiene and separate sick animals.

triage.headline_ja: 牛を口蹄疫から守るには？専門家が簡単な方法を解説
triage.triage_reason: 家畜の口蹄疫に関する一般的な予防・治療啓発記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大の懸念を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（獣医学的助言）に関する地方ローカルニュースであり、ヒト感染症としてのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Nia-Nia : 313 cas confirmés dont 209 décès, 88 guéris - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nia-Nia: 313 confirmed cases including 209 deaths, 88 recovered - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Nia-Nia health zone, Mambasa territory, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 30 September 2026, reports 313 confirmed cases, 209 deaths, and 88 recoveries. Four health areas—Juhudi, Bafwabango, Bafwambaya, and Alimasi—are currently in outbreak, with Juhudi recording the most new cases, followed by Bafwabango. The epidemic curve continues to rise, keeping the situation alarmingly chronic. Persistent community deaths are noted; post-mortem examinations conducted by the Red Cross are consistently positive, signaling ongoing transmission risk at funerals. The information comes from Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, chief of the Nia-Nia health zone. These figures reflect ongoing outbreak status in the Nia-Nia zone. Reported by ACP/NM.

triage.headline_ja: ニア・ニアでのエボラ出血熱：確定症例313例、うち死亡209例、回復88例 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定流行で致死率が高く（209/313）、コミュニティでの死亡・葬儀での感染拡大リスクが継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: エボラは致死率の高い高リスク病原体であり、コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州ニア・ニア地域での継続的な流行と葬儀関連の感染伝播が確認されている。Red Crossによる死後検査の陽性結果は地域社会での継続的な感染を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : 40 jours sans un nouveau cas confirmé à Katwa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: 40 days without a new confirmed case in Katwa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo remains active with hopeful signs in Katwa zone of Butembo. Three health areas—Kihinga, Mizebere, and Muyisa—have each surpassed 40 days without a new confirmed Ebola case (Muyisa 41 days). Katwa’s medical authorities say community adherence has aided containment. In the last 21 days, Katwa recorded 174 confirmed Ebola cases and 69 deaths (case fatality rate 55.6%). Katwa continues to be the epicentre of the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in Nord-Kivu, with 561 confirmed cases and 384 deaths (CFR 68.4%). The Butembo health zone reports 269 confirmed cases, 166 deaths, and 38 recoveries. Ongoing surveillance and public health measures accompany these figures, underscoring limited transmission but persistent outbreak activity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：カトワで新規確認症例なしが40日間続く - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、致死率55~68%と高く、確認症例・死亡者数も多いため、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にブルンジ（Mwaro州）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（北キブ州ブテンボ・カトワ）の状況のみが言及されており、ブルンジでの発生は確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU denuncia el impacto sobre la respuesta al brote de ébola de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN denounces the impact on the response to the Ebola outbreak of....
article.articleSummary: UN agencies condemned recent attacks by unidentified armed groups in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo that have undermined the Ebola response, causing civilian deaths and displacement. In Lubero, North Kivu, two individuals involved in Ebola response and four displaced people were killed on 27–28 September. Around Rhoe camp near Ituri, clashes forced about 3,000 people to flee. Since mid-September, Masisi has seen 24,000+ displaced; violence has also affected South Kivu and Tanganyika, compounding humanitarian needs. OCHA notes that insecurity has halted some movement of aid workers and responders. The Ebola outbreak, declared in mid-May, has reached 8,116 cases and 3,924 deaths across seven provinces, making it the deadliest in DRC history and second globally; projections threaten surpassing 2014–2016 West Africa totals (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths). The UN cites a funding gap: the $2.1 billion plan is only half funded. Calls for safe, sustained, unimpeded access and continued international support.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行への対応に対する武装攻撃の影響を非難
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模（8,116症例、3,924死亡）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、武装勢力による攻撃で対応活動が妨げられ、資金不足も深刻であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: DRCのエボラ流行は2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（28,616症例、11,325死亡）を超える可能性が指摘されており、$21億ドルの対応計画は半分しか資金確保されていない。武装勢力による攻撃で対応者・避難民の死亡や大規模避難（マシシで24,000人超）が発生し、人道アクセスが著しく制限されている。

article.articleHeadline: Projeto da Fiocruz previne transmissão vertical da doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz Project Prevents Vertical Transmission of Chagas Disease
article.articleSummary: Congenital Chagas disease in Brazil, Bolivia, Colombia, and Paraguay: after five years, the Cuida Chagas project led by Fiocruz has completed field activities and moves to data analysis to inform SUS practices. The program targeted care, diagnosis, and treatment of congenital Trypanosoma cruzi infection across 31 municipalities in four countries, screening 81,000 people and confirming over 2,600 cases. Many newborns with the infection show no common signs such as prematurity, low birth weight, or enlarged liver and spleen. It advanced primary health care, implemented active case-finding, trained health professionals, and fostered community leadership. A key diagnostic advance was introducing PCR to detect parasite DNA, enabling treatment within the first months of life. The team emphasizes integrating screening of women of childbearing age, routine care for exposed children, decentralizing sample collection, and linking primary care, surveillance, labs, and specialists. Some municipalities even created local laws to sustain actions after field activities.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスのプロジェクト、シャーガス病の母子垂直感染を予防
triage.triage_reason: 既存の研究・保健プログラムの成果報告であり、新規の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常な流行を示す情報ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ボリビア・コロンビア・パラグアイで実施された先天性シャーガス病対策プロジェクトの成果報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国はブラジルのみだが、同国は対象国リストに含まれるものの新規感染拡大や危機的事象ではないためDISMISSと判定。なお対象国リストにブラジル(3469034)が含まれるため、形式上は記載可能だが、本イベントはシグナルとして取り上げる性質のものではない。

article.articleHeadline: वाराणसी में नर्सिंग छात्रा दिव्यांशी यादव की डेंगू से मौत के मामले में हॉस्पिटल पहुंची किंग जॉर्ज मेडिकल कॉलेज लखनऊ की जांच टीम - an investigation team has arrived at the hospital regarding the death of nursing student divyanshi yadav due to dengue in varanasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Investigation team from King George's Medical College, Lucknow has arrived at the hospital in the dengue-related death of nursing student Divyanshi Yadav in Varanasi.
article.articleSummary: Dengue-related death of nursing student Divyanshi Yadav in Varanasi prompted an inquiry at Om Sai Homeo Hospital and Research Center in Kapforva. An investigation team from King George’s Medical College, Lucknow, led by Dr. R. S. Kushwaha and Dr. K. K. Singh, arrived with Varanasi ACMO after hospital and pathology inquiries yielded no satisfactory answers. The team questioned ICU and OPD staff and then examined a local pathology lab where the hospital had conducted blood testing. Divyanshi, a Shivpur resident, developed fever on 11 September; on 16 September dengue, malaria, and typhoid tests were performed, with family claiming a dengue-positive result. She was admitted to Om Sai Hospital on 17 September, treated on 18 September, and referred to BHU on 19 September, where doctors reportedly stated she had already died. Post-mortem protests by nursing college students demanded accountability and punishment for the alleged negligence; the district malaria officer accompanied the team.

triage.headline_ja: バラナシの看護学生ディヴィヤンシ・ヤダブさんのデング熱による死亡事案で、ラクナウのキング・ジョージ医科大学の調査チームが病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の医療過誤疑いに関する調査報道であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の死亡症例に関する病院対応の過失調査が主題であり、デング熱自体のアウトブレイク状況を示すものではない。地元の政治的・社会的関心（学生の抗議）はあるが、公衆衛生上の広範な影響を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: वडोदरा में डेंगू का कहर: ओपीडी में बढ़े 1000 मरीज, बच्ची की मौत से मचा हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue wreaks havoc in Vadodara: 1,000 more patients in the OPD, uproar after a girl's death.
article.articleSummary: Vadodara, India, faces a dengue surge: over 50 dengue-symptom admissions in the last 15 days; a baby girl died of dengue in Chhota Udepur district two days ago. Authorities say Vadodara remains comparatively controlled against Ahmedabad and Surat, but locally cases rose sharply. Primary and community health centers report a surge in fever and dengue patients. SSG Hospital's OPD, once 2,000–2,200 daily, now receives roughly 1,000 more patients; dengue inpatients include 24 at SSG and 26 at GMERS Gotri Hospital. RMO Dr. Hitendra Chauhan warns stagnant water fosters Aedes breeding; urges timely fogging and sanitation by the municipal corporation to prevent a bigger outbreak. World Rabies Day observances feature a three-day vaccination drive (Sept 26–28) vaccinating 209 stray animals—166 dogs, 43 cats—in Vishvamitra, Lalbagh, Akota, Parshuram Bhatta, and Sayajiganj. Five-in-One vaccines and deworming given; plans to scale up citywide.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァドーダラでデング熱が猛威：OPDで患者1000人増加、少女の死で騒然
triage.triage_reason: ヴァドーダラでデング熱患者が急増し小児の死亡例も発生、公衆の関心も高まっているためWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱の増加と小児死亡例、狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーン（World Rabies Day）を併せて報じているが、主眼はデング熱の急増。地域的なアウトブレイクであり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU denuncia el impacto sobre la respuesta al brote de ébola de los ataques armados en el este de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns about the impact of armed attacks in eastern DRC on the Ebola outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 30, 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists as armed attacks in eastern DRC hamper response. The UN OCHA reports 8,116 Ebola cases and 3,924 deaths across seven provinces since mid-May. Recent clashes around the Rhoe displacement camp in Ituri Province have killed four civilians and forced about 3,000 more to flee. In Lubero, North Kivu, two response workers were killed on Sept 27–28 while assisting Ebola operations. Fighting in Masisi has displaced more than 24,000 people since mid-September. Violence has also affected South Kivu and Tanganyika, straining humanitarian access and funding, with the Humanitarian Response Plan funded to only about 50% of USD 2.1 billion. DRC remains the most experienced Ebola country, and this outbreak could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic in cases (28,616) and deaths (11,325). Kasai's outbreak ended December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国東部での武装攻撃がエボラ出血熱流行対応に与える影響を非難
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8,116例・3,924死亡に達し、武力紛争により対応が著しく阻害されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（28,616例・11,325死亡）を上回る可能性が指摘されており、人道支援計画の資金は目標の約50%にとどまる。武力紛争により対応要員も死亡しており、状況は極めて深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Artificial Intelligence, a Lifeline Against Pandemics
article.articleSummary: Artificial intelligence (AI) may be a lifeline against pandemics, as of 2026-09-30, per UN General Assembly and WHO remarks. WHO DG Tedros warned a new respiratory disease could emerge with pandemic potential, echoing concerns from COVID-19. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is cited as a reminder that infectious diseases can arise anywhere and cross borders. Progress since COVID-19 is seen in national responses to Ebola and Marburg with WHO support, but gains appear fragile as funding shifts toward defense and away from health. Rising nationalism and reduced international cooperation could undermine global preparedness. India’s New Delhi model—export restrictions on medical supplies and a $1+ billion investment—illustrates isolationist tendencies. AI is proposed to sustain preparedness and accelerate responses.

triage.headline_ja: 人工知能、パンデミックへの命綱
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規感染症イベントの発生報告ではなく、AI活用やパンデミック対策の政策・論評記事であるため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はAIとパンデミック予防の論説であり、DRCのエボラ流行は過去の事例として言及されているのみで新規発生情報ではない。インドは医療品輸出規制の例示として言及されており感染症発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: At The Directive Of The President, UAE Allocates US$10 Million To Support International Efforts To Contain Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: US$10 million from the UAE to curb the Ebola outbreak in Africa, focusing on the Democratic Republic of the Congo and strengthening health systems in affected areas. Announcement made during an international meeting convened by the United States on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly. UAE Aid Agency Chairman Dr. Tareq Ahmed Al Ameri described UAE humanitarian leadership coordinating with governments and international organizations to address crises and epidemics. The UAE has delivered more than 150 tonnes of aid, including protective equipment, infection-control materials that benefited about 280 health facilities, plus shelter supplies and food for affected people. Emphasis on accelerating international coordination and action to limit transmission, protect communities, and bolster prevention, early detection and effective response capacities amid the ongoing, geographically widening Ebola outbreak in the DRC and surrounding regions.

triage.headline_ja: 大統領の指示により、UAEがエボラ流行阻止のための国際的取り組みを支援するため1000万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中かつ地理的に拡大しているエボラ出血熱の流行であり、国際支援・国際会議が行われるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEによる資金拠出に関する内容だが、背景にあるDRCでのエボラ流行自体は継続的かつ地理的に拡大しているため、既存の進行中アウトブレイクとしてフルRRA対象とする。米国・UAEは資金拠出国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : Ebola perçu différemment à Kisangani (Constat) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Ebola perceived differently in Kisangani (Observation) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is perceived differently in Kisangani, capital of Tshopo in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. A Kisangani resident, Papy Kalonda, says he has never seen an Ebola case in the city and views EVD as an Western invention aimed at exterminating Congolese, tying it to the Ituri epicenter and alleging threats against Red Cross volunteers accused of releasing Ebola. The report notes that Ebola exists regionally and fear is shaping work and daily life in Kisangani, with restrictions on movement. Kalonda calls for intensified media and Red Cross sensitization, universal barrier measures, and vaccine availability for the entire population to prevent a Bunia-like recurrence. The piece underscores mistrust and the need for clear public health messaging amid ongoing Ebola concerns in the region.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：キサンガニではエボラの受け止め方が異なる(現地報告) - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行地域（イツリ州）に近接するキサンガニでの住民の誤解・不信感を扱った社会的内容の記事であり、新規症例の確認情報はないが、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクの高い疾患であり地域住民の意識・対策状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はキサンガニ住民のエボラに対する誤解・陰謀論的見解と不信感を主題としており、同市での新規症例報告ではない。イツリ州（ブニア）の流行状況との関連性、ワクチン普及・啓発活動の必要性が言及されている。続報でキサンガニにおける実際の症例発生有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Com 581 casos de dengue, MPMS instaura inquérito e cobra limpeza de terrenos com taxa no IPTU em Ivinhema -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 581 dengue cases, MPMS opens an investigation and demands cleaning of land plots with IPTU tax in Ivinhema -- AconteceuMS.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Ivinhema, Mato Grosso do Sul, reached 581 confirmed cases in 2025–2026, the state’s highest incidence. The Ministério Público de Mato Grosso do Sul (MPMS) issued a recommendation to the municipality for mandatory sanitary measures and intensified control of dengue, Zika virus, and chikungunya. The measures require notifying landowners, cleaning public areas, and recovering private cleaning costs via IPTU. Under Municipal Laws 490/1994 and 1,155/2011, the city must clean all public properties within one year and present a January maintenance schedule. It should notify owners of vacant lots and strengthen inspections in high-incidence rural zones and in Água Azul, Itapoã, Vitória, and Triguenã neighborhoods. Immediate cleanup of PAC areas in Triguenã, regardless of litigation, plus legal and security support for health workers to access closed or abandoned properties. The municipality has 15 days to respond with a plan; noncompliance could trigger judicial action.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱581例確認、MPMSがイヴィニェマで調査開始、IPTU税による土地清掃を要求
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方都市（イヴィニェマ）における季節性デング熱の流行で、行政による衛生対策強化の記事。国際的拡大や異常性は認められず、地域限定の公衆衛生対応と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトグロッソ・ド・スル州イヴィニェマ市における地方検察庁（MPMS）の行政対応に関する内容であり、感染症の国際的リスク評価というよりは地域保健行政ニュースに近い。死亡者数や重症度についての記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ações de combate à malária reforça a importância do diagnóstico precoce e da prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Actions to combat malaria reinforce the importance of early diagnosis and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil, recorded 3,061 malaria cases from Jan 1 to Sep 15, 2026, up 8.8% from the same period in 2025. The rise is driven by Plasmodium falciparum, with 213 notifications, and 31 mixed P. vivax + P. falciparum cases. Transmission is uneven, primarily in rural, riverbank, and village areas; the top localities are Bacia Leiteira (157), Terra Santa (123), KM 13 / Santa Helena (96), Bairro Novo / BR-364 (91), Uberaba (71), Areia Branca (61), Vila Codaron - KM 13 (60), Fortaleza do Abunã (58), Colônia Viçosa (54), and Ramal Castanheira - KM 14 (53). Local authorities have intensified active surveillance and household spraying; Endemic Disease Control Agents emphasize community cooperation to ensure rapid testing, indoor spraying, and impregnated mosquito nets. Common symptoms include fever, chills, headaches, body aches, and fatigue. Malaria is curable; the SUS offers free treatment, prioritizing children, pregnant women, the elderly, and rural residents. Testing is free via rapid tests or thick blood smear at multiple units, with G6PD testing available as needed.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア対策の強化、早期診断と予防の重要性を再確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ポルトベーリョでマラリア症例が前年比増加しているが、既知の地域流行であり当局が対策を強化している状況。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、罹患数増加の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方流行地域における既知の風土病（マラリア）の季節的増加であり、地元当局が対応中。SUSによる無料診断・治療が提供されており、管理体制は機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : démarrage des travaux de validation du plan communicationnel de lutte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: Start of validation work on the Ebola response communication plan - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo — On 30 September 2026, validation work began in Kisangani for the Ebola response communication plan, aimed at diagnosing and contextualizing the 17th Ebola outbreak declared 15 May, with Ituri province as the epicenter. Tshopo province had imported Ebola cases by late June, and the outbreak was officially declared on 9 July. The plan's sociocultural mapping covers 23 health zones, 442 health areas, 305 micro-areas, 3 internally displaced camps, 3 categories of special populations (including fishermen and miners), 30 radio and television stations, 8 refractory sects, and pockets of insecurity such as the Bafwasende territory. Hubert Lobanga Tembele, interim CREC coordinator for risk communication, said these elements will inform the provincial communications plan. The CREC has been on the ground previously, and proceedings will continue next Friday.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ：エボラ対策コミュニケーション計画の検証作業が開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（イツリ州を震源、ツショパ州に飛び火）に関する対応活動であり、致死率の高いエボラであること、複数州・保健区域にまたがる拡大、治安不安や特殊集団（漁師・鉱夫等）への対応必要性から国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコミュニケーション計画の検証作業についてであり新規症例報告ではないが、第17次エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言、イツリ州震源、ツショパ州に輸入例）が依然進行中であることを示す。治安不安地域（バフワセンデ）や特殊人口集団、排他的宗教団体の存在が対応の難易度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS exige garantizar suministro de oxígeno para pacientes de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO demands guaranteed oxygen supply for Ebola patients in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 8,000 cases with 3,924 confirmed deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), as of 27 September. The World Health Organization urges guaranteed, uninterrupted oxygen supply for Ebola patients, noting that oxygen access remains unstable in multiple wards across seven affected provinces, hampering response. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Hospital capacity has expanded to more than 1,600 beds across 50 treatment centers, with projections to exceed 2,000 beds in coming days. The outbreak is described as the second-most contagious and deadly Ebola event in global history, underscoring the need for improved logistics and timely care to reduce community deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者への酸素供給保証を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8000症例・致死率48.3%に達し、ワクチン・承認治療法が存在しない重大な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイクで、致死率48.3%、7州に拡大。WHOが酸素供給支援を要請しており国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू जागरूकता बढ़ाने के लिए बंगाल के सभी स्कूलों में बनेगा 'ग्रीन स्कूल', साफ-सफाई पर जोर - west bengal schools dengue awareness green school initiative
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To raise dengue awareness, all schools in West Bengal will establish a 'Green School', with a focus on cleanliness.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal's Education Department will convert all schools into 'Green Schools' to raise dengue awareness and promote environmental sustainability. Following a Nabanna high-level meeting, the department issued directives for dengue prevention and environmentally friendly campus practices. Campaigns will educate students, teachers, and parents on preventing dengue, stopping mosquito breeding, and eliminating standing water, with active student participation and outreach to homes and neighborhoods. Schools must maintain clean premises, ecological balance, and responsibly run green initiatives, with linked activities under the Swachh/Green School Rating (SHVR). District inspectors will monitor implementation. Effective as of 30 September 2026, the program seeks integrated dengue prevention and community outreach to curb transmission in West Bengal.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱啓発のため、西ベンガル州の全学校が『グリーンスクール』に-清潔重視
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱予防のための教育・啓発キャンペーンに関する行政施策の報道であり、新規の異常な感染拡大や深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の感染拡大そのものではなく、学校における予防啓発・環境衛生施策に関する行政発表。具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Νέα μελέτη: Για το 12% των καρκίνων παγκοσμίως ευθύνονται λοιμώξεις από ιούς και βακτήρια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New study: Viral and bacterial infections account for 12% of cancers worldwide.
article.articleSummary: 2.3 million new cancers in 2024 were caused by infections from viruses, bacteria, and parasites, accounting for 12% of all global cancer cases, per IARC. Helicobacter pylori, a stomach bacterium, was the leading infectious driver with 760,000 cases (4%), including gastric cancer and a gastric non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Human papillomavirus caused 750,000 cases, with hepatitis B virus also contributing. Epstein-Barr virus is highlighted as a potential future vaccine target, capable of causing six cancers such as pharyngeal and stomach cancers. In total, 12 oncogenic pathogens—viruses, a bacterium, and parasites—underlie these cancers. East Asia recorded the most infection-attributed cancers in 2024 (990,000; 42%), driven by H. pylori and HBV; Sub-Saharan Africa had the highest regional share by infection-linked cancers (~25%). Disparities persist; the study advocates prevention, screening, treatment, and research, and notes that new preventive tools could notably impact EBV-related cancer burden.

triage.headline_ja: 新研究:世界の癌の12%はウイルスと細菌による感染症が原因
triage.triage_reason: グローバルながん疫学研究であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や特定の感染拡大イベントを報告するものではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はIARCによる発がん性感染症に関する長期的疫学研究の紹介であり、特定の国・地域での急性アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。発生地域としてChinaが付与されているが、記事はEast Asia全体の統計に言及しているのみで、中国固有のイベントではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Diarrhoea Outbreak In Ganjam Village Leaves One Dead, Over 15 Affected
article.articleSummary: Diarrhoea outbreak in Patashala village, Dharakote block, Ganjam district, Odisha, India, has claimed one life and affected more than 15 people over the past three days. The deceased is 36-year-old Sushanta Malik; more than five affected individuals are admitted at Manikpur Primary Health Centre (PHC). District authorities directed medical teams from Dharakote and Manikpur PHCs to treat patients, with another team visiting after additional cases emerged on Wednesday. Preliminary information links some cases to a feast at Podamari, with suspected food poisoning as a possible cause; the exact reason is not yet established. Health teams are monitoring the situation and providing treatment; laboratory confirmation and a confirmed infection source have not been established.

triage.headline_ja: ガンジャム県の村で下痢症が発生、1人死亡・15人以上が感染
triage.triage_reason: 小規模な下痢症（食中毒の可能性）で死亡者も出ているが、原因・病原体未確定であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域的な集団発生として続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 感染源は未確定（食中毒の疑いあり）。地方の医療チームが対応中で、国レベルの危機管理対応は報告されていない。続報により病原体が判明すれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Avanço de Streptococcus agalactiae sorotipo III reforça a prevenção na tilapicultura brasileira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III reinforces prevention in Brazilian tilapia farming.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III is increasingly reported in Brazilian tilapia farming, expanding from the Northeast to other production poles, prompting ongoing surveillance and preemptive measures. Data from the Tilapia Health Bulletin (April–June 2026) show 17 of 154 analyses positive for serotype III (11%), 39 of 309 for S. agalactiae (13%), and 28 of 156 for serotype Ib (17.9%), underscoring co-circulation of serotypes and region-specific risk. Clinical signs include anorexia, lethargy, erratic swimming, exophthalmos, corneal opacity, neurological changes, systemic inflammation and mortality. Vaccination is presented as a key preventive tool; commercial vaccines provide defined composition, dosage and delivery, with batch quality controls and veterinary guidance. Vaccination should be part of a broader biosafety program including diagnostic testing, serotyping, animal sourcing, stocking density, water quality and stress reduction. AQUAVAC STREP 4 covers Ia, Ib, III and S. iniae; AQUAVAC STREP SA-SI targets Ib and S. iniae, guiding region-specific decisions.

triage.headline_ja: ストレプトコッカス・アガラクティエ血清型IIIの拡大がブラジルのティラピア養殖における予防策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物（魚類養殖）における疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響は認められないため、IHR/WPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事例はティラピア養殖業における魚類の細菌性疾患であり、ヒト感染症ではないため公衆衛生リスク評価の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Vĩnh Long tập trung phòng, chống bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vĩnh Long focuses on rabies prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam, intensified in 2026 with six human deaths to date and four animal outbreaks detected in Phuoc My Trung, Loc Thuan, Dong Khoi, and Thanh Phuoc. Fatalities occurred in Tan Xuan, Hiep My, Chau Hung, Ben Tre, Ba Tri and Tan Thuy. Surveillance via event-based reporting and vaccination-site monitoring enabled rapid verification; over 600 warning signs were shared and more than 20 samples tested, with four dog samples positive. In Tan Thuy, one outbreak linked to a human death. Health posts operate 24/7 to triage exposure and guide post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). From 2022–2025, 24 deaths occurred in the province; nearly 100,000 people received PEP annually. Approximately 333,000 dogs and cats live in the province; authorities aim to vaccinate >80% of pets and achieve zero rabies deaths by 2030, with enhanced surveillance, testing, vaccination, and public education. Victims should wash wounds for 15 minutes and seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省、狂犬病の予防・対策に注力
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ヴィンロン省で狂犬病による複数の人的死亡と動物感染が継続しているが、同国では狂犬病は既知のエンデミック疾患であり、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。既存の対策プログラムが機能しているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムで地方病として知られ、同省では2022〜2025年に24人の死亡例があり、既に大規模なワクチン接種・監視プログラムが実施されている。今回の報告は継続的な対策活動の一環であり、突発的・異常な増加を示す明確な根拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: MP: बालाघाट में फैली बीमारी पर तत्काल एक्शन, 50 गांवों में पहुंचीं मेडिकल टीमें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madhya Pradesh: Immediate action on the disease spreading in Balaghat district; medical teams reached 50 villages.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, faces a sudden disease outbreak triggering a multi-tier response. Authorities activated the District Rapid Response Team and deployed pediatricians, epidemiologists, entomologists, and a national team to the affected areas. In 50 villages, 57 health teams screened 43,451 people; 6,537 were treated at home and 647 severely ill children hospitalized. Birsa block conducted measles-rubella vaccination for 35,827 children. Diarrhoea prevention included ORS and zinc for 163,902 families; malaria control involved spraying in 8,610 homes, screening 26,865 people with 980 positives treated, and distributing 3,600 nets. Financial measures include 3.60 lakh for safe transport of pregnant women, 3.40 lakh for vaccine transport, and funding for repairs and equipment. Ghummur Sub-Health Center may be upgraded to a PHC with 66 lakh; 54 new doctors and strengthened CDPOs/Anganwadi staff bolster services. Over 23 years, maternal mortality fell from 176 to 60 and infant mortality from 3,805 to 1,560, while institutional delivery and immunization rose markedly.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州:バラガート県で広がる疾病に即時対応、医療チームが50の村に到達
triage.triage_reason: バラガート県で原因不明の「突発的な疾病流行」が発生し、647人の重症児童が入院するなど重症例が多数報告され、政府が大規模な多部門対応（医療チーム・国家チーム派遣、麻疹風疹ワクチン接種、マラリア対策等）を実施しており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性・重症度・流行可能性）に該当し、関係省庁の高い関心も確認できる。
triage.notes: 記事では「突発的な疾病流行」の具体的な病原体が明示されておらず、麻疹・風疹・マラリアは対応として挙げられた疾患であり、実際の主要アウトブレイクの原因疾患は不明。重症児童647人の入院が報告されており、詳細なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट में अचानक फैली बीमारी पर मोहन यादव सरकार का बड़ा एक्शन, 57 टीमों ने 50 गांवों में की 43 हजार से ज्यादा लोगों की जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Balaghat, the Mohan Yadav government's bold action against a sudden outbreak of disease; 57 teams screened over 43,000 people in 50 villages.
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, faced a sudden fever and rash outbreak among children, with actions traced to July amid heavy rains. Across 50 villages, 57 health teams examined 43,451 people; 6,537 treated at home and 647 children hospitalized. In Birsa development block, 35,827 children were vaccinated with measles-rubella. ORS and zinc were provided to 163,902 families. Malaria control included spraying 8,610 homes, 26,865 malaria tests with 980 positives, and treatment for all positives; about 3,600 mosquito nets were distributed. Financial provisions supported safer transport for pregnant women and children, vaccine logistics, repairs for 22 sub-health centers, and equipment purchases. Fifty-four new doctors were posted; a malaria advisor and four technical supervisors were appointed; four CDPOs and 52 Anganwadi workers were filled. Over 23 years, institutional delivery rose to 92.1%, full immunization to 92.7%, maternal mortality fell to 60, and infant mortality to 1,560.

triage.headline_ja: バラガートで突然発生した病気に対しモハン・ヤーダブ政府が大規模対応、57チームが50村で4万3000人以上を検査
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹・マラリアへの大規模な政府対応が報告されているが、これは既に数ヶ月前（7月）から進行中の対応であり、新規の異常事態というよりは既知のアウトブレイクへの行政対応の報告。重症度・規模は一定程度あるが国際的拡大の懸念は低く、続報を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年9月配信だが、対応は7月の豪雨期に遡る既知の事案。麻疹・風疹（647人入院）とマラリア（980人陽性）の複合的な公衆衛生対応で、州政府主導の大規模介入（インフラ・人員強化含む）が報告されている。国際的な注目や支援要請は見られず、地域内対応として進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes gelar ORI respons peningkatan kasus campak di Manokwari - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office Holds ORI in Response to Rising Measles Cases in Manokwari - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, Manokwari, West Papua, is conducting a 12-day Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) for measles-rubella from Oct 5–17, 2026, targeting children 9 months to under 5 years with a 95% coverage goal. Epidemiology shows 70 suspected measles cases across eight Puskesmas, with three lab-confirmed positives in Wosi and Sanggeng (Manokwari Barat) and Pasir Putih (Manokwari Timur). Through week 36, 70 cases have been reported; about 67% are under five. Of the cases, 49 (70%) had no documented vaccination history; 34 patients were hospitalized. Transmission includes 13 cases in Susweni village, indicating inter-household or neighborhood spread. The outbreak meets KLB criteria (28 cases in weeks 31–36), and Manokwari is slated for KLB status to accelerate response. Pre-ORI socialization ran Sept 28–Oct 3, 2026. Microplanning and logistics (vaccines, diluent, syringes, cold chain) are in place, with Puskesmas, RSUD Manokwari, and community leaders engaged.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、マノクワリでの麻疹症例増加に対応しORI（アウトブレイク対応予防接種）を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・マノクワリでKLB（アウトブレイク）基準を満たす麻疹70例・入院34例が報告され、ワクチン未接種率が高くヒト-ヒト感染拡大が懸念されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: KLB（Kejadian Luar Biasa＝アウトブレイク）認定基準を満たし、西パプア州マノクワリで予防接種キャンペーン（ORI）が10月5〜17日に実施予定。未接種率70%、5歳未満が67%を占める。国際的拡大の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ľudia preniesli na amazonské opice nebezpečný vírus. Vedci hovoria o vážnom varovnom signáli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People transmitted a dangerous virus to Amazonian monkeys. Scientists say it is a serious warning sign.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) detected in Amazonian New World primates in Brazil. A EcoHealth study analyzed blood or liver samples from 88 primates across 28 species, from two environments: human-impacted Rondônia and Mato Grosso versus the remote Japurá River headwaters in Amazonas. In the human-impacted zone (49 primates), 17 tested HBV-positive (≈35%), with viral genotypes matching HBV strains circulating among local humans, suggesting spillover from people. In the remote area (39 primates), none were positive. Transmission is not airborne; possible routes include close human contact or keeping young primates as pets, allowing infection to re-enter the wild. Deforestation and urban-adjacent edges may elevate contact, underscoring the need for protective buffer zones. It remains unclear whether HBV causes disease in Amazonian primates or whether it can spread among them, raising concern about a potential new wildlife reservoir. Region-wide livelihood reliance on primates involves about three million individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 人間がアマゾンの猿に危険なウイルスを感染させた。科学者は深刻な警告信号だと指摘
triage.triage_reason: ヒトからアマゾン霊長類へのB型肝炎ウイルス spillover が確認され新たな野生動物リザーバーの可能性が示唆されるが、ヒト感染拡大や重症化の報告はなく情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本件はヒトから野生霊長類への逆spillover事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクではなく生態学的・公衆衛生監視上の関心事項。続報（霊長類での発症有無、感染拡大状況）を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Monkeypox Confirmed in Congo's Ebola-Hit Bunia as Health Officials Brace for More Cases
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox confirmed in Bunia, Ituri province, DR Congo, amid a concurrent Ebola outbreak; one confirmed Monkeypox case and five other suspected cases under investigation in Bunia. The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species, has infected over 7,800 people with at least 3,700 deaths since May. International funding to combat Ebola totals $886 million, with a new $267 million pledge from the United States bringing the US contribution to $886 million, including $107 million from HHS. Britain has deployed three experts near Juba, South Sudan, to bolster infection control and cross-border surveillance as authorities warn of potential spread across the 500-mile frontier. Congolese Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka calls the outbreak a major test and urges continued domestic and partner mobilization.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行地ブニアで天然痘サル痘（Mpox）確認、保健当局はさらなる症例増加を警戒
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブニアでエボラ流行（7,800人感染、3,700人死亡）と並行してMpox症例が確認され、国境を越えた拡大リスクや国際支援の動員（米英の資金・専門家派遣）が既に生じているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 南スーダン（Juba）やアメリカ・イギリスは記事に登場するが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）とMpoxの同時流行という複合的な公衆衛生危機であり、国境を越えた拡大警戒（南スーダン国境500マイル）が明記されている点が特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: Em meio a aumento de casos de sarampo no Brasil, CE não atinge meta da 2ª dose; veja onde se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid rising measles cases in Brazil, Ceará does not meet the target for the second dose; see where to get vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases are rising in Brazil, with Ceará state missing the 95% herd-immunity target for the second MMR dose. In 2026, Ceará reports 96.45% of 1-year-olds with the first dose and 84.78% with the second, based on RNDS data up to Aug 1 (updated Aug 24). Despite tourism-driven risk, Ceará reports no measles cases since 2022 and no active suspected cases currently. The National Immunization Program aims for 95% vaccination; the measles vaccine is the MMR (live-attenuated), provided free by SUS, and requires completion of the two-dose schedule, with verified vaccination records. Symptoms include fever above 38.5°C and a red rash starting on the head, plus cough, runny nose, and red eyes; transmission is airborne and highly contagious, with up to 90% of susceptible contacts infected. Public health authorities stress active surveillance and prompt reporting of suspected cases to sustain elimination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹症例増加の中、セアラ州は第2回接種目標未達成－接種場所を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全体で麻疹症例増加との報道だが、セアラ州自体は2022年以降症例なしで具体的な症例数・重症度情報が不足しており、ワクチン接種率不足によるリスク注意喚起が主眼のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はセアラ州の予防接種率不足とブラジル全国的な麻疹増加傾向を報じているが、セアラ州自体には現在活動症例なし。具体的な全国症例数や重症度データが記載されておらず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: HIV Control Raigad | रायगडात एड्सविरोधी लढ्याला यश; संसर्गाचे प्रमाण ०.१७ टक्क्यांवर, ९७ टक्के रुग्णांमध्ये विषाणू नियंत्रणात
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV Control Raigad | Success of anti-AIDS fight in Raigad; infection rate at 0.17 percent, the virus under control in 97 percent of patients.
article.articleSummary: HIV infection rate in Raigad district, Maharashtra, has fallen to 0.17% with virus under control in about 97% of those on treatment, per guidance from the Maharashtra State AIDS Control Society and the National AIDS Control Organization. Increased awareness, testing, counselling, and treatment have boosted uptake: 43,519 individuals tested against a target of 17,432; 18,314 pregnant women tested against 11,756. Across 61,833 tests, 103 infections were detected. Since 2002, Raigad has recorded 11,242 HIV infections. Treatment-registration coverage rose from 24% in 2009 to 78.42% in 2026. Care is provided at Alibag District Hospital, Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital (Lodhiwali), and MGM Hospital (Kamothe), with 4,642 patients on regular medication. In April–July 2026, 1,673 HIV tests yielded 1,626 with viral suppression (≈97%).

triage.headline_ja: HIV対策ライガド | ライガドでエイズ撲滅運動が成功、感染率0.17%に低下、97%の患者でウイルス制御
triage.triage_reason: インドのライガド県でHIV感染率が低下し、治療成果が改善しているという肯定的な公衆衛生報告であり、異常性・緊急性・国際的拡大リスクはない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・マハラシュトラ州ライガド県のHIV対策成功事例を報じるものであり、ミャンマー（Kayin State等）は発生地域として関連性がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng: Bệnh nhân sốt xuất huyết tăng gần 10 lần, bệnh viện kê thêm giường ở hành lang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang: Dengue patients nearly tenfold; hospital adds beds in the corridors.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, Da Nang reports a dengue fever surge, with September admissions nearly tenfold higher than the same period last year. The city has recorded close to 4,000 dengue cases, more than twice the level of the previous year. Da Nang Hospital is operating at capacity with wards full; beds are being placed in corridors and staffing increased to treat the surge. A patient from Quang Tri Province presented with high fever, spontaneous bleeding from gums and nose, marked fatigue, and reddened skin. Dengue is described as unpredictable, with many cases progressing to severe illness. The report highlights ongoing community transmission and the strain on hospital resources in Da Nang.

triage.headline_ja: ダナン:デング熱患者が約10倍に増加、病院は廊下にもベッドを追加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例が前年比約10倍に急増し医療資源が逼迫しており、地域内での持続的な感染拡大と重症化例が確認されているためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ダナン市での症例急増と病院の病床逼迫が報告されており、重症例（自然出血等）も確認されている。周辺省からの患者搬送もあり、地域的な感染拡大が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 17ème Épidemie d'Ebola en RD Congo : questions fréquemment posées
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: Frequently Asked Questions
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak declared on May 15, 2026 in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, had expanded by September 15, 2026 to seven provinces, with 7,404 confirmed cases, 3,577 deaths and 1,776 recoveries. The epicenter remains Ituri, with spillover to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo and Sud Ubangi. The affected regions include conflict-affected areas with limited access to essential services. National health authorities and humanitarian partners have intensified response activities, including surveillance, risk communication, infection prevention, and community engagement. The Democratic Republic of the Congo Red Cross (CRRDC), supported by the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), is central to outreach, monitoring, and the organization of safe and dignified burials. The article notes ongoing outbreak management and response coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ出血熱流行：よくある質問
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,404症例・3,577死亡に拡大した大規模エボラ流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約48%と高く、紛争地域での対応困難、7州への拡大、国際的な人道支援（IFRC/ICRC）が関与していることから、重大なシグナルとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: Pramono nilai jumlah kasus Influenza A di DKI tergolong rendah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pramono says the number of Influenza A cases in Jakarta is relatively low.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung Wibowo says Influenza A infections in DKI Jakarta remain relatively low despite a rise in cases, with a 15% uptick not nearing outbreak thresholds (150%). After discussions with the DKI Health Office and the Ministry of Health, Jakarta remains safe and prepared, with government-run hospitals and health centers ready to treat patients with flu or acute respiratory infections (ARI). Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono notes that most Influenza A infections are not dangerous and self-limiting, typically recovering without treatment; no significant increase has been seen nationally or globally. The spread pattern mirrors typical influenza, tending to rise before Indonesia’s rainy season and fall around February–March. Authorities urge proportional concern and advise those with flu symptoms to seek hospital care, avoiding sensationalism.

triage.headline_ja: プラモノ知事、ジャカルタのインフルエンザA感染者数は比較的低水準と評価
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常範囲内の増加であり、当局は流行閾値に達していないと説明。重症度・異常性ともに低く、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 当局者が自ら『流行閾値に達していない』『季節性パターンと一致』『自然軽快する』と説明しており、懸念の少ない通常の季節性インフルエンザ報道と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : MSF alerte sur l'impact de la désinformation dans la réponse - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: MSF warns about the impact of misinformation on the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Nia-Nia health zone, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is being hampered by misinformation and fear. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warns that misinformation contributes to a widening third epidemic by causing people to avoid care, with most early Ebola-related deaths occurring within the community in the outbreak's first weeks. There is a shift, with more patients now seeking treatment centers at the onset of symptoms. MSF teams are engaging with community leaders, health workers, and local organizations to understand public concerns and to rebuild trust in the response to the outbreak. MSF emphasizes cooperation with authorities and community stakeholders to ensure safe, timely care.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱：MSFが対応における誤情報の影響に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と地域拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 第3波のエボラ流行が拡大中とされ、誤情報による受診回避が死亡率上昇に寄与しているとMSFが警告。具体的な症例数・致死率データは本文に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria é identificada em UTI de hospital de Balneário Camboriú e pacientes entram em isolamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacterium identified in the ICU of a hospital in Balneário Camboriú, patients enter isolation.
article.articleSummary: An unidentified bacterium was detected in the Adult ICU at Hospital Regional Ruth Cardoso in Balneário Camboriú, Santa Catarina, Brazil, on Friday, 2026-09-26. Immediate infection-control measures were implemented and affected patients are in contact isolation; the hospital did not specify the organism. The Infection Control Commission (CCIH) continues monitoring, with precautions including gowns and disposable materials; officials say the bacterium is not airborne and poses no risk to patients outside the ICU. The incident has been referred to the Santa Catarina Public Prosecutor’s Office (MPSC), which has not publicly confirmed the organism. A representation cites a possible Acinetobacter genus, potentially Acinetobacter baumannii, but confirmation is pending. The MPSC requests details on the organism, first case date, number of infections/colonizations, notifications, lab reports, and isolation protocols, plus equipment/hygiene concerns. The hospital noted ongoing revitalization: a new patient admissions reception this week, with surgical rooms expanding from three to five and later ICU work planned.

triage.headline_ja: バルネアリオ・カンボリウの病院ICUで細菌が確認され、患者が隔離措置
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の1病院ICU内に限定された未同定細菌（Acinetobacter属の可能性）の院内感染事例で、既に隔離措置が取られており院外への拡大は報告されていないが、病原体の確認や検察による調査結果など続報が必要。
triage.notes: 病原体は未確認（Acinetobacter baumannii疑い）で、州検察（MPSC）が病院に詳細情報の提出を求めている。ICU内に限定され院外への感染リスクはないとされるが、確認結果と感染者数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ada 6.199 Kasus Baru TBC di Cirebon, Anak-Anak Hingga Dewasa Tertular |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are 6,199 new TB cases in Cirebon, infected from children to adults |Republika Online.
article.articleSummary: As of August 2024, Cirebon Regency in Indonesia reported 6,199 new tuberculosis (TB) cases and 125 new leprosy (kusta) cases, with infections occurring in both children and adults. TB and leprosy remain substantial public health challenges, complicating poverty, economic growth, education, and demographic dynamics and highlighting hurdles in case management. The local Health Office outlines a multi-pronged response: expanding public information about TB and leprosy, promoting early case finding, strengthening health services and rehabilitation, and reducing stigma toward patients and their families. Additional measures include community health worker empowerment and heightened commitment from both government and society. The data indicate an ongoing burden requiring coordinated, community-based strategies to improve detection, treatment access, and social support for affected individuals and households.

triage.headline_ja: チレボンで6,199件の新規結核症例、子供から大人まで感染
triage.triage_reason: 結核・ハンセン病はインドネシアの地域で既知の継続的な公衆衛生課題として報告されており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常の疾病負担報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局による既存の疾病対策プログラムの一環としての報告であり、結核・ハンセン病ともに既知の風土病であるため新規性・緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Cancer : 2,3 millions de nouveaux cas attribuables à des infections dans le monde en 2024
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cancer: 2.3 million new cancer cases attributable to infections worldwide in 2024.
article.articleSummary: 2.3 million cancers diagnosed in 2024 worldwide are attributable to infections, about one in eight cancers globally. The Lancet Oncology study by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) evaluated 12 infectious agents; five drive the majority: Helicobacter pylori (760,000 cases), human papillomavirus (HPV, 750,000), hepatitis B virus (HBV, 360,000), Epstein–Barr virus (EBV, 260,000), and hepatitis C virus (HCV, 160,000). East Asia accounts for 42% of infection-related cancers, with strong contributions from H. pylori and HBV; Sub-Saharan Africa contributes 28.5%, where HPV and the virus responsible for Kaposi’s sarcoma are among the main agents. Over 75% of these cancers occur in low- or middle-income countries. Prevention is pivotal: HPV and HBV vaccination, plus screening and treatment of infections; calls to develop vaccines against EBV and other oncogenic agents lacking preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: がん:2024年、世界の新規がん症例の230万件が感染症に起因
triage.triage_reason: 世界的な疫学研究に関する一般的な報告であり、特定の国や地域での急性の感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はIARC/Lancet Oncologyによる世界的な感染関連がんの統計報告であり、特定国でのアウトブレイク事例ではない。発生地域に上海・中国が付与されているが、記事内で中国固有の事象は述べられておらず、東アジア全体の統計言及のみのため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 灣仔有食肆海南雞飯樣本檢出沙門氏菌　食安中心指示停售
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Salmonella detected in Hainanese chicken rice samples from Wan Chai eateries; Centre for Food Safety orders a halt to sales.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-30, Salmonella was detected in Hainanese chicken rice samples from Wan Chai eateries in Hong Kong. A 25-gram ready-to-eat sample tested positive for Salmonella, exceeding the centre's guideline that such samples should not contain the pathogen. The Centre for Food Safety dispatched inspectors to investigate and informed the eateries of violations; the outlets halted sales and discarded the affected products. The centre provided food safety and hygiene education to the restaurant owner and staff, with instructions to improve cooking processes and carry out thorough cleaning and disinfection. This incident underscores ongoing food-safety enforcement in Hong Kong. Original reporting by RTHK.

triage.headline_ja: 湾仔の飲食店の海南鶏飯サンプルからサルモネラ菌検出、食品安全センターが販売停止を指示
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食品検査によるサルモネラ検出事例であり、人への健康被害や感染拡大の報告はなく、通常の食品安全監視業務の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 疾患名にTyphoid/Paratyphoidとあるが、記事内容はサルモネラ菌による食品検査事例であり、腸チフス・パラチフスの症例報告ではない。タグ付けの誤りと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A di Jakarta Naik 15 Persen, Pramono Anung Tegaskan Status Masih Aman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases in Jakarta rise 15 percent, Pramono Anung asserts that the situation remains safe.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections in Jakarta rose 15% but remain within safe limits, according to Governor Pramono Anung Wibowo after coordination with the DKI Jakarta Health Service and the Ministry of Health. An outbreak is defined as a rise exceeding 150%; the 15% increase does not meet that threshold, keeping Jakarta in a safe status. Residents with flu or acute respiratory infections are urged to seek hospital care promptly, with government-run hospitals and Puskesmas (community health centers) prepared to treat patients. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono noted that most Influenza A infections are not dangerous and typically recover on their own, though monitoring of case severity and trends continues. No specific case counts or fatalities are provided. Ongoing surveillance and preparedness in the capital are emphasized as of 2026-09-30.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタのインフルエンザA感染者15%増加、プラモノ・アヌン氏は状況は安全だと強調
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常範囲内の増加であり、当局が安全と公式発表。重症例や死亡報告もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 当局はアウトブレイクの定義（150%超の増加）に達していないとして安全を強調しており、季節性インフルエンザの通常変動と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : l'anthrax, cause la mort des hippopotames dans la riviè.re Semuliki (ICCN) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Anthrax, the cause of hippopotamus deaths in the Semuliki River (ICCN) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Anthrax is the cause of hippopotamus deaths in the Semuliki River, Nord-Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Analyses by veterinarians from Virunga Doctors and ICCN confirm Bacillus anthracis as the cause of mortality among hippos observed in the Semuliki. A rapid response protocol has been activated to contain the situation. The ICCN warns humans can contract anthrax through contact with infected or dead animals or by consuming their meat. Residents are urged not to touch, move, butcher, bury, or burn carcasses; keep children, livestock, and pets away and avoid water near carcasses. Veterinary teams and partners will continue monitoring and issue further directives as needed. The communiqué was signed in Ishango on 29 September 2026; ACP reported on 30 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ：炭疽菌がセムリキ川のカバ大量死の原因に（ICCN）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: カバの炭疽菌感染による大量死が確認され、ヒトへの感染リスクについて注意喚起がなされているが、現時点でヒト感染例の報告はなく情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 現時点では野生動物（カバ）の炭疽菌による死亡事例であり、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。ICCNは死骸との接触や肉の摂取を避けるよう住民に警告しており、今後のヒト症例発生の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Navi Mumbai: Taloja Records 20 Dengue, Malaria Cases As Construction And Stagnant Water Raise Health Concerns
article.articleSummary: 20 dengue and malaria cases were detected in Taloja township and adjoining rural areas of Navi Mumbai between June and August 2026, per Panvel Municipal Corporation health data. Among 183 suspected dengue cases, 8 were confirmed positive; malaria testing of 4,103 residents identified 12 infections. Rapid construction activity, stagnant water, and poor sanitation are cited as mosquito-breeding drivers in this rapidly developing belt. Authorities call for water management at construction sites, regular cleaning of drains and gutters, elimination of breeding spots, and intensified fogging and insecticide spraying, alongside public awareness campaigns and fever surveillance. Health workers and inspectors are visiting private hospitals to collect case information. The Panvel health department emphasizes ongoing field-level surveillance and coordination with private facilities to identify cases early and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナビムンバイ：タロジャで建設工事と滞留水を背景にデング熱・マラリア20例を記録、健康懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: インド・タロジャ地域で季節性のデング熱・マラリア小規模発生が報告されているが、地方自治体レベルで既に対応中であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクなど重大な懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリアともに確認症例数は少なく（デング8例、マラリア12例）、地方自治体による通常の媒介蚊対策・サーベイランス活動の範囲内と判断される。インドの雨季における典型的な季節性感染症報告であり、国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Shravasti News|Shravasti Today News|Shravasti Waterlogging News|Shravasti DM News | Shravasti News: एक अक्टूबर से संचारी रोग नियंत्रण अभियान, डीएम ने जलभराव पर दिए सख्त निर्देश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shravasti News|Shravasti Today News|Shravasti Waterlogging News|Shravasti DM News | Shravasti News: From October 1, a communicable disease control campaign, the DM has issued strict instructions on waterlogging.
article.articleSummary: Shravasti district, Uttar Pradesh, will run a communicable disease control campaign from October 1–31, with a Dastak (door-to-door) phase from October 12–31 targeting brain fever and other vector-borne diseases. District Magistrate Annpurna Garg chaired a Collectorate meeting to finalize plans, directing health, panchayat, education, and municipal departments to operate a comprehensive plan. Emphasis on removing waterlogging and spraying anti-larva agents to curb mosquito breeding, alongside sanitation and cleanliness drives. Anganwadi and ASHA workers will visit homes to raise awareness, and residents with fever, cough, or other symptoms will be identified and their details (name, address, mobile) uploaded to the E-Kavach portal. The campaign will also promote awareness for TB suspects, leprosy, filariasis, and kala-azar. A district control room will monitor progress with daily reports.

triage.headline_ja: シュラーヴァスティー:10月1日より伝染病対策キャンペーン開始、DMが水たまり対策に厳格指示
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な流行報告ではなく、通常の季節的な伝染病予防・啓発キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、毎年実施される予防的な衛生・啓発キャンペーンの行政発表である。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Ponorogo catat 254 anak idap TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ponorogo Health Office records 254 children with TB
article.articleSummary: TB in Ponorogo, East Java, Indonesia: By end-September 2026, 254 children under 14 have been diagnosed with tuberculosis out of 928 total TB cases. Active case finding aims to detect cases early for timely treatment and to reduce transmission within families and the community. TB in children often coincides with stunting; persistent lack of weight gain should prompt further testing, not reliance on cough alone. Transmission occurs via contact with TB patients, including family members or others in crowded environments. Diagnosis requires laboratory sputum testing and chest X-ray for suspected cases. Parents are advised to seek medical evaluation for ongoing health issues or failure to gain weight in children.

triage.headline_ja: ポノロゴ保健局、254人の子供が結核に罹患していると報告
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアの地方で地方病的に流行している疾患であり、本記事は通常の症例報告・啓発活動であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアで地方病的（endemic）に流行しており、本記事は地域保健局の定期的な症例数報告・予防啓発の内容であるため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: एसकेएमसीएच में होगी कालाजार की निगरानी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kala-azar surveillance at SKMCH.
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis (Kala-azar) surveillance workshop held at SKMCH in Muzaffarpur, Bihar. WHO regional coordinator Dr. Madhuri Devaraju outlined Bihar’s Kala-azar status, noting a 29% year-on-year reduction in visceral leishmaniasis and a 37% drop in post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL). In 2026 Muzaffarpur recorded 33 Kala-azar cases, with 33% concentrated in five blocks. Experts focused on eliminating remaining transmission links, strengthening SKMCH surveillance, regular case follow-up, and improved dossier documentation. The event was chaired by SKMCH Principal Prof. Dr. Vibhha Kumari, with inputs from Dr. Mahesh Kumar and specialists including Dr. Gopal Shankar Sahni (pediatrics) and Dr. Amit (General Medicine). Attendees included DM Office Dr. Rajesh Kumar and VBDC officials. The discussion emphasized adult vs. child symptomatology and new treatment approaches.

triage.headline_ja: SKMCHにおけるカラ・アザール（内臓リーシュマニア症）のサーベイランス
triage.triage_reason: カラ・アザール排除に向けた既存の対策会議・サーベイランス強化の報告であり、症例数は減少傾向にあるため異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はビハール州ムザファルプルにおけるカラ・アザール排除プログラムの定例ワークショップ報告であり、症例数は前年比で減少傾向（29%減）。新規の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: संचारी रोग नियंत्रण के लिए माइक्रो प्लान बनाकर करें काम : डीएम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Make a micro plan for communicable disease control and put it into action: DM.
article.articleSummary: Bijnor district in Uttar Pradesh will launch a month-long Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign from October 1 to October 31, 2026. District Magistrate Umesh Pratap Singh directed micro-planning across departments and on-ground action, urging coordinated efforts in education and health sectors. Preparations were reviewed at the Mahatma Vidur Hall, with planned surprise inspections of the district hospital, community health centers, and other facilities. Despite available funding, negligence will invite action. The meeting also reviewed the Janani Suraksha Yojana to boost institutional deliveries and urged health workers to improve patient service. A chart on the status of undernourished and severely undernourished children was requested for the next meeting. Sensitization workshops for officials will be completed on schedule. Programs reviewed included Family Planning, TB, RCF Portal, e-Sanjeevani, e-Kavach, and vaccination. Attendees included CDO Ranvijay Singh and CMO Kaushalendra Singh.

triage.headline_ja: 伝染病対策のためのマイクロプランを策定し実行せよ：DM（地区行政官）
triage.triage_reason: 行政の定例的な感染症対策キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的なアウトブレイクや症例急増の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核を含む複数の疾病対策プログラムのレビューと月間キャンペーンの告知に関する行政記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクイベントを報告するものではない。対象国リストには該当するがイベント性が低いため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 群众健康|幼童合胞病毒爆发：分清症状针对治疗 避免耽误病情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Health | Respiratory Syncytial Virus Outbreak in Young Children: Differentiate Symptoms to Guide Treatment and Prevent Delays in Care
article.articleSummary: RSV outbreak in Xi’an among hospitalized children aged 0–4 has risen to among the top three causes of severe respiratory infection since late August. Xi’an Medical College Children's Hospital (Xi’an Qidi Children’s Hospital) reports the highest risk in children under 5, especially under 2 years old. RSV primarily affects the lower respiratory tract, causing cough, wheeze, and rapid breathing; without intervention it can progress to bronchiolitis, pneumonia, hypoxia, respiratory failure, dehydration, and, in some survivors, recurrent wheeze or increased asthma risk. High-risk groups include preterm infants, those ≤6 months, children with underlying cardiopulmonary disease, and immunocompromised kids. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, ventilation, avoiding crowded enclosed spaces, and avoiding unnecessary antibiotics or cough medicines. The hospital offers a six-pathogen respiratory panel; sampling before 11:00 yields results by 15:00, with 24/7 care. Early recognition, testing, and timely intervention are key. Location: Xi’an, Shaanxi, China.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生｜幼児のRSV（呼吸器合胞体ウイルス）感染拡大：症状を見分けて適切な治療を行い、病状の悪化を防ごう
triage.triage_reason: RSVは季節性疾患であり通常の小児呼吸器感染症として報告されている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、医療機関による一般向け啓発記事の域を出ない。
triage.notes: RSVは季節性の既知病原体であり、記事内容も一般向けの症状説明・予防啓発が中心。重症例や死亡者数の急増等、異常を示す情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar esquistossomose em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves medication to treat schistosomiasis in children.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approved registration of Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel for treating schistosomiasis caused by Schistosoma mansoni or Schistosoma haematobium in children aged 3 months to 6 years. The decision, published in the Diário Oficial da União on 2026-09-30, marks a public-health milestone for tropical neglected diseases predominantly affecting low-income populations in Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, and South America. Schistosomiasis is a neglected tropical disease with a spectrum from asymptomatic infection to severe clinical disease. Arpraziquantel is absorbed by worms in the bloodstream; it induces muscular spasms and paralysis, disrupting their attachment to blood vessels and damaging the parasite's tegument, enabling the immune system to destroy them. The approval expands pediatric treatment options and supports efforts to control morbidity in endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ、小児の住血吸虫症治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 新規治療薬の承認に関する規制ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル規制当局による医薬品承認のニュースであり、アウトブレイクや感染症の異常発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: उरणमध्ये डेंग्यू-मलेरियाचा डंख
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue-Malaria Sting in Uran
article.articleSummary: Fever, dengue and malaria cases are rising in Uran taluka due to changing monsoon conditions, with additional reports of cough/cold and vomiting/diarrhea. The past month has seen several dengue patients, prompting health authorities to urge gram panchayats to intensify sanitation and mosquito-control measures. Residents report inadequate execution of regular cleanliness, removal of stagnant water, and elimination of breeding sites, stressing shared responsibility beyond the health department. The surge is straining Uran’s health services, which include only one rural hospital and one primary health center; citizens demand additional primary health centers, doctors, nurses, and facilities. Reports of private clinics being full and patients treated on floors highlight capacity gaps. Citizens call for investigations of doctors’ qualifications, registrations, and unauthorized practice, and for stricter sanitation and mosquito-control efforts in Uran city and areas including Chanje, Jasai, Koproli, Chirner, Kalambusare, Vindhane, Karla, Sonari, Chirle, Avare, Vasheni, Bandhapada, Pirkon, Sarde, Navghar, Veshvi, and Belpada.

triage.headline_ja: ウランでデング熱・マラリアが猛威
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン時期のインド・ウラン地域における季節性デング熱・マラリアの増加で、医療体制の逼迫が報告されているが、国際的拡大や異常性を示す根拠はなく、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・マハーラーシュトラ州ウラン地域（Uran taluka）に限定した地方報道で、モンスーン期の季節性デング・マラリア増加と医療体制の不足（診療所不足、医師・看護師不足）を訴える内容。他地域（コロンビア、ブルキナファソ、中央アフリカ共和国）の地名はBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリー上では言及されていないため除外した。重症度・死亡者数等の詳細情報がなく、国際的拡大の兆候もないためWATCH判定とした。
