article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma nova morte por gripe e total chega a 34 - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms a new death from influenza and the total reaches 34 - ACidade ON Campinas.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil reports a new influenza-related death due to severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) in 2026, bringing the year’s cases to 377 and deaths to 34. The latest victim is a 92-year-old vaccinated woman with no comorbidities; the death occurred July 22. In 2026 Campinas has 34 influenza deaths; in 2025 there were 561 SARI cases and 69 deaths, 54 of which were among the unvaccinated. Vaccination is available to anyone 6 months and older at 69 health centers, with no appointment needed, protecting against influenza A (H1N1, H3N2) and B and compatible with other vaccines. By Sept 1, 363,664 doses had been administered: elderly 128,757 (57.56%), children six months to under six years 37,020 (54.18%), pregnant women 7,145 (83.09%). Expansion to all ages 6 months+ began June 1. Preventive measures include handwashing, ventilation, hydration, healthy diet, and masking for symptomatic individuals; details are on the Campinas Health Department site.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市、インフルエンザによる新たな死亡例を確認、累計34人に - ACidade ON Campinas
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する地域保健当局の定例サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1/H3N2/B)の通常流行期の報告で、ワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗も含まれる。地域保健当局が通常体制で対応しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Lampung Selatan perkuat pencegahan dan pengendalian penyakit ATM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Lampung strengthens prevention and control of ATM disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-30, South Lampung Regency (Lampung Selatan) in Indonesia prepared social contracting to strengthen prevention and control of AIDS, TB, and malaria (ATM), via civil society organizations and community groups, with implementation planned for 2027 under Grant Cycle 8 (2027–2029). The workshop in Kalianda (Aula Rajabasa) featured Devi Arminanto, Head of Lampung Selatan Health Office, and Dr. Indrasari Aulia of Lampung Province Health Office. The approach uses swakelola Type 3 (civil society) and Type 4 (community groups), requiring cross-department coordination. The program aligns with Minimal Service Standards in health and national strategic programs. Objective: boost outreach and ensure ATM control beyond government services, strengthening government-community collaboration to prevent AIDS, TB, and malaria in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 南ランプン県、AIDS・結核・マラリア（ATM）の予防と対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の保健プログラム計画・会議に関する行政的内容であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 2027年からのグラントサイクルに向けた予防強化策の発表であり、現時点で疾病の急増や異常事態は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Após espera por vaga, menino com suspeita de febre maculosa será transferido -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After waiting for a hospital bed, a boy with suspected Rocky Mountain spotted fever will be transferred -- AconteceuMS.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) suspected in a 2-year-old boy in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. The child, exposed to a tick at his grandmother’s home, began fever on Sept 27 and developed a rash with red petechiae on the hands, legs, lips, inner mouth, and throat; mouth blisters appeared by today. He has waited nearly a day for a hospital bed and is awaiting ambulance transfer from Pronto Atendimento Pediátrico Tiradentes to Hospital de Câncer Alfredo Abrão; authorities say he is stable. The case is entered in Sinan as suspected RMSF, with confirmation requiring two serological tests whose results may take about two weeks to 21 days. The last confirmed RMSF in Mato Grosso do Sul was in 2018 (a 34-year-old man from Campo Grande who had traveled to Sidrolândia). RMSF is transmitted by the star tick, is potentially fatal, and presents with fever, severe headache, nausea/vomiting, abdominal pain, myalgia, and a characteristic rash; progression can include gangrene and respiratory failure.

triage.headline_ja: 病床待機の末、紅斑熱(ロッキー山紅斑熱)疑いの少年が転院へ -- AconteceuMS
triage.triage_reason: 単発の疑い症例(未確定)であり、ダニ媒介性で人-人感染なし。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、重症化しうる疾患であり続報(血清確認)を注視する。
triage.notes: 本件はブラジル国内の単発疑い症例報道であり、確定診断（血清学的検査、結果判明まで最大21日）待ちの段階。マダニ媒介性疾患でヒト-ヒト感染なし、過去の確定例は2018年にさかのぼる地域限定的事例。

article.articleHeadline: Detento diagnosticado com tuberculose morre em presídio de Rio Branco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inmate diagnosed with tuberculosis dies in Rio Branco prison.
article.articleSummary: An inmate at Rio Branco's Complexo Penal in Acre, Brazil, died on September 30, 2026, after being diagnosed with tuberculosis. Caio Henrique Anedino Pena was in Pavilion B of the Division of Penitentiary Establishment for the Provisional and Semi-Open Regime (DEPRPSA), in a cell dedicated to inmates undergoing TB treatment. Around 6:20 am, guards found him unresponsive; SAMU responders, with advanced life support under Dr. Eduardo Formiga, confirmed death. The cell, shared with two other inmates, was isolated and preserved for procedures by the Instituto Médico-Legal (IML). Detainee health care at the Complex Penal is provided through a partnership among Semsa, the Acre state government, Iapen, and Sesacre. Iapen and the Penal Police emphasized ongoing commitment to health care and state responsibilities for people in custody.

triage.headline_ja: リオブランコの刑務所で結核と診断された収容者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内における個別の結核死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大やアウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、単発の医療対応事例として扱われている。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の疾患であり、刑務所内での個別死亡例に留まる。集団感染やアウトブレイクを示唆する記述はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Perbedaan Gejala Flu Biasa dan Influenza Tipe A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Differences in Symptoms Between Seasonal Flu and Influenza Type A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Indonesia, but Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin says the situation is not yet alarming. The article distinguishes seasonal flu from influenza A, noting that the so-called 'super flu' label is common in public discourse yet not an official term used by WHO or CDC. Symptoms such as headache, fever, and sneezing are described as typical for flu and are also present with influenza A, contributing to confusion about severity. The piece emphasizes the need to differentiate ordinary flu from influenza A, and directs readers to a video explainer for details. It cites Alicia Diahwahyuningtyas and Irawan Sapto Adhi as writers and mentions related coverage. While laboratory confirmation or exact case counts are not provided, the overall message is that influenza activity in Indonesia is rising but not currently deemed a public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザとA型インフルエンザの症状の違い
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでA型インフルエンザ症例が増加しているが、保健大臣は「まだ警戒すべき状況ではない」としており、検査確定や症例数など具体的情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザとA型インフルエンザの症状の違いを説明する解説記事であり、具体的な症例数や検査確定情報は含まれていない。保健当局は公衆衛生上の緊急事態とは見なしていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pancaroba Tiba, Bukan Cuma Flu! 3 Penyakit Ini Berisiko Melonjak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The change of season has arrived—it's not just the flu! These three diseases are at risk of surging.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health warns that the pancaroba transition from dry to rainy seasons heightens the risk of dengue fever (DBD), diarrhea, and leptospirosis, alongside influenza and other acute respiratory infections (ARIs). In areas with standing water or floods, dengue-carrying Aedes mosquitoes proliferate in stagnant pools, while disruptions to water quality and food supply raise diarrhea risk. The warning emphasizes that seasonal climate changes can influence disease transmission and public health across Indonesia. The briefing is delivered as a video by Afif Khoirul Muttaqin and Irawan Sapto Adhi, with narration by Wiyudha Betha Dinaragis. The report provides no specific case counts or outbreak totals.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目到来、インフルエンザだけじゃない！急増リスクのある3つの病気
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの報告がなく、異常性・緊急性も認められない。
triage.notes: 季節変化に伴う一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例や症例数の報告はない。インドネシア保健省による予防的注意喚起にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Cholera-Todesfälle 2025 um 30 Prozent gestiegen - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of cholera deaths in 2025 has risen by 30 percent - Deutsches Ärzteblatt.
article.articleSummary: Cholera deaths in 2025 rose 30% to 7,870, despite fewer WHO-reported cases (451,499) across 47 countries, the highest annual death toll since 1999. The WHO Africa region faced the largest burden, with cases up 34% and deaths up 58% vs. 2024. About 90% of global cholera cases and deaths occurred in seven countries: Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, and Yemen. Cholera is an acute diarrheal disease caused by Vibrio cholerae, spreading via contaminated food and water where safe water and sanitation are lacking; rapid dehydration treatment can be life-saving. More than one-fifth of deaths occurred outside health facilities; in-facility mortality rates are under 1%. Global oral cholera vaccine production more than doubled from 2022 to 2025 (≈30 million to ≈80 million doses annually). The ICG approved 71 million doses for affected countries, including 20 million for preventive use.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年のコレラ死亡者数が30%増加 - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
triage.triage_reason: 2025年のコレラ死亡者数が1999年以降で最多となり、アフリカ地域を中心に死亡率・重症度が顕著に上昇しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界コレラ年次統計の概説であり、7カ国（アンゴラ、バングラデシュ、DRC、ナイジェリア、南スーダン、スーダン、イエメン）が全体の9割を占めると報告。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが該当国として明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: नोएडा में डेंगू-मलेरिया की रोकथाम के लिए अक्टूबर में चलेगा विशेष अभियान, सेक्टरों और गांवों में होगी एंटी लार्वा स्प्रे व फॉगिंग - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A special campaign to prevent dengue and malaria will be launched in Noida in October; anti-larval spraying and fogging will be carried out in sectors and villages.
article.articleSummary: Noida authorities announced a special October campaign to curb vector-borne diseases, including malaria, dengue, and chikungunya, across sectors and villages under Work Circles 01–05. Daily anti-larval spraying and fogging will follow a roster to target mosquito breeding sites such as pits, drains, and any standing water. Teams will also fog in hedges, vacant and high-risk areas identified for infestation. The effort emphasizes identifying actual breeding habitats rather than mere formalities, with health inspectors and supervisors issued guidelines to ensure resources like fogging machines and anti-larval agents are available. Public participation is deemed essential; residents are urged to remove standing water from homes and surroundings—coolers, pots, rooftops, old containers, tires—and report persistent water accumulation. Timely drainage and cleaning are expected to curb mosquito proliferation and keep Noida mosquito-free.

triage.headline_ja: ノイダでデング熱・マラリア予防のため10月に特別キャンペーンを実施、各セクター・村で防虫幼虫駆除スプレーとフォギングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的な蚊媒介性疾患対策キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増等を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な蚊媒介性疾患対策の行政対応についてのもので、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告はない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Noida, a special campaign will be launched in October to prevent dengue and malaria; larvicidal spray and fogging will be carried out in sectors and villages.
article.articleSummary: Noida Authority launches an October campaign to curb vector-borne diseases and rising mosquito prevalence. Across Work Circles 01–05, sectors and villages will follow a daily roster of anti-larval spray and fogging to curb malaria, dengue, and chikungunya transmission. Teams will identify mosquito breeding sites, inspecting pits, drains, and other water-collection spots; wherever water accumulates, larvicidal spray will be deployed. Fogging will also be conducted in shrubs, vacant lots, and dirty areas with higher mosquito breeding risk. Health inspectors and supervisors have been issued guidelines to systematically execute the operation and ensure availability of fogging machines and anti-larval spray. Community participation is emphasized: residents should eliminate standing water in homes and surroundings—coolers, pots, rooftops, old containers, tires, etc.—and report persistent waterlogging to authorities. Noida aims for a clean, healthy, mosquito-free environment.

triage.headline_ja: ノイダ市でデング熱・マラリア予防のため10月に特別キャンペーン実施、地区・村落で防虫剤散布と燻蒸を実施
triage.triage_reason: ノイダ市当局による定例的な蚊媒介感染症予防キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な行政キャンペーンの告知であり、実際の症例数や流行状況についての具体的データは含まれていない。地域はインド（ノイダ、ウッタル・プラデーシュ州）だが、対象国リストに含まれるインドはイベントの主題ではなく予防活動の実施地であるため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Границы между видами стерты: как опасный вирус унес частицу человеческого кода в свой геном
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The boundaries between species have been erased: how a dangerous virus carried a fragment of human genetic code into its genome.
article.articleSummary: Two independent insertions of the human BC200 non-coding RNA gene have been found in the genome of Molluscum contagiosum virus, marking the first confirmed case of human sequence integrated into a viral genome. Researchers from China and the United States report in Science that BC200, which does not code a protein but produces regulatory RNA in neurons, likely remained mobilizable after its domestication. Comparative analyses suggest LINE-1 retrotransposition mediated the transfer, enabling RNAs including BC200 to be reverse-transcribed and inserted in viral DNA, probably in skin cells where Molluscum contagiosum replicates. Evolutionary reconstructions place the ancestral BC200 insertion at approximately 40 million years ago, with hundreds of later insertions across studied species, indicating repeated transposition over millions of years. Similar BC200 insertion patterns are present in human genomes, with population-specific variants and unique copies, underscoring ongoing genomic plasticity.

triage.headline_ja: 種の境界は消えた：危険なウイルスがどのようにヒト遺伝コードの断片を自身のゲノムに取り込んだか
triage.triage_reason: 進化生物学・ウイルスゲノム研究に関する学術報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や感染拡大、重症化等のリスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は伝染性軟属腫ウイルスのゲノムにヒトBC200遺伝子が組み込まれた進化学的発見についての科学報道であり、公衆衛生イベントではない。地域情報（米国・中国）は研究者の所属機関を示すものであり、感染症発生地域ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola pressiona hospitais e equipes no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak puts pressure on hospitals and healthcare teams in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Ituri, and Butembo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are grappling with the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the country, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. By Sep 28, 2026, the outbreak surpassed 8,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths since it began in May. North Kivu alone reported over 1,300 cases with a fatality rate above 62%; Ituri's CFR is about 45% as transmission starts to decline. Health facilities in Butembo's Kitatumba and other centers are overwhelmed, with overflow into transit centers due to bed shortages. Ongoing violence hampers access, disrupts contact tracing, and even attacks on hospitals threaten responders. Survivors are aiding response; examples include a baby whose mother died in birth, and several recovered patients who later work in treatment centers, leveraging acquired immunity. Community mistrust and fear delay care, hindering containment; MSF notes urban spread and late community engagement complicate control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴの病院と医療チームに圧力をかける
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（8,000例以上、死者3,901人）が継続し、重症度・国際拡大リスクが高く、紛争地域での対応困難も伴うためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率の高さ（北キブ62%以上、イトゥリ45%）、都市部への拡大、紛争による対応阻害、MSFによるコミュニティエンゲージメントの遅れの指摘など、重大な懸念材料が複数存在する。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo politician killed for defending Ebola measures - ruling party -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Marie-Celestin Karondwa, UDPS spokesperson in Butembo, DR Congo, died after an assault following a radio appearance defending Ebola measures; his property was looted and home set on fire. The UDPS links the attack to his stance on the existence of Ebola and related measures; motive under investigation. The killing underscores resistance to Ebola response in eastern DR Congo, with the WHO noting insecurity and attacks on health facilities that hinder containment, surveillance, and access to care. Between May 17 and mid-August, WHO counted 12 attacks on health care, with additional incidents under verification. As of September 27, DR Congo reported 8,116 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,924 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%), caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists, though candidates are studied. Russia provided aid, sending specialists and Russian PCR tests to Uganda, DR Congo, and Republic of Congo; Lavrov indicated vaccine production for Bundibugyo strain could begin once material is obtained.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の政治家、エボラ対策を擁護したために殺害される - 与党発表 -- RTアフリカ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（8,116症例、致死率48.3%）が継続し、治安悪化により対応が妨害されている重大な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（北キブ州・ブテンボ）でのエボラ対応に対する暴力・妨害行為と、大規模な流行状況（致死率48.3%、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス、ワクチン未承認）を報告。ウガンダ・ロシアへの言及は支援提供国としてであり、対象国リストに該当する発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Apa Itu Influenza A | tempo.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What Is Influenza A | tempo.co.
article.articleSummary: Several regions in Indonesia report influenza activity, with the Ministry of Health noting a rise in positive influenza specimens to 46% in week 36, up from 35% in week 35. Of 185 specimens tested, 86 were positive: 76 Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, 8 Influenza A(H3N2), and 2 Influenza B Victoria. The H1N1pdm09 subtype accounted for more than 80% of detected influenza viruses, indicating the dominant lineage in the current activity. Despite this uptick, the Ministry classifies national influenza activity as low and under control, suggesting no widespread severe transmission at present.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAとは何か | tempo.co
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの陽性率上昇が報告されているが、保健省は国内の活動レベルを低く管理下にあると分類しており、異常な公衆衛生上の脅威とは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09が優勢）に関する解説的な内容であり、保健省は『低く管理下にある』と評価している。通常の季節的変動の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: जिसको समझ नॉर्मल बुखार वो निकला स्क्रब टाइफस, हो गई छात्र की मौत, जानें क्या है ये बीमारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What was thought to be a normal fever turned out to be scrub typhus; a student dies—know what this disease is.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, a 20-year-old student at Anna University in Tamil Nadu died from scrub typhus after about four days of high fever. On admission, he exhibited altered sensorium (confusion), slurred speech, and breathing difficulties; dengue tests were negative, while scrub typhus serology was positive. Scrub typhus is caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and is transmitted via chigger mites found in grass and brush. Early fever, headache, body pains, weakness, and rashes are typical; timely diagnosis and treatment can prevent severe outcomes. Delays may involve lungs, kidneys, liver, brain, or heart, with potentially fatal consequences such as respiratory distress, confusion or fainting, hypotension, and multi-organ dysfunction. The report urges urgent hospital care for persistent high fever with worsening condition, noting that self-management or delayed care can be dangerous.

triage.headline_ja: 普通の発熱だと思われたものがツツガムシ病と判明、学生が死亡――この病気について知る
triage.triage_reason: 単発の学生死亡事例であり、流行や大規模発生を示す情報はないが、感染症による死亡例として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、地域的流行や集団発生の情報は含まれていない。ツツガムシ病はインドの一部地域で季節的に報告される疾患であり、これ単独では大規模リスク評価に進む根拠は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Temuan Data Terkini Ada 26,8 Ribu Kasus TBC Baru dari CKG Nasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Data Findings: 26,800 New TB Cases From National CKG
article.articleSummary: In Indonesia, the National Free Health Screening Program (CKG) screened 20.6 million people, identifying 360.7 thousand with signs/symptoms suggestive of tuberculosis (TB) and 26.8 thousand new TB cases. Screening spans from puskesmas (community health centers) to schools and pesantren. Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono says these findings support government efforts to curb TB, noting a downward national trend: 2024 estimated TB cases around 1,092,000; 2025 around 1,090,000; 2026 projected about 1,080,000. Since 2024, TB treatment duration has shortened from 9–20 months to 6 months under the RO/BPaL-M regimen, with a new regimen under TB Alliance aiming for about 1 month. Prevention via Siaga TB mobilizes 9,759 villages across 154 regencies/cities in 29 provinces, with weekly monitoring and joint evaluation by central and regional authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 最新データ:国民健康スクリーニング(CKG)から新規結核症例2万6800件判明
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで既知の流行病であり、本記事は政府の全国スクリーニングプログラムによる症例把握と減少傾向を報告する通常の公衆衛生活動であるため、異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核罹患数は減少傾向にあり、国家プログラムによる定期的なスクリーニング報告。緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak exceeds 8,000 cases
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-30, the DRC reports 8,067 Ebola cases, 3,901 deaths, and 2,070 recoveries since the current crisis began, a 48.4% case fatality rate. The outbreak started in northeastern Ituri and has spread to seven provinces, with Ituri, North Kivu, and Upper-Uele accounting for most cases. After a rapid rise, case numbers have levelled off but authorities say the outbreak is not under control. Trials are underway for treatments and vaccines against the Bundibugjo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Remote-area response is hampered by armed groups, mistrust, and violence against humanitarian workers; a health worker was killed at a North Kivu checkpoint, and Ituri faces a complete shortage of stocks of an experimental Bundibugyo vaccine in Tshopo. About 70,000 Ervebo doses have been allocated to the DRC in August, with first doses given to frontline staff in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生、8,000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.4%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクがDRC7州に拡大し、治療・ワクチンが未承認で、武装勢力による人道支援妨害も発生しており、国際的拡大・管理困難性の観点から複数のIHR・WPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、治験段階。武装勢力による妨害や医療従事者殺害など治安上の課題も深刻。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: बालाघाट में अचानक फैली बीमारी को काबू में करने के लिए एक्शन में MP सरकार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MP Government Takes Action to Contain Sudden Disease Outbreak in Balaghat
article.articleSummary: Sudden fever with rash in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, in July prompted a rapid government response. The District Rapid Response Team (DRRT) was activated; pediatricians, epidemiologists and entomologists were deployed, with national teams visiting affected areas. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav directed decisive action. In 50 villages, 43,451 people were screened; 6,537 treated at home; 647 severely ill children hospitalized. Birsa development block saw measles–rubella vaccination for 35,827 children. Diarrhea prevention reached 163,902 families with ORS and zinc. Malaria control included spraying 8,610 homes, 26,865 tests, 980 positives, and 3,600 nets distributed. Infrastructure funding covered safe transport for pregnant women and children (₹3.60 lakh) and vaccine logistics (₹3.40 lakh); repairs for 22 sub-centers (₹1.93 crore) and equipment (₹24 lakh); Ghummur PHC upgrade proposed (₹66 lakh); 54 new doctors. Over 23 years, institutional births rose to 92.1% and full immunization to 92.7%; maternal mortality fell from 176 to 60 and infant mortality from 3,805 to 1,560, saving about 2,650 maternal and 51,600 infant lives.

triage.headline_ja: バラガートで突然発生した疾病を抑制するためMP州政府が行動
triage.triage_reason: 7月にマダヤプラデシュ州バラガート県で原因不明の発熱・発疹アウトブレイクが発生し政府が大規模対応を行ったが、本記事は既に対応済みの状況報告であり、病原体の特定情報や国際的拡大の兆候は不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア単体ではなく、原因不明の発熱・発疹アウトブレイク（7月発生）への包括的な公衆衛生対応（麻疹風疹ワクチン接種、下痢対策、マラリア対策等）をまとめた行政報告。病原体の確定診断情報がなく、既に州政府・国の対応チームにより収束に向かっている模様。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Health experts flag need for immediate wound care, medication to fight rabies
article.articleSummary: Public health experts in Keralam urge immediate wound care and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) after animal exposure to align with zero human rabies deaths by 2030. In 2026, 15 human rabies deaths have been reported, all but one after exposure for which PEP was not taken; most cases followed dog bites, with five deaths having unknown exposure. A new concern is deaths from exposures to wild animals—leopard, wild cat, fox, jackal and mongoose—over two to three years. About 50% of animal bites are dog bites; stray dogs account for roughly 30% of dog bites, underscoring the role of domestic dog vaccination and licensing. Last year saw six deaths despite PEP; this year one death. Lax wound washing and suboptimal immunoglobulin administration are cited as avoidable factors. The WHO-funded Integrated Bite Case Management (IBCM) project and One Health approach promote community involvement and mass dog vaccination as cost-effective control.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病対策として、動物咬傷後の即時の創傷処置と薬剤投与の必要性を専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州における狂犬病死亡例は例年発生している地域風土病であり、新規の異常発生や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、既存の公衆衛生対策（PEP・ワクチン接種）の改善を呼びかける啓発記事である。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインド・ケララ州で継続的に発生している地域風土病であり、本記事は2030年までのヒト狂犬病ゼロ目標に向けた予防啓発・医療体制改善の呼びかけが主旨。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はないため、フルRRAの対象とはしない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS urge a aplicar un plan de 1.300 millones de dólares para contener el ébola en la RDC - Diario de Santiago. Noticias de Santiago de Compostela y Galicia.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urges the implementation of a $1.3 billion plan to contain Ebola in the DRC - Diario de Santiago. News from Santiago de Compostela and Galicia.
article.articleSummary: WHO urges a $1.3 billion, six-month plan to intensify Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as cases exceed 8,000 and deaths near 3,900. The multisector plan, announced Sept 4 by the DRC government with WHO, UN, Africa CDC and partners, aims to expand hospital capacity, diagnostic laboratories, and safe burial teams, targeting 1,830 beds by late September and over 1,400 additional health workers. Focus centers on hard-to-reach Mangala in Ituri Province (341 cases, 149 deaths), with patients often moved to Nizi or Bunia for care. Daily alerts rose to about 2,000 (90% verified); contact tracing exceeds 85%. As of Sept 27, 8,116 infections, 3,924 deaths, 2,088 recoveries, and 817 currently hospitalized or isolated, across 63 health zones in Ituri, Tshopo, Bas‑Uélé, Haut‑Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. It is the second deadliest Ebola outbreak globally.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ出血熱封じ込めに13億ドルの計画実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な規模の流行）し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC国内（Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, South Ubangi）での大規模エボラ流行（世界で2番目に死者数が多い流行）とWHOによる13億ドル対応計画への言及。発生地域にAustraliaが含まれるが記事内容と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova registro de medicamento para tratamento de esquistossomose infantil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves drug registration for the treatment of pediatric schistosomiasis.
article.articleSummary: As of September 30, 2026, Brazil’s National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) approved the registration of Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel for the treatment of schistosomiasis in children aged three months to six years. Schistosomiasis is a neglected tropical disease affecting tropical and subtropical regions, primarily low-income populations, ranging from asymptomatic to severe illness. The active ingredient is absorbed by worms lodged in the bloodstream, triggering strong muscle spasms and paralysis and damaging the worm tegument, enabling the immune system to clear the parasites. The medication targets Schistosoma mansoni and Schistosoma haematobium. The approval provides a new pediatric therapeutic option, strengthening control efforts in endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ、小児住血吸虫症治療薬の登録を承認
triage.triage_reason: 新規感染症発生や流行の報告ではなく、既存の顧みられない熱帯病に対する治療薬の承認に関するニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は薬事承認に関する内容であり、感染症の発生・流行イベントではないため対象国の発生地域としては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Pato Branco registra sete casos de varicela em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pato Branco records seven cases of varicella in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak in Pato Branco, Brazil, with seven confirmed cases in 2026. The Municipal Health Secretariat warns of overdue doses and emphasizes vaccination in all active vaccination rooms. In 2025, the city had four outbreaks totaling 14 infections, including three in daycares and one in a hospital setting. Vaccination is the main prevention to reduce infection risk, limit transmission, and prevent complications, especially for vulnerable groups. The routine schedule requires two doses: first at 15 months via the tetraviral vaccine, second at four years. The public network maximum vaccination age is six years, 11 months, and 29 days, so check for any pending doses. Vaccines available at neighborhood units and the Central vaccination room, with hours: neighborhoods Mon–Fri 7:30–11:30 and 13:00–16:30; Central 7:30–17:30. Bring photo ID and vaccination card.

triage.headline_ja: パト・ブランコ市、2026年に水痘7例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は既知の予防可能疾患で局所的な小規模発生に留まり、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による日常的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、予防接種推奨が主目的。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Escola na Grande BH suspende aulas após 14 casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in Greater Belo Horizonte suspends classes after 14 cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: In Lagoa Santa, a municipal school in the Greater Belo Horizonte area of Minas Gerais, Brazil, suspended classes for two days after confirming 14 cases of human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) among students and staff at Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Lacerda in Moradas da Lapinha. The first case was identified on September 18, and two staff members were also diagnosed. The Municipal Education and Health secretaries, with SES-MG, activated outbreak measures including a full cleaning of classrooms, pest control, and sanitization of the water tank. Transmission occurs mainly through direct, prolonged contact and via contaminated clothing or bedding. Parents were notified, and students with severe itching or skin lesions were advised not to attend until evaluated at a health unit. A separate outbreak in Andradas involved 11 children at a municipal daycare, with two days of suspension and cleaning before return on the 29th.

triage.headline_ja: 大ベロオリゾンテ圏の学校、ヒゼンダニ症14例確認で休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤度が低く、国際的拡大リスクもない局地的な学校内アウトブレイクであり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染する皮膚疾患であり、地域保健当局によるローカルな対応（清掃・消毒・休校）で管理可能な事例。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: L'OMS rapporte les dernières tendances mondiales en matière de choléra, de méningite et de peste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: WHO Reports the Latest Global Trends in Cholera, Meningitis, and Plague.
article.articleSummary: Cholera: In 2025, cholera deaths rose 30% with 451,499 cases and 7,870 deaths reported to WHO across 47 countries—the highest annual cholera deaths since 1999. About 90% of cases and deaths occurred in seven countries: Angola, Bangladesh, Nigeria, DR Congo, Sudan, South Sudan, and Yemen, with Africa bearing the heaviest burden; cases in Africa rose 34% and deaths 58% since 2024. Vaccination progress: oral cholera vaccine production more than doubled (30 million to 80 million doses annually, 2022–2025); the GIC approved 71 million doses, including 20 million for preventive campaigns. Meningitis: 2025 saw 21,526 suspected bacterial meningitis cases and 971 deaths reported by 24 of 26 African-region countries (case fatality 4.5%), a 5.9% fall in cases where data exist. Vaccination, notably MenA conjugate and Men5CV/MMCV, transformed control; Niger led a national campaign in 2025. Plague: 2019–2025 recorded 3,847 suspected cases and 423 deaths (11% CFR) in 10 countries, mainly Madagascar and DR Congo; endemic foci persist and surveillance remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：WHOがコレラ、髄膜炎、ペストに関する最新の世界的傾向を報告
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次グローバルトレンド報告であり、DRCはコレラ・ペストの主要負担国として継続的に言及されているが、新規の緊急事態発生を示す具体的情報はなく、既存の流行状況の統計的まとめに留まる。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの世界的な疾病動向（コレラ・髄膜炎・ペスト）に関する年次統計レポートであり、対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが主要負担国として言及されている（コレラの90%burden国の一つ、ペストも主にマダガスカルとDRCで発生）。新規アウトブレイクの発生を示す情報ではなく、既存の流行継続に関するマクロ統計のため、個別国に対する即時のRRAよりも継続的な動向観察が妥当と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Why Makerere's $10,000-scientist drive aims to shield Africa from pandemics - The Observer Media Ltd
article.articleSummary: Makerere University's five-year ACT-PREP program, launched Sept 28, 2026, aims to end Africa's dependence on Western clinical data by building a continent-wide epidemic-preparedness network. The initiative spans Uganda, Rwanda, Tanzania, the DRC, Somalia, South Sudan, Senegal, and Europe, and will upgrade regional laboratories while training more than 10,000 African scientists, including 15 PhD candidates and 10 postdoctoral fellows. Target pathogens include Ebola, Marburg, and mpox, with cross-border activity in Eastern and Central Africa. It embraces a One Health approach, linking animal and environmental drivers to human disease. Two systemic vulnerabilities cited are funding delays and misinformation; governments are urged to create emergency mechanisms and foster community trust to counter rumours. Long-term goal: empower local testing and rapid deployment of life-saving treatments when the next outbreak arrives, reducing reliance on foreign donors rather than publishing more papers.

triage.headline_ja: マケレレ大学の「1万人科学者」育成プログラムがアフリカをパンデミックから守る理由
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、大学主導の人材育成・研究能力強化プログラムに関する記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、Makerere大学による5年間のエピデミック対応能力強化プログラム（ACT-PREP）の立ち上げに関する報道。DRC等は対象地域として言及されているが、実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar esquistossomose em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves a drug to treat schistosomiasis in children.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) approved registration of Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel for treating schistosomiasis caused by Schistosoma mansoni or Schistosoma haematobium in children aged 3 months to 6 years, with the resolution published in the Official Journal of the Union (Diário Oficial da União). Schistosomiasis is highlighted as a neglected tropical disease and a public health problem in tropical and subtropical regions across Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, and South America, predominantly impacting low‑income populations and ranging from asymptomatic to severe clinical forms. The medication works after absorption by worms in bloodstream vessels, causing muscle spasms and paralysis, which disrupts their attachment to vessels; it also damages the parasite’s tegument, enabling destruction by the host immune system. No outbreak or case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、小児向けの住血吸虫症治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 新規の薬事承認に関する報道であり、アウトブレイクや症例数の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は薬事承認のニュースであり、アウトブレイク情報ではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes Sebut Influenza A Umumnya Sembuh Sendiri, Kelompok Rentan Tetap Perlu Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister Says Influenza A Generally Resolves Itself; Vulnerable Groups Still Need to Be Vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A generally self-limiting in Indonesia, with most cases resolving without specific treatment; Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Herbuwono notes no significant rise domestically or globally. Surveillance through 39 community health centers, 35 hospitals, and 14 quarantine centers shows influenza activity at a moderate level through week 38, with a 56% positivity rate and influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 as the dominant strain. Regions reporting higher positive proportions include Southeast Sulawesi (37%), Jakarta (31%), and Bangka Belitung Islands (29%). Influenza follows typical seasonality, peaking before the rainy season and waning around February–March. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, myalgias, headache, and fatigue. WHO cautions that influenza can cause severe illness in high-risk groups such as children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with comorbidities, underscoring vigilance for vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣、インフルエンザAは一般的に自然治癒すると発言、脆弱層は引き続き注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09は季節性の範囲内で、当局も国内外で有意な増加はないとしており、通常のサーベイランス報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告であり、異常な増加や重症化の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo confirmados fazem buscas por informações aumentarem 550% no Amazonas - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed measles cases cause information searches to increase by 550% in Amazonas - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda.
article.articleSummary: Five confirmed measles cases in Tabatinga, Amazonas, Brazil, linked to a multi-border area with Peru and Colombia. The Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) confirmed the latest case on September 21; all five patients are Peruvian nationals: three children (ages 8, 2, 1) and two adults (24, 18). The rise in cases coincided with a 550% jump in September in Google searches for measles, especially after September 10. Symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, followed by a red rash that begins on the face and spreads. Diagnosis requires medical assessment; lab confirmation may be used. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure through Brazil's SUS, using MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) and the tetravalent vaccine including varicella. Routine schedule is two doses at 12 and 15 months; catch-up doses during outbreaks depend on age and vaccination status. Seek reliable sources and medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹確定例の増加によりアマゾナス州での検索が550%増加 - アマゾナス | Portal do Holanda
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビア国境地域での麻疹確定例発生であり、IHR基準のうち「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」の2つに該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 確定例はいずれもペルー国籍者であり、ペルー・コロンビアとの多国境地域での感染拡大が懸念される。ただしペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。重症度・医療支援の必要性については記事内に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ministers Urge Faster Collective Action to Defeat Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-30, the United States-led G20 Foreign Ministerial pressed to accelerate action against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, announcing more than $470 million in new commitments and lifting total global pledges to over $2 billion since the outbreak began in May 2026. The effort centers on the Bundibugyo strain, with vaccines, diagnostics and therapies not fully effective, and addresses outbreak zones in conflict-affected, isolated areas; Uganda’s outbreak ended in August, illustrating what scale-up can achieve. Priorities include contact tracing, protecting frontline workers, expanding bed capacity, deploying new diagnostics, and accelerating vaccine development. The United States added $267 million in health and humanitarian aid, bringing direct Ebola assistance to $887 million, plus $350 million mobilized via OCHA for broader needs. Donor pledges include Australia $3.5m; France $16m; Germany $24.8m; Italy $11.3m; Japan $5m; Korea $18m; UK $67.5m; UAE $10m; World Bank $90m.

triage.headline_ja: 各国閣僚、エボラ出血熱制圧に向けた迅速な協調行動を強く要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行がG20外相級会合で取り上げられ、20億ドル超の国際的拠出が発表されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻さと国際的対応の必要性が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ・米国・韓国・イタリア・日本・フランス・豪州・ドイツ・UAE・英国が含まれるが、これらは拠出金提供国であり実際の流行地ではないため除外。ウガンダは8月に終息したとされるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS urge a aplicar un plan de 1,300 millones de dólares para contener el ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO urges the implementation of a $1.3 billion plan to contain Ebola in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts WHO to urge a $1.3 billion plan to scale up response over six months. The multisectoral package, announced with the Congolese government, WHO, the UN system, Africa CDC, and partners, aims to expand hospital capacity, diagnostic laboratories, and safe-burial operations. By end-September, targets include 1,830 beds, with more than 1,400 additional health workers needed. Ituri province, the epicenter, includes Mangala, which lacks treatment facilities; patients are referred to Nizi (27 km) or Bunia (45 km). As of Sept. 27, official data show 8,116 confirmed infections and 3,924 deaths (48.3% fatality); 2,088 recovered; 817 hospitalized or isolated. The outbreak affects 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, Ubangi-Sud. Surveillance has improved, with daily alerts rising from about 10 to 2,000 and 85% contact follow-up. Declared May 15; second deadliest outbreak globally, though behind the 2014–2016 Africa event.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行抑制に13億ドル規模の計画実施を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が7州63保健地域に拡大し、致死率48.3%、死者3,924人という深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、WHOが巨額の国際支援計画を発表していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 2014-2016年のアフリカ流行に次ぐ史上2番目に死者数の多いエボラ流行とされ、WHO・コンゴ政府・UN・Africa CDCが共同で大規模対応計画を発表。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Custodiado morre em decorrência de tuberculose no Complexo Penal de Rio Branco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Detainee dies due to tuberculosis at the Rio Branco Penitentiary Complex.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-30, detainee Caio Henrique Anedino Pena died of tuberculosis at the Rio Branco Penitentiary Complex in Acre, Brazil. He was housed in Pavilion B of the DEPRPSA, in a cell exclusively for inmates undergoing TB treatment, shared with two other detainees. The cell was isolated to preserve a scene for the Instituto Médico Legal (IML) investigation. At about 6:20 a.m., prison officers alerted SAMU after finding him unresponsive; the advanced life support team arrived, but he was already deceased. Health care for detainees at the complex is provided through an integrated system involving Semsa (Municipal Health Secretariat) with state-level support from Iapen and Sesacre. Iapen and the Polícia Penal reaffirm their commitment to detainee health and ensure necessary care and compliance with legal and constitutional obligations.

triage.headline_ja: 収容者がリオ・ブランコ刑務所複合施設で結核により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設内の個別死亡事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり、刑務所内での単発死亡例は通常の医療事案として扱われる。集団感染や異常な拡大の兆候は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar esquistossomose em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves drug to treat schistosomiasis in children.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's health regulator Anvisa approves praziquantel for treating schistosomiasis in children. Schistosomiasis, a neglected tropical disease comprising a diverse group of conditions that affect predominantly low-income populations worldwide and can range from asymptomatic to extremely severe clinical forms. Orally administered praziquantel is absorbed by adult worms in the patient’s bloodstream, causing muscular spasms and paralysis that disrupt attachment to vascular walls. The medication also damages the parasite’s tegument, a protective outer layer, enabling the host immune system to attack and destroy the worms. This approval highlights pediatric access to treatment for schistosomiasis within Brazil and underscores the role of praziquantel in addressing a longstanding neglected disease in affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、小児住血吸虫症治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 規制当局による治療薬承認に関する内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は医薬品承認に関する規制ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Detento diagnosticado com tuberculose morre em Unidade Penal de Rio Branco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inmate Diagnosed with Tuberculosis Dies at Rio Branco Penitentiary Unit.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-30, a detainee, Caio Henrique Anedino, died from tuberculosis at the Rio Branco Penitentiary Unit in Acre, Brazil. At about 6:20 a.m., prison staff alerted emergency medical services; SAMU and an advanced life support team responded, but he was pronounced dead on arrival. The cell, shared with two other inmates and reserved for those undergoing tuberculosis treatment, was isolated and preserved for forensic procedures by the Instituto Médico-Legal (IML). Healthcare for detainees at the Complexo Penal de Rio Branco is delivered through SEMSA in partnership with the state government, via IAPEN and Sesacre, reaffirming commitment to care and legal obligations for people deprived of liberty. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the infection source, nor any information on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 受刑者が結核と診断され、リオ・ブランコ刑務所施設で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の収監者の結核による死亡であり、既知の疾患であることや、他への拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の管理可能な疾患であり、単発の死亡例。同房者2名への感染拡大リスクはあるが、施設内で隔離・対応済みとされ、追加の懸念情報は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: СИМПТОМИ СУ СЛИЧНИ ГРИПУ, НОВИ ВИРУС ВЕОМА ЈЕ ОПАСАН Преносе га мали паразити са животиња, а може бити смртоносан
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms are similar to the flu; the new virus is very dangerous. It is transmitted by small parasites from animals, and it can be deadly.
article.articleSummary: China reports a new tick-borne virus, Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), causing influenza-like illness with potential fatality. ALTNV, a member of Orthonairovirus, is transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks. In a study of 3,163 hospitalized patients across 15 Chinese provinces, ALTNV was detected in 10.4% (RNA or IgM); among Dabie virus (DABV)-negative patients ALTNV rose to 15.1%. Infections with ALTNV alone produced fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, thrombocytopenia, and elevated liver enzymes, with all patients recovering. Dual infection with DABV (SFTS) occurred in 38 patients and yielded higher rates of respiratory problems, renal failure, and 18.4% mortality. Environmental work screened 47,428 ticks in 15 provinces; ALTNV RNA appeared in 1.3%, highest in Haemaphysalis longicornis at 1.8%; ticks could transmit ALTNV in mice. Findings in NEJM underscore the need for differential diagnosis where SFTS and ALTNV co-circulate.

triage.headline_ja: 症状はインフルエンザに似ている、新型ウイルスは非常に危険 ― 動物由来の小さな寄生虫（マダニ）によって媒介され、致死的となる可能性もある
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のマダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMに報告され、SFTS（Dabieウイルス）との重複感染で18.4%の致死率が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と異常性（新規病原体）の両方が認められるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はNEJM掲載の学術研究を基にしたセルビアメディアの報道。ALTNV単独感染では全例回復しているが、SFTS（DABV）との重複感染で重症化・高致死率が報告されている点が注目される。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無については記載なし。
