article.articleHeadline: G20 donors pledge $470m for DRC Ebola fight
article.articleSummary: By 30 September 2026, donors pledged over US$470 million in new funding to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), lifting total global commitments since the outbreak began in May to above US$2 billion. The United States led with US$267 million, bringing US direct support to US$887 million; the World Bank contributed US$90 million; the United Kingdom US$67.5 million; Germany US$24.8 million; South Korea US$18 million; France US$16 million; Italy US$11.3 million; United Arab Emirates US$10 million, with Australia and Japan also adding funds. The outbreak is centered in an isolated, conflict-affected eastern DRC and involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which vaccines and therapies are less effective. Funding supports Ebola treatment units, PPE for frontline workers, burial teams, laboratories, community outreach, and strengthened surveillance. Coherent cross-border preparedness is urged, with Uganda cited as a positive containment example; attendees included G20 members and multilateral partners such as UNICEF, Africa CDC, the Pandemic Fund, and UN OCHA.

triage.headline_ja: G20ドナー、DRCのエボラ対策に4億7000万ドルの拠出を表明
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・治療効果が限定的）に対し、G20各国・国際機関が総額20億ドル超の支援を表明するなど、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的関心の高さが確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには多数のドナー国（米国・韓国・イタリア・日本・フランス・ドイツ・ウガンダ・UAE・豪州・英国）が含まれるが、これらは資金拠出国であり、実際の感染発生国はDRCのみ。隔離された紛争影響地域での発生であり、ワクチン・治療が効きにくい株であることから管理の困難さが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri: l'état de la route Nia-Nia-PK51 freine l'évacuation des malades - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the Nia-Nia-PK51 road condition slows the evacuation of patients - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces evacuation delays as the PK51-Niania road in Nia-Nia health zone (Mambasa territory) is in advanced disrepair, hindering ambulance movement to the newly constructed Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). The standardized CTE, built by MSF Spain, has a 50-bed capacity and an on-site laboratory for diagnosing suspected cases; it began receiving patients about a week ago from the former center. Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, the zone medical chief, said the degraded road continues to impede access. Post-mortem samples are sent to Bunia for confirmation, a necessary step for validating results. He noted that roughly thirty samples are sent at a time, with about ten returning positive for Ebola, illustrating ongoing transmission and diagnostic activity amid evacuation challenges.

triage.headline_ja: イツリのエボラ出血熱：ニアニア〜PK51間の道路状況が患者搬送を阻害 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の陽性症例が継続的に確認されており、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに高いためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 道路インフラの不備により患者搬送・検体輸送が阻害されており、約30検体中10検体がエボラ陽性と判明していることから、感染拡大が継続している可能性が高い。MSFスペインが治療センターを建設・運営しており、既に国際支援が行われている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : plusieurs hippopotames morts dans la rivière Semuliki suite à l'Anthrax (ICCN)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Several hippopotamuses have died in the Semliki River following anthrax (ICCN).
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak among hippopotamuses in the Semliki River, within the Virunga National Park area of Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has been laboratory-confirmed by Virunga Doctors and the ICCN. Several hippos died, and a communique issued Sept 29, 2026 in Ishango warns local populations to avoid touching, moving, cutting or consuming carcasses. Children, livestock, and domestic animals should be kept away from affected zones, and a response protocol is in place to curb the outbreak and limit spread. The ICCN urges reporting of new carcasses or unusual mortalities to local authorities, veterinary services, or ICCN agents. Anthrax can transmit to humans through contact with an infected or dead animal, or by consuming its meat; anyone with symptoms after exposure should seek prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：セムリキ川でカバ数頭が炭疽により死亡（ICCN）
triage.triage_reason: DRCヴィルンガ国立公園内でカバの炭疽感染による死亡が確認されたが、現時点で人への感染事例は報告されておらず、地域住民への注意喚起と対応プロトコルが実施されている段階のため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 動物（カバ）における炭疽発生で、人への感染事例は本記事時点で報告なし。ICCN・Virunga Doctorsにより死骸への接触回避等の注意喚起と対応プロトコルが実施されている。人獣共通感染症としてヒトへの波及リスクがあるため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: All four dengue serotypes are circulating at once, and that is why the vaccine question is hard
article.articleSummary: Dengue in India shows all four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) co-circulating simultaneously across eight states and union territories, according to a pan-India ICMR-NIV/NCVBDC molecular surveillance study. Infections with one serotype confer lasting immunity to that type but only brief protection against others; a secondary infection with a different serotype substantially raises the risk of severe dengue through antibody-dependent enhancement. The findings, ahead of a national vaccine rollout, indicate a broad tetravalent vaccine is nearly mandatory, since partial protection could worsen outcomes in a four-serotype environment. In the meantime, vector control remains key: address standing water in containers where Aedes aegypti breeds; conduct weekly rather than seasonal inspections; the daytime biting pattern reduces bed-net efficacy, while daytime repellents are more protective. Study conducted by ICMR’s National Institute of Virology with the National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control across eight states and UTs.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の4つの血清型すべてが同時に流行しており、それがワクチンに関する判断を難しくしている
triage.triage_reason: インド全土8州でデング4血清型が同時流行しているとのICMR/NCVBDC分子疫学調査結果であり、二次感染による重症デングリスク（ADE）上昇とワクチン政策（4価ワクチン必須化）への影響が示唆されるため、公衆衛生上の関心が高く経過を精査する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はNipah言及があるが内容はデング熱に関するもの。血清型co-circulationによる重症化リスク上昇と国家ワクチン導入方針への影響という政策的関心から、続報（実際の症例数・重症例動向）を注視する必要がある。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数データは記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança no Brasil e acende alerta no Ceará para baixa cobertura da segunda dose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles spreads in Brazil and raises alarm in Ceará over low coverage of the second dose.
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 30, 2026, measles spreads in Brazil raise alarm in Ceará due to low second-dose coverage. In 2026, 96.45% of Ceará's one-year-olds received the first measles vaccine dose, while second-dose coverage lags at 84.78%. Data from the National Health Data Network of the Ministry of Health, with information up to August 1 and updated on September 24, 2026. Outbreaks have occurred in regions including São Paulo, with reported deaths in other areas. Ceará's vulnerability is heightened by tourism, exposing the state to entrants from different regions and countries. Health authorities reiterate the target 95% coverage for adequate population protection and urge parents to review immunization status and complete the indicated doses to prevent circulation and reintroduction of measles.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで麻疹が拡大、セアラ州で第2回接種率の低さに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で麻疹の拡大と予防接種率不足への懸念が報じられているが、具体的な症例数や重症度・国際的拡大の情報が不足しているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ワクチン接種率の低下による麻疹再流行リスクが主題。サンパウロでの死亡例の言及はあるが詳細不明。セアラ州は観光による人の流入でリスクが高いとされる。

article.articleHeadline: وبا جان هزاران نفر را گرفت / بالاترین آمار مرگ از سال ۱۹۹۹ ثبت شد / چرا بیماران به مراکز درمانی نمی‌رسند؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera has claimed thousands of lives / The highest death toll since 1999 has been recorded / Why aren't patients reaching medical centers?
article.articleSummary: Global cholera deaths in 2025 reached the highest annual toll since 1999, according to WHO. The year recorded 451,499 cases and 7,870 deaths, a 30% rise in mortality despite fewer reported cases. Africa bore the heaviest burden, with 34% of cases and 58% of deaths. About 90% of reported cases and deaths occurred in Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, and Yemen. More than one in five cholera deaths occurred outside health facilities, indicating limited timely access to care. Surveillance-based data likely underestimates the true burden. Oral cholera vaccine production rose from about 30 million doses in 2022 to about 80 million in 2025, more than doubling. The report underscores ongoing gaps in prevention and treatment and why patients aren’t reaching medical centers.

triage.headline_ja: コレラが数千人の命を奪う／1999年以来最高の死亡者数を記録／なぜ患者は医療機関に辿り着けないのか？
triage.triage_reason: WHO報告によれば2025年の世界コレラ死亡者数は1999年以降で最多となり、アフリカを中心に深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と医療アクセスの課題が示されており、国際的な注目・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの2025年版グローバルコレラ報告を基にした国際的な概況記事。発生地域リストにあるSudan, Angola, Yemen, Bangladesh, Nigeriaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、対象国の中で明示的に言及されているDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratar esquistossomose em crianças pequenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves a drug to treat schistosomiasis in young children.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approved Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel, a pediatric formulation of praziquantel, for treating schistosomiasis in Brazil. The drug is indicated for children aged 3 months to 6 years and targets infections by Schistosoma mansoni and Schistosoma haematobium, addressing administration challenges in very young patients. Schistosomiasis is contracted via exposure to contaminated freshwater and remains a significant public health issue in Brazil, where transmission occurs in areas with suitable parasite and snail hosts. Praziquantel is a key anti-parasitic; the pediatric formulation aims to improve dosing and compliance in early childhood. Registration by Anvisa is regulatory and does not automatically mean immediate availability through the SUS; incorporation into public policy will require additional evaluations of evidence, cost, and health impact.

triage.headline_ja: アンビザ（ブラジル国家衛生監督庁）、幼児の住血吸虫症治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 新規治療薬の承認に関する規制ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は医薬品承認に関する規制ニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova novo remédio para esquistossomose infantil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves new drug for pediatric schistosomiasis.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health regulator Anvisa approved Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel for pediatric schistosomiasis, targeting children aged 3 months to 6 years, with regulatory use authorized and published in the Diário Oficial da União on 2026-09-30. The drug treats infections by Schistosoma mansoni and Schistosoma haematobium, the parasites driving transmission. Schistosomiasis is described as a tropical neglected disease affecting populations across tropical and subtropical regions of South America, Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean; it is often asymptomatic early but can cause severe organ damage if untreated. Mechanistically, praziquantel acts directly on the worms in blood vessels, inducing intense muscular spasms and paralysis and damaging the tegument, facilitating immune clearance. The approval underscores public health urgency to address this neglected disease in vulnerable pediatric populations.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、小児住血吸虫症向け新薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: 新薬承認に関する規制ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は新薬の承認・治療に関する内容であり、具体的な感染拡大やアウトブレイク事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Jeder 8. Krebsfall geht auf Infektionen zurück - Hauptübeltäter ist ein Bakterium
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One in eight cancer cases is due to infections - the main culprit is a bacterium.
article.articleSummary: In 2024, infections caused about 2.3 million new cancers worldwide, roughly 12% of all new cases. Twelve oncogenic agents were identified, led by Helicobacter pylori (≈760,000) and human papillomavirus (HPV) (≈750,000), followed by hepatitis B virus (HBV) ≈360,000, Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) ≈260,000, and hepatitis C virus (HCV) ≈160,000. Together these five pathogens account for the vast majority of infection-related cancers. East Asia bears 42% of these cases, driven largely by H. pylori and HBV; Sub-Saharan Africa shows high burden with HPV and Kaposi sarcoma–associated herpesvirus (KSHV), worsened by HIV. More than three-quarters occur in low- and middle-income countries with limited prevention and treatment access. EBV is the fourth most common infectious cancer cause worldwide, linked to nasopharyngeal cancer, lymphomas, and some stomach cancers. Prevention priorities include HPV/HBV vaccination, H. pylori and viral hepatitis control, HIV prevention, and HPV-related cancer screening; vaccines against EBV are urgently needed.

triage.headline_ja: 癌の8件に1件は感染症が原因 - 主犯は細菌
triage.triage_reason: 世界的な感染症起因がんに関する疫学研究の紹介記事であり、特定の国での急性発生事象ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界規模の感染症関連がんに関する研究報告であり、特定の発生国（中国・上海）に関する記述はなく、発生地域情報はBluedotの誤割当てと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Beyond the Usual Suspect: Dogs and Cats in Brazil Harbor More Than One
article.articleSummary: Visceral leishmaniasis in São Luís, Maranhão, Brazil, long attributed to Leishmania infantum and domestic dogs, may involve Leishmania amazonensis in urban pets. A cross-sectional study in three Itaqui-Bacanga neighborhoods (Fumacê, Anjo da Guarda, Mauro Fecury) sampled 330 dogs and 21 cats (July–October 2020). Serology (IFAT) showed 37.9% of dogs seroreactive to L. amazonensis and 23.0% to L. infantum; 75 dogs reacted only to L. amazonensis, 26 only to L. infantum, 50 to both. Cats were seroreactive to L. amazonensis (28.6%) and L. infantum (14.3%). ITS1 PCR detected Leishmania DNA in 58/330 dogs (17.6%) and 2/21 cats (9.5%). Of 9 canine PCR+ samples with clear profiles, 8 were L. infantum and 1 mixed; both cats were L. infantum. The remaining 49 canine PCR+ samples were indeterminate. The findings support possible co-circulation of L. infantum and L. amazonensis in urban animals amid ongoing human VL transmission (205 confirmed cases, 2020–2025).

triage.headline_ja: よくある容疑者を超えて:ブラジルの犬と猫は複数種のリーシュマニア原虫を保有している
triage.triage_reason: これは動物宿主における疫学研究報告であり、ヒトの新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（動物のリーシュマニア種同定に関する血清学・PCR調査）であり、既知の内臓リーシュマニア症の継続的なヒト感染（2020-2025年に205例確認）に関する背景情報を含むが、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Нови вирус откривен у Кини: Познато како се преноси
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New virus discovered in China: How it is transmitted is known.
article.articleSummary: ALTNV (Asian longhorned tick nairovirus), a novel pathogen identified in China and transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks, causes an influenza-like illness. The discovery, published in the New England Journal of Medicine, differentiates ALTNV from the Dabie virus (DBV), the agent of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS). In 3,163 hospitalized patients across Chinese provinces, ALTNV RNA or IgM was detected in 10.4%; among DBV-negative patients, ALTNV positivity reached 15.1%. Infections with ALTNV alone largely resolved, with fatigue in 84% and GI symptoms in 80%; thrombocytopenia occurred in 38% and elevated transaminases in 36%. Coinfection with DBV in 38 patients led to worse outcomes: 61% respiratory problems, 84% kidney failure, and 18.4% mortality (7/38). Tick surveillance of 47,428 ticks from 15 provinces found ALTNV RNA in 1.3%, highest in Haemaphysalis longicornis at 1.8%, and laboratory transmission to mice. Authors urge better differential diagnosis in SFTS-endemic regions where ALTNV and DBV co-circulate.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新型ウイルスを発見：感染経路が判明
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新たなマダニ媒介性ウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMに報告され、既知のSFTS病原体（Dabieウイルス）との共感染で高い致死率（18.4%）が確認されており、鑑別診断の必要性が強調されているため、サーベイランス強化の観点からフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の流行事例報告ではなく、NEJM掲載の病原体発見・後ろ向き研究に基づくもの。現時点でヒト-ヒト感染やアウトブレイクの報告はないが、SFTS流行地域における新規マダニ媒介性ウイルスの共感染リスクとして継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa aprova medicamento para tratamento de esquistossomose em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa approves drug for treatment of schistosomiasis in children.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa approves Farmanguinhos Arpraziquantel for treating schistosomiasis in children aged 3 months to 6 years, caused by Schistosoma mansoni or Schistosoma haematobium. Schistosomiasis is a neglected tropical disease prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions of Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, and South America. Transmission occurs via contact with freshwater containing infected snails. The incubation period is 2–6 weeks, with two disease phases: acute (2–6 weeks after exposure) and chronic (months to years later). Oral arpraziquantel is absorbed by adult worms in blood vessels, causing muscle spasms and paralysis and damaging the tegument, enabling the immune system to destroy the parasites. The approval broadens pediatric treatment options for schistosomiasis in endemic regions.

triage.headline_ja: アンビザ、小児向け住血吸虫症治療薬を承認
triage.triage_reason: これは新規薬剤承認に関する規制ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの医薬品規制当局(Anvisa)による小児用住血吸虫症治療薬の承認を報じたものであり、ブラジル国内での症例増加やアウトブレイクを示す内容ではないため、Brazilは発生地域として検証されず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Fevers Persist As Monsoon Ends
article.articleSummary: Viral fevers persist in Hyderabad as the monsoon ends as of 30 September 2026. Patients report severe headache, body pain in the lower limbs, and fever lasting three to four days; cold, cough and fever can persist a week, with expectations of more water-borne illnesses (nausea, diarrhoea) in October. Doctors advise hand hygiene and caution against self-medication or indiscriminate antibiotic use, noting antibiotics are sometimes prescribed for repeated fever episodes. At Fever Hospital, Nallakunta, and Gandhi Hospital, fevers still drive care, with Gandhi Hospital reporting about 50–60 admissions daily, of which 10–15 are viral fever cases requiring antiviral treatment and intravenous fluids. Advocacy emphasizes masking during persistent symptoms to reduce household transmission. Ganesh Chaturthi saw a temporary drop in fever cases, followed by a resurgence after the festival.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン終息後もウイルス性熱が継続
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス性熱・水系疾患に関する一般的な報道であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性のウイルス性熱・水系感染症に関する地域医療報道。特定病原体の同定はなく、毎年繰り返される季節的傾向として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Novi virus otkriven u Kini: Prenose ga krpelji, stručnjaci otkrili simptome
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New virus discovered in China: Ticks transmit it; experts have identified the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: China reports a newly identified orthonairovirus, Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks, linked to influenza-like illness. The finding, published in the New England Journal of Medicine, analyzed 3,163 fever patients with prior tick exposure; ALTNV was confirmed in 10.4% via viral RNA or IgM antibodies, and 15.1% among those negative for Dabie bandavirus (DBV). In ALTNV-only cases, fatigue and gastrointestinal symptoms predominated; 38% had thrombocytopenia and 36% elevated liver enzymes, with full recovery and no lasting sequelae. Coinfection with DBV indicated greater severity: among 38 patients, respiratory symptoms occurred in 61%, renal injury in 84%, and 7 deaths (18.4%). ALTNV circulated in ticks, detected in 1.29% of 47,428 ticks across 15 Chinese provinces, mainly Haemaphysalis longicornis. Data center in China; further studies needed on distribution and health impact.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新型ウイルスを発見：マダニが媒介、専門家が症状を特定
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規に同定されたマダニ媒介性ウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMに報告され、重症化（Dabie bandavirusとの混合感染で致死率18.4%）や肝腎機能障害などの重篤例が確認されており、異常性・重症度の両面でIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 新規病原体（Asian longhorned tick nairovirus, ALTNV）は中国15省のマダニ（Haemaphysalis longicornis）から検出。ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、現時点で国際的拡大の証拠はないが、学術誌発表により国際的関心が高まる可能性がある。続報でヒト間伝播や地理的拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Katanga : l'Assemblée provinciale alerte sur les incursions armées à Mitwaba, le banditisme à Lubumbashi et le choléra à Pweto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Katanga: the Provincial Assembly issues a warning about armed incursions into Mitwaba, banditry in Lubumbashi, and cholera in Pweto.
article.articleSummary: On Sept. 30, 2026, the Haut-Katanga Provincial Assembly warned of armed incursions into Mitwaba, urban banditry in Lubumbashi, and persistent cholera in Pweto, over 400 kilometers from Lubumbashi. In opening remarks, President Michel Kabwe Mwamba linked insecurity to anarchic urbanization and poverty, lauding security forces for defending territorial integrity. Mitwaba was singled out for incursions by Mai-Mai Bakata Katanga; Lubumbashi suffers vehicle thefts, burglaries, kidnappings, including a gas-station robbery on Manono Avenue in Kilobelobe that left police dead, and the murder of Haut-Katanga Court of Appeal president Vincent Mwana Mulenda at home in Bel-Air. The assembly praised security actions against suspects in Kilobelobe. Health-wise, it flagged unsanitary conditions ahead of the rainy season and noted Ebola spreading to seven of 26 provinces, risking Haut-Katanga due to population movement. In Pweto, cholera has persisted for weeks with dozens of deaths; authorities urged better waste management and enforcement of public-space surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: オー・カタンガ州:州議会がミトワバへの武装勢力侵入、ルブンバシでの治安悪化、プウェトでのコレラについて警告
triage.triage_reason: プウェトで数週間にわたりコレラが持続し数十人が死亡、さらにエボラが26州中7州に拡大し人口移動によりオー・カタンガ州へのリスクも指摘されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は治安問題（武装勢力の侵入、都市犯罪）が主題だが、州議会が公衆衛生上の懸念としてプウェトでのコレラ継続とエボラの州内への拡大リスクを公式に警告している点が重要。具体的な感染者数・致死率等の詳細データは不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Escola na Grande BH suspende aulas após surto de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in Greater Belo Horizonte suspends classes after outbreak of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies outbreak in Lagoa Santa, part of the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Area, Minas Gerais, prompted suspension of classes at Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Maria on Oct 1–2, 2026 after 21 cases among students and one teacher. The two-day shutdown will be followed by full cleaning of facilities, pest control, and sanitization of the water tank to ensure a safe return. Authorities urge families not to send symptomatic children and to seek care at local health units. Origin of the outbreak was not disclosed. Context: Minas Gerais has seen other scabies activity in Alfenas (over 150 cases since late August) and Andradas (seven suspected cases), with preventive school measures. Symptoms include intense itching and skin lesions in warm, moist areas; transmission via prolonged close contact or shared items; treatment involves topical and oral medications.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・ベロオリゾンテ都市圏の学校、ヒト疥癬の集団発生で休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低い疾患だが、複数都市での集団発生が続いており、地域の公衆衛生対応として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト接触で伝播するが重症度は低く、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。ミナスジェライス州内の複数地域（Lagoa Santa, Alfenas, Andradas）で発生が報告されており、地域内での拡大傾向が見られるため続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Chagas: Projeto busca prevenir transmissão de mãe para filho | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease: Project seeks to prevent mother-to-child transmission | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (American trypanosomiasis) congenital prevention project Cuida Chagas, led by Fiocruz, aims to stop mother-to-child transmission. After five years of fieldwork, 81,000 people were screened with more than 2,600 confirmed infections. The program operates across Brazil (31 municipalities) and extends to Bolivia, Colombia, and Paraguay. In the post-field phase, results will be analyzed to translate research into actions within Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS). A key finding demonstrates feasibility of addressing congenital Chagas through primary health care, with efforts to integrate testing of pregnant women and women of reproductive age into routine services, strengthen monitoring of exposed children, decentralize exam collection, and coordinate care across primary care, surveillance, laboratories, and specialized services. The initiative added PCR testing to detect Trypanosoma cruzi DNA in blood, enabling treatment in early infancy. Emphasizes training, adapting processes to local realities, and engaging communities.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病：母子感染予防を目指すプロジェクト | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病（シャーガス病）に対する予防・研究プロジェクトの報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではないため、通常のサーベイランス・研究活動として見送り判断とする。
triage.notes: ボリビア・コロンビア・パラグアイも言及されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。記事は既存の母子感染予防プロジェクトの進捗報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna suspende aulas em escola na Grande BH; 21 casos foram confirmados - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies outbreak suspends classes at a school in Greater Belo Horizonte; 21 cases confirmed - BH 24 Horas
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak at Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Lacerda in Lagoa Santa, part of the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area in Minas Gerais, Brazil, with 21 confirmed cases (20 inside the school and 1 outside) has led to the suspension of classes on October 1–2. The first alert appeared September 18 when a student showed symptoms; authorities say cleaning, pest control, and water-tank sanitization will occur during the pause. Since September 29, medical staff have been on site to examine students with parental authorization. Scabies is caused by a mite and typically causes intense itching and skin lesions; transmission occurs mainly through prolonged direct skin contact, and treatment follows medical guidance. The situation highlights the importance of sanitation and ongoing surveillance in the school and community to protect students and staff.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬(かいせん)の集団発生でベロオリゾンテ大都市圏の学校が休校に；21例確認 - BH 24 Horas
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重大なリスクを持つ疾患ではなく、学校内の限定的な集団発生で既に対応（清掃・診察）が取られており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染するが重症度は低く、地元当局により既に対応済み。国レベルでの対応能力は十分と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue data bites: 640 cases in 27 days
article.articleSummary: Ahmedabad reports dengue surge: Sept 1–27 recorded 640 dengue cases, 51.1% of 1,228 dengue cases Jan 1–Sept 27, as monsoon lull fostered mosquito breeding. Construction sites and commercial units under inspection; breeding sites sealed; open plots with standing rainwater surveyed; drains and insecticide spraying underway. High case clusters in Gota, Jagatpur, Chandkheda, Bodakdev, Thaltej; also Vastral, Lambha, Nikol. Public awareness campaigns and hospital data collection enforced; private hospitals urged to submit dengue data; notices to noncompliant units. In Sept 1–27, 103 simple malaria, 27 falciparum malaria, 7 chikungunya; year-to-date totals: 419 simple malaria, 74 falciparum, 14 chikungunya. Other Ahmedabad data Jan 1–Sept 27: 4,114 gastroenteritis, 600 jaundice, 1,655 typhoid; Sept 1–27: 194 gastroenteritis, 68 jaundice, 236 typhoid. Water testing: 46,080 chlorine tests (9 chlorine-nil), 6,585 bacteriological tests (19 not fit for consumption). Pediatric dengue cases rising modestly; hydration advised; children urged to wear full-sleeved clothing.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱データが示す衝撃：27日間で640症例
triage.triage_reason: アーメダバードでのデング熱季節的増加であり、通常の対応策（防疫・啓発）が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、症例数増加は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・アーメダバード（グジャラート州）におけるデング熱・マラリア・チクングニア・腸チフス等の季節性感染症報告であり、地元自治体による通常の防疫対応（蚊の繁殖地調査・薬剤散布・啓発活動）が行われている。発生地域リストにバングラデシュが含まれるが、記事本文はインドのアーメダバード市に限定されており、バングラデシュは主題ではないため除外。重症例や死亡の言及なし、国際的拡大の兆候もないため、WATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Descubren un nuevo virus transmitido por garrapatas detrás de enfermedades que hasta ahora no tenían explicación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers discover a new tick-borne virus behind diseases that until now had no explanation.
article.articleSummary: Newly identified Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV) is a novel tick-borne pathogen associated with syndromes resembling severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) in Asia. Clinically, more than 30% of patients with suspected SFTS test negative for Dabie bandavirus (DBV), the known SFTS agent, prompting investigators in Beijing and other Chinese institutions to expand their search beyond DBV. Using metatranscriptomic sequencing of samples from febrile, tick-exposed patients and subsequent viral isolation, researchers demonstrated ALTNV, a member of Orthonairovirus in the Nairoviridae family, with amino acid sequence similarity to other ortonairoviruses below 80.04%, supporting its novelty. In vitro, ALTNV replicated in Vero cells; immunofluorescence detected viral antigens, and electron microscopy showed orthonairovirus-like particles across several cell lines. The NEJM report details this discovery and its potential to explain previously unexplained SFTS-like illnesses in China.

triage.headline_ja: 新種のマダニ媒介性ウイルスが発見され、これまで原因不明だった疾患の背景にあることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 新規のマダニ媒介性ナイロウイルス(ALTNV)が中国で発見され、SFTS様疾患の一因である可能性が示されたが、現時点では症例数・重症度・ヒト-ヒト感染の有無等の疫学情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術論文(NEJM)に基づく新規病原体発見の報告であり、アウトブレイク発生の報告ではない。SFTS陰性例の30%以上を説明しうる可能性がある点で公衆衛生上の関心は高いが、実際の患者数・地理的分布・重症度・伝播様式等の詳細情報がなく、フルリスク評価に進むには情報不足。続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Goiânia instala 25 mil armadilhas após alta de 351% nos casos de chikungunya - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiânia installs 25,000 traps after a 351% increase in chikungunya cases - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: Goiânia, Brazil, is boosting vector control ahead of the rainy season by installing 25,000 Aedes aegypti traps. By epidemiological week 37 of 2026, dengue exceeds 33,000 confirmed cases (33,065), up 21% from the same period last year, with 33 deaths. Chikungunya totals reach 750 cases, a 351% rise, and 1 death has been reported. The municipal Health Secretariat notes ongoing transmission risk from the mosquito vector responsible for these diseases. Since the start of the year, health teams conducted 1,705,891 home visits and eliminated more than 953,000 breeding sites. The intensified measures aim to curb outbreaks during the pre-rainy period and reduce Aedes aegypti populations in the capital.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアニア市、チクングニア熱症例が351％増加したことを受け、2万5000個の捕獲器を設置
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とデング熱の症例数が顕著に増加しているが、ブラジルでは雨季前の季節的な流行であり、地元自治体が既に大規模なベクター対策を実施中であるため、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと判断される。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ゴイアニア市における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱増加と、それに対する市保健局のベクター対策（捕獲器設置、家庭訪問、繁殖地除去）を報告。死亡例はあるが致死率は低く、既に地元当局が積極的に対応しているため、現時点では国際的な懸念事項としての優先度は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Petrolina capacita Agentes Comunitários de Saúde para fortalecer tratamento de hanseníase
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Petrolina City Hall trains Community Health Workers to strengthen leprosy treatment.
article.articleSummary: About 220 Community Health Agents in Petrolina were trained in September to strengthen early detection of leprosy (Hanseníase) cases. The program, delivered in 12 groups, emphasized recognizing signs and symptoms during home visits and the agents’ role in identifying suspected cases. Under the theme 'The look that diagnoses by the Community Health Agent,' the training aimed to expand knowledge of leprosy and reinforce careful observation during family follow-ups. Topics included key clinical signs, identification of suspected cases, and the importance of prompt diagnosis and treatment. The initiative seeks to strengthen Primary Health Care and expand active case finding, ensuring faster access to care. It supports Epidemiological Surveillance to qualify municipal health workers and bolster leprosy control strategies in Petrolina.

triage.headline_ja: ペトロリナ市役所、ハンセン病治療強化のため地域保健員を研修
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病の早期発見能力強化のための通常の保健研修プログラムであり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ペルナンブコ州ペトロリナ市における地域保健員向けのハンセン病早期発見研修に関する内容で、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Lagoa Santa confirma mais de 20 casos de sarna em escola municipal e suspende aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoa Santa City Hall confirms more than 20 cases of scabies at a municipal school and suspends classes.
article.articleSummary: 21 confirmed cases of human scabies at a municipal school in Lagoa Santa, Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The city hall suspended classes on October 1–2 for preventive measures, including full cleaning of all school facilities, pest control, and sanitization of the water tank. Scabies is caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei and spreads via prolonged direct skin contact or sharing clothing and personal items. Reported symptoms include intense itching (often worse at night), small papules, red bumps, and skin lesions that can resemble fine lines, typically appearing between the fingers, on wrists, armpits, waistline, and genitals. The article does not specify laboratory confirmation or the infection source, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴア・サンタ市役所、市立学校で疥癬20件以上を確認し休校措置
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤な疾患ではなく、局所的な学校内発生であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもないため、見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染で重症度は低く、学校内での局所的流行。市当局が予防的に休校・清掃措置を実施済みで、外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Drug-Resistant HIV Strains Circulate Widely in Yunnan Transmission
article.articleSummary: HIV-1 drug resistance circulates in Qujing, northeastern Yunnan Province, China. Genotypic resistance testing of two groups—treatment-failure (2023–2024) and treatment-naive diagnosed in 2024—shows pretreatment drug resistance (PDR) in 10.85% of naive individuals (37/341), dominated by NNRTI mutations (7.62%), especially E138, V179, and K103. Among 743 treatment-failure samples, acquired resistance reaches 41.45%, with NNRTI resistance at 37.55% and M184 (NRTI) in 15.61%; protease inhibitor resistance remains low at 2.56%. Molecular transmission-network analysis identifies CRF08_BC as the prevalent local subtype, with NNRTI mutations (E138, K103) embedded in transmission clusters, indicating resistant viruses spread through new infections. Older adults (≥50) have higher odds of cluster inclusion (adjusted OR 7.499). Methods included nested RT-PCR, Sanger sequencing of HIV-1 pol regions, and Stanford HIV Drug Resistance Database interpretation, informing ART monitoring and cluster-targeted interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 雲南省で薬剤耐性HIV株が伝播ネットワークを通じて広範に流行 ― 研究報告
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究報告であり急性の公衆衛生緊急事態ではないが、薬剤耐性HIVの地域内伝播という疫学的に注視すべき内容を含むため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究論文の紹介であり、突発的な公衆衛生イベントではなく、既存の薬剤耐性HIV伝播に関する疫学調査結果の報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Plus de 100 patients guéris de la variole dans l'est du Moxico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: More than 100 patients cured of smallpox in eastern Moxico Province.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, Angola’s eastern Moxico Province reports 114 recoveries from smallpox since cases emerged in June, with over 100 total cured. Twenty-seven patients remain under medical supervision across health centers. Luau municipality, bordering the Democratic Republic of Congo, is the epicenter. To curb spread, intensified awareness campaigns are underway in communities, markets, schools and other venues, and epidemiological surveillance at the Luau border has been strengthened to prevent importation. A new batch of vaccines has arrived for administration to vulnerable groups. Benilde Miguel, director of the Moxico Leste Provincial Health Office, urges continued preventive measures, including handwashing with soap and water, mask-wearing, and avoiding unprotected sexual contact and contacts with people from endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ：モシコ州東部で天然痘（疑い例を含む）から100人以上が回復
triage.triage_reason: 天然痘は1980年に根絶されており、本記事の症状記述（性的接触回避の呼びかけ等）からサル痘（mpox）の可能性が高く、病名表記の異常性と国境地帯での感染拡大リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 疾患名が『Smallpox（天然痘）』とされているが、天然痘は根絶済みであり、性的接触回避の注意喚起等からmpox（サル痘）の誤表記・誤訳の可能性が高い。発生地域はアンゴラ・モシコ州（Luau市）であり、DRCは国境に接する隣国として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での症例発生は記事中に明記されていないため、対象国リストに該当する確定発生国は無しと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Entenda os riscos da Raiva e desmistifique os principais mitos sobre a vacinação de pets - Portal Pet News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Understand the risks of Rabies and debunk the main myths about pet vaccination - Portal Pet News
article.articleSummary: Rabies, a lethal viral zoonosis from the Rhabdoviridae family, remains a public health focus in Brazil, highlighted on World Rabies Day. Transmission occurs via saliva, mainly through bites or contact with infected animals, and the disease is nearly 100% fatal once clinical symptoms appear. Vaccination of dogs and cats is essential to curb human risk. As of 2026, Brazil marks ten years without human rabies transmitted by dog-associated variants AgV1 and AgV2, credited to sustained vaccination, surveillance, and control, though sporadic countrywide cases trigger alerts in Rio de Janeiro and other regions. Current risk centers on wildlife—bats and primates—and pets that interact with them in urban areas. Annual vaccination from three months of age remains mandatory, including indoor pets. MSD Saúde Animal promotes Nobivac Rabies (inactivated Pasteur strain) for dogs, cats and ferrets. MSD supports Afya Program and Bravecto do Bem, donating 100,000 rabies vaccines since 2024 to NGOs.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病のリスクを理解し、ペットワクチン接種に関する主な俗説を解明する - Portal Pet News
triage.triage_reason: 世界狂犬病デーに関する啓発記事であり、ブラジルでは10年間人への犬媒介狂犬病の発生がないなど、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種啓発・予防に関する一般的な内容で、具体的な発生急増や新規症例報告ではないため対象国リストに該当する発生国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Российским туристам сообщили об угрозе опасной крысиной лихорадки в Таиланде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists have been warned about the threat of dangerous rat fever in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists and volunteers in flooded Rayong, Thailand, have been warned about leptospirosis (rat fever) linked to contaminated water. The warning follows reports that several hundred Russians may be in the area after floods; a first group of volunteers left Pattaya on September 29. On September 30, Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health confirmed the infection source: leptospira bacteria detected in water in the flood zone. The primary risk group includes workers in water, debris removal, and waste collection. Leptospirosis, transmitted through contact with water or urine from infected rodents, presents with high fever, headache, muscle pain, and nausea; severe cases can cause kidney and liver failure. Preventive measures: avoid swimming and working in standing water without protective gear (rubber gloves and footwear). Early medical consultation improves outcomes since the disease responds to antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客にタイでの危険な『ネズミ熱』の脅威が警告される
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症のリスク警告であり、タイ保健省も感染源を確認しているが、現時点で症例数や重症度など詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 洪水に伴う水系感染症の典型例。ロシア人観光客・ボランティアへの注意喚起が主眼であり、国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態としての性質は低いが、感染源確認済みで今後の症例動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Katanga : l'Assemblée provinciale alerte sur les incursions armées à Mitwaba, le banditisme à Lubumbashi et le choléra à Pweto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haut-Katanga: The Provincial Assembly warns of armed incursions into Mitwaba, banditry in Lubumbashi and cholera in Pweto.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, the Haut-Katanga Provincial Assembly warns of armed incursions into Mitwaba by Mai-Mai Bakata Katanga, rising urban banditry in Lubumbashi, and a cholera outbreak in Pweto. The speaker reiterates solidarity with civilians in the East and commends the Armed Forces for defending territorial integrity. In Mitwaba, residents face incursions; in Lubumbashi, incidents include vehicle thefts, burglaries, kidnappings, exemplified by a service-station robbery on Avenue Manono (Kilobelobe) where police were killed, and the killing of Vincent Mwana Mulenda, President of the Haut-Katanga Court of Appeal, in Bel-Air. He praises security services for Kilobelobe prosecutions and notes urban disorder linked to uncontrolled urbanization and poverty. Sanitation remains poor across several towns ahead of rains; Ebola is spreading in 7 of 26 provinces, heightening Haut-Katanga’s risk due to mobility. Pweto cholera persists for weeks with dozens of deaths; urges waste management, hygiene measures, and stricter public-space surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: オー・カタンガ州：州議会がミトワバへの武装侵入、ルブンバシの治安悪化、プウェトでのコレラ流行について警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCの26州中7州でエボラが拡大中であり、人の移動によるHaut-Katangaへのリスクが指摘されている。加えてPwetoでは数週間にわたるコレラ流行で数十人が死亡しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのHaut-Katanga州（Pweto, Mitwaba, Lubumbashi）における治安問題とコレラ流行、さらにDRC全体でのエボラ拡大（26州中7州）に言及している。発生地域にFranceが含まれるが、記事主題と無関係のため除外。コレラとエボラ両方の視点から継続的な情報収集とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tilapicultura amplia vigilância após avanço do Streptococcus agalactiae sorotipo III
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tilapia farming expands surveillance after the spread of Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III has been detected in new tilapia production areas in Triângulo Mineiro, Minas Gerais, Brazil, signaling expanded regional surveillance as of 2026. Previously linked mainly to outbreaks in the Northeast, serotype III's appearance in the Triângulo Mineiro updates the national map of circulation; serotype Ib remains more widespread across Brazilian regions. A national study of 257 tilapia farms (2019–2024) found serotype III only in the Northeast during that period, while different serotypes circulate elsewhere. Pathovet Labs confirmed serotype III in Triângulo Mineiro, underscoring regional differences in sanitary risk. Prevention should start before high infection pressure, including vaccination integrated into a biosafety program. Vaccines must be used per approved indications, alongside water quality, animal health, management, and stress-reduction practices. Diagnostics (PCR/microbiology) and serotyping guide region-specific control and continuous monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ティラピア養殖、Streptococcus agalactiae血清型IIIの拡大を受けサーベイランス強化
triage.triage_reason: 魚類(ティラピア)養殖における動物疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は確認されておらず、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事例は養殖魚(ティラピア)の細菌感染症であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルとしては対象外。動物衛生・水産業上の監視事項として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF - Kolera përhapet në lindje të Kongos, mbi 12,700 raste dhe 175 viktima që nga fillimi i vitit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF - Cholera spreading in eastern Congo, over 12,700 cases and 175 deaths since the beginning of the year.
article.articleSummary: Cholera is spreading in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 12,700 cases and 175 deaths in South Kivu Province since the start of the year. UNICEF reports over 30,400 cases and about 700 deaths across the DRC in the same period, with North Kivu and South Kivu remaining the epicenters. Flooding, population displacement, and inadequate access to safe water are driving transmission. Health authorities say cholera continues to spread in communities as attention and resources since May have increasingly focused on the Ebola outbreak. Fifteen cholera deaths were recorded in South Kivu from Sept. 14–20 across four health zones: Shabunda, Fizi, Ibanda, and Uvira. UNICEF urges urgent action to protect children and support an integrated response, including community surveillance and laboratory analyses of suspected cases. The report notes ongoing outbreaks in West and Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF - コンゴ東部でコレラが拡大、年初から1万2,700人以上が感染し175人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（南キブ州中心）でコレラ感染が年初来1万2,700例・死亡175例に達し拡大を続けており、洪水・避難民・衛生インフラ不足が感染を助長、エボラ対応にリソースが割かれ管理体制が逼迫しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラ拡大が主題であり、エボラは対応リソースの文脈でのみ言及。フィジーの位置情報はBluedotの誤判定とみられ、記事内容と無関係のため除外した。南キブ州・シャブンダ・イバンダ・ウビラ等は国内の下位地域であり、国レベルのDRCに集約した。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera affects more than 12,700 in eastern DR Congo: UNICEF
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with South Kivu recording over 12,700 cases and 175 deaths since the start of the year, while the country totals exceed 30,400 cases and nearly 700 deaths. North Kivu and South Kivu remain the epicenters of transmission, accelerated by widespread flooding, population displacement, and limited access to safe water. UNICEF reports an integrated response including household interventions, community surveillance, and laboratory analysis of suspected cases to curb spread. Since May, attention and resources have increasingly shifted to the Ebola outbreak, hindering cholera control. In the latest week (Sept 14–20), South Kivu logged 15 cholera deaths across four health zones (Shabunda, Fizi, Ibanda, Uvira). UNICEF calls for urgent action to protect children, while noting cholera spreading into West and Central Africa and across multiple countries.

triage.headline_ja: コレラがコンゴ民主共和国東部で12,700人以上に影響:ユニセフ
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で死者数700人・症例3万件超と大規模なコレラ流行が継続し、エボラ対応への資源シフトで対策が阻害されている。国際的拡大（西・中部アフリカへの波及）も指摘されており、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFiji、Angolaが含まれるが記事主題はDRCのみであり対象外。エボラ流行との資源競合がコレラ対応を阻害している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Novo vírus de carrapato é descoberto após casos misteriosos de febre na China
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New tick-borne virus discovered after mysterious fever cases in China.
article.articleSummary: New tick-borne nairovirus identified in China, ALTNV (Asian longhorned tick nairovirus), reported in NEJM in early September 2026. ALTNV detected in patients with fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, and thrombocytopenia, negative for Dabie bandavirus (DBV). In a cohort of 3,163 patients, 10.4% showed ALTNV infection; among DBV-negative individuals, 15.1% were ALTNV-positive. ALTNV belongs to Orthonairovirus, family Nairoviridae; amino acid similarity to other species <80%. The virus was cultured in vitro, and RNA sequencing supported its classification. Symptoms in ALTNV-only cases: 84% fatigue, 80% GI issues, 38% thrombocytopenia, 36% elevated aminotransferases; all ALTNV-only patients recovered. Coinfection with DBV occurred in 38 patients and linked to more severe disease: 61% respiratory symptoms, 84% renal failure vs 66% in DBV-only, and 7 deaths (18.4%). ALTNV RNA detected in 1.3% of 47,428 ticks; Haemaphysalis longicornis had 1.8% positivity; ticks transmitted ALTNV to mice in lab studies. Regions endemic for SFTS should differentiate ALTNV from DBV.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で原因不明の発熱症例から新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスが発見される
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のナイロウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMで報告され、重症化・死亡例（DBVとの共感染時）も確認されていることから、WPRO基準に複数該当し、学術誌・メディア双方で注目を集めているためフルRRAへの移行が適当。
triage.notes: ALTNV単独感染は全例回復したが、Dabieバンダウイルスとの共感染では致死率18.4%と報告。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、主にダニ媒介。SFTS流行地域での鑑別診断が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: Identifican un nuevo virus transmitido por garrapatas tras años de casos sin explicación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New tick-borne virus identified after years of unexplained cases.
article.articleSummary: Researchers have identified a previously unknown tick-borne pathogen responsible for unexplained febrile illnesses in Asia. The organism, named Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), is an orthonairovirus transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis and infects both humans and animals, with confirmed transmission and replication. The finding helps explain why more than 30% of patients clinically diagnosed with severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome did not test positive for the conventional virus. Using advanced genomic sequencing and analyses of hospital samples and tick populations, scientists confirmed ALTNV as the culprit. Led by the Beijing State Key Laboratory of Pathogens and Biosafety, the study was published in the New England Journal of Medicine and summarized by Muy Interesante. In affected humans, ALTNV caused fatigue and gastrointestinal symptoms, with full recovery and no lasting sequelae.

triage.headline_ja: 数年間原因不明だった症例から、新たなマダニ媒介ウイルスを同定
triage.triage_reason: 新規のマダニ媒介性ウイルス(ALTNV)が同定され、SFTS様症例の一部原因と判明したが、症状は軽症・回復良好で重篤例やヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、現時点でのパンデミックリスクは低い。今後の症例動向・地理的拡大を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 北京の国家重点実験室による研究でNEJMに掲載。マダニ(Haemaphysalis longicornis)媒介のorthonairovirusで、SFTS陰性患者の一部説明となる。ヒトでは疲労・消化器症状のみで後遺症なく回復。今後の症例数・分布拡大の有無を継続的に確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Balaghat Medical Campaign News: बालाघाट जिले में फैली गंभीर बिमारी को लेकर सरकार ने उठाए महत्वपूर्ण कदम, मेडिकल टीमों ने 50 गांवों में की हजारों लोगों की जांच | IBC24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balaghat Medical Campaign News: The serious disease spreading in Balaghat district, the government has taken significant steps, medical teams screened thousands of people in 50 villages | IBC24
article.articleSummary: Balaghat district in Madhya Pradesh faced a sudden disease outbreak, triggering government action. The District Rapid Response Team was activated, with pediatricians, epidemiologists, entomologists, and national teams visiting. In 50 villages, 57 health teams screened 43,451 people; 6,537 treated at home; 647 severely ill children admitted. Measles-rubella vaccination reached 35,827 children in Birsa block. ORS and zinc were distributed to 163,902 households to prevent diarrhea. Malaria control included spraying in 8,610 homes; 26,865 tests detected 980 infections; 3,600 nets distributed. Financial measures funded transport for high-risk patients (₹3.60 lakh) and vaccine transport (₹3.40 lakh); repairs of 22 sub-centers (₹1.93 crore) and equipment (₹24 lakh). Proposal to upgrade Ghummar SHC to PHC (₹66 lakh) was submitted. Fifty-four doctors were appointed; malaria staff expanded; Anganwadi workers filled. Long-term gains since 2003 include institutional deliveries up to 92.1%, immunization 92.7%; maternal deaths down to 60 and infant deaths to 1,560, saving thousands annually.

triage.headline_ja: バラガート医療キャンペーンニュース：バラガート県で広がる深刻な疾病に対し政府が重要な対策を実施、医療チームが50村で数千人を検査
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹・マラリアが同時に流行し、647人の小児重症患者が入院するなど公衆衛生上深刻な影響が見られ、政府が大規模な緊急対応（迅速対応チーム投入、ワクチン接種、マラリア対策）を実施していることから、IHR基準2項目・WPRO基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 麻疹・風疹・マラリアの複合アウトブレイクで、地域限定（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガート県）の事例。政府は既に大規模な国内対応（資金投入、医療スタッフ増員、インフラ整備）を実施済みで、外部支援の必要性については記事内に言及なし。国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: الكوليرا تضرب شرق الكونغو.. أكثر من 12 ألف إصابة و175 وفاة منذ بداية العام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera Strikes Eastern Congo: More Than 12,000 Cases and 175 Deaths Since the Beginning of the Year
article.articleSummary: UNICEF reports more than 12,700 cholera cases and 175 deaths in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, since the start of the year. Across the country, cholera totals exceed 30,400 cases and about 700 deaths. UNICEF and partners are implementing an integrated response: supporting affected families, strengthening community surveillance, and laboratory testing of suspected cases to curb spread. Widespread floods, displacement, and limited access to safe water have driven transmission, with North Kivu and South Kivu as the main hotspots. In South Kivu, 14–20 September saw 15 cholera deaths across four health zones—Shabunda, Fizi, Ibanda, and Uvira. Attention and resources have shifted toward the Ebola outbreak since May, but cholera remains a rising threat. UNICEF calls for urgent action to protect children and warns of rapid cholera spread in West and Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コレラが東コンゴを襲う…年初から1万2000人以上の感染と175人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRC南北キブ州でコレラが継続的に拡大し、死亡者数も多く、洪水・避難民・水アクセス不足による感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラが主題であり、エボラは背景情報として言及されているのみ。発生地域リストに含まれる米国・フィジー等は記事内容と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF : le choléra touche plus de 12 700 personnes dans l'est de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF: Cholera affects more than 12,700 people in eastern DRC.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in North Kivu and South Kivu. Since January, DRC has logged over 30,400 cholera cases and nearly 700 deaths. In South Kivu, more than 12,700 cases and 175 deaths have been reported this year. From Sept 14–20, 15 cholera deaths occurred in South Kivu across four health zones: Shabunda, Fizi, Ibanda, and Uvira. Flooding, population displacement, and limited access to safe drinking water drive transmission. UNICEF notes an integrated response with partners, involving household interventions, community surveillance, and laboratory confirmation of suspected cases. Since May, attention and resources have increasingly focused on Ebola, hindering cholera control. UNICEF urges urgent action to protect children as outbreaks extend across West and Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF: コレラがコンゴ民主共和国東部で12,700人以上に影響
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で年間30,400件超・死者700人近くの大規模コレラ流行が継続しており、洪水・避難民・資源不足（エボラ対応への集中）により制御が困難化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（北キブ・南キブ州）のコレラ流行に焦点を当てている。Fiji、Angola等はBluedotの地域タグ付け誤りと判断し除外。エボラ対応への資源集中がコレラ対策を阻害している点も注目すべき継続要因。

article.articleHeadline: Balneário Camboriú registra queda de 99,8% nos casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balneário Camboriú records a 99.8% drop in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Balneário Camboriú reports a 99.8% reduction in dengue cases, according to municipal data. The steep decline follows comprehensive vector-control efforts targeting Aedes aegypti, the dengue transmitter. Public health actions include intensified surveillance, ongoing monitoring of mosquito populations, and community guidance to prevent breeding sites in homes and neighborhoods. Although the article does not provide exact case counts, the municipality emphasizes that the substantial decrease reflects successful prevention and control measures. Officials caution that maintaining progress requires continued vigilance, sustained sanitation campaigns, and adherence to preventive practices to keep dengue transmission low in the municipality and the broader region. The report underscores the ongoing importance of public health outreach even after large reductions in cases.

triage.headline_ja: バルネアリオ・カンボリウ市、デング熱症例が99.8%減少
triage.triage_reason: 症例減少を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念拡大や異常事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱症例の大幅減少という好転事例を報じており、リスク評価の対象となる感染拡大や異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: SP chega a 40 casos de sarampo neste ano e governo alerta para vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo reaches 40 measles cases this year, and the government warns about vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Measles reaches 40 confirmed cases in 2026 in São Paulo state, with 36 in the capital, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos, and 1 in Santo André. Three new infections involve two men aged 18 and 21 and a baby, linked to transmission chains monitored for over three months by CVE-SP Prof. Alexandre Vranjac. Surveillance tracks transmission routes and contacts; in Guarulhos and São Bernardo do Campo, chains from known cases appear near completion. A 90-day (12-week) period without new cases is used to declare a chain closed. About 60% of cases are in children under 2, underscoring the need for a 'dose zero' vaccination. Of 40 cases, 30 lack vaccination or have incomplete vaccination; no deaths. First-dose coverage rose from 86.56% to 93.24% (April–July); second-dose from 72.72% to 78.37%. Over 2.5 million doses were given in September's multivaccination campaign; vaccine is free in all 645 municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、今年の麻疹症例が40件に達し、政府がワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、政府がワクチン接種を呼びかけるなど社会的関心も高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 死亡例はなく、国内のワクチン接種キャンペーン（9月に250万回以上接種）で対応中。伝播チェーンは収束傾向にあるが、2歳未満の未接種児童が60%を占める点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Araçatuba registra redução da mortalidade infantil e dos casos de dengue no 2º quadrimestre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araçatuba Health Department records a reduction in infant mortality and dengue cases in the second four-month period.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil, reports for May–August 2026 (2nd quadrimester) an infant mortality rate of 4.55 per 1,000 live births with 3 deaths among 659 births, a 77.58% drop from 1st quadrimester’s 14 deaths/690 births; Jan–Aug cumulative infant mortality is 12.60 per 1,000, below the 13.00 target. Dengue cases drop to 673 confirmed in the 2nd quadrimester (1,445 in 1st), a 53.4% reduction, with no dengue deaths May–August. Sanitary inspections totaled 1,298 (down from 1,330). Influenza vaccination reaches 49,693 doses (57.95% overall), with subgroup coverage: 39.98% (6 months–4 years), 45.77% (pregnant), 44.87% (elderly). Health services expand: Family Health Strategy consultations 146,022 (+17.32% from 124,470), above the 98,478 target; home visits 215,138; dental prostheses 525 (target 420). Specialized care: 8,141 consultations; ultrasound 1,531; ECG/EEG 1,023; 1,135 high-complexity procedures. Transport: 2,084 TFD trips, 7,466 passengers; 9,251 TDD removals (dialysis 4,646). Expenditure: 22.95% of own health funds spent by August (R$120.736 million), above the legal minimum. Secretary Lucila Bistaffa calls for reduced absenteeism.

triage.headline_ja: アラサトゥーバ市保健局、2026年第2四半期の乳児死亡率とデング熱症例数の減少を発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱・乳児死亡率の改善を報告する行政実績報告であり、新規感染症の異常発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、デング熱症例数は減少傾向であり、記事は行政の定例報告であるため対象国として含めず見送りと判定。

article.articleHeadline: В Сенегале зафиксирована вспышка дифтерии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak of diphtheria has been recorded in Senegal.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria outbreak in Matam Department, northern Senegal, with 13 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1 death. In total 55 suspected cases have been identified; 40 tested negative, 2 samples awaiting Pasteur Institute in Dakar. Median patient age is 14 years, predominantly male (10 of 13). Geographic distribution: 10 cases in Matam Department, 2 in Kanele, 1 in Tilonie. Health authorities launched a rapid-response plan; regional pharmacy and clinics stocked with antibiotics and specimen-collection kits. About 60 contacts are under surveillance; 10 have been released from quarantine, and no new symptoms have been observed among the remaining contacts. Testing is prioritized for symptomatic contacts rather than universal testing to rapidly detect new cases and interrupt community transmission. No information on infection source or imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: セネガルでジフテリアの集団発生が記録される
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリアという稀少かつ重篤な感染症で死亡例が発生しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本イベントはセネガル（対象国リスト外）で発生しており、記事中にミャンマー等の言及はないため、Bluedotの地域タグは誤りと判断し verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna em escolas de MG: especialista explica transmissão e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Scabies in Schools in Minas Gerais: Specialist Explains Transmission and Prevention
article.articleSummary: Scabies cases in Minas Gerais, Brazil, reported in Lagoa Santa (Greater Belo Horizonte) and Andradas (Southern Minas Gerais). Lagoa Santa’s Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Lacerda has 14 students and staff diagnosed; Andradas’ municipal creche reports 11 cases. In Lagoa Santa, classes were suspended on Oct 1–2 for environmental cleaning, pest control, and sanitization of the water tank. Municipal health epidemiology teams were deployed to guide prevention and control and to conduct active case finding. The first case at the Lagoa Santa school appeared Sept 18, with the family reporting a scarlet fever diagnosis. Scabies is caused by the Sarcoptes scabiei mite and transmits mainly through prolonged skin-to-skin contact; mites can persist temporarily on objects. It is not strictly tied to hygiene. Preventive measures include proper treatment, laundering of contaminated clothing and bedding, cleaning of surfaces, avoiding prolonged contact, and notifying schools/health services when multiple cases occur.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の学校で疥癬症例：専門家が感染経路と予防策を解説
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重大な脅威ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない局地的な学校内アウトブレイクであり、既に地域保健当局が対応している。
triage.notes: 疥癬（ダニによる皮膚感染症）は軽症で治療可能、既に地域保健チームが対応中。ブラジル国内の局地的事案であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया का मंडल पर डंक, चारों जिले अतिसंवेदनशील
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria strikes Mandal; all four districts are highly vulnerable.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, malaria risk has spiked in Uttar Pradesh's Mandal region after monsoon rains caused widespread waterlogging. Four Mandal districts—Bareilly, Badaun, Pilibhit, and Shahjahanpur—are designated highly vulnerable, with Kheri also listed. The state has reported the highest malaria cases in Badaun (647) and Sitapur (636). Bareilly has 409 confirmed cases; Hardoi 262; Lucknow 256; Shahjahanpur 226; Pilibhit 110; Kheri 100. In response, the health department ordered increased surveillance in sensitive districts and faster malaria testing for fever patients, along with larval source management to identify and destroy mosquito larvae. The outbreak underscores ongoing risk from mosquito-borne diseases in flood-prone zones, with water stagnation sustaining vector breeding even as case counts remain concentrated in certain districts.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアがマンダル地域を襲う、4県が高リスクに
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州でモンスーン後にマラリア症例が増加しているが、風土病の季節的な増加であり重症度・死亡数等の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病でモンスーン後の季節的増加はある程度予想される。死亡数や重症例の情報がなく、保健当局は既に監視強化・検査迅速化・幼虫対策を実施中で国内対応の範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Criança de 2 anos com suspeita de febre maculosa será transferida em Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 2-year-old child with suspected Brazilian spotted fever will be transferred to Campo Grande.
article.articleSummary: A two-year-old child in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with suspected Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) will be transferred from the Pediatric Emergency Center Tiradentes to the Alfredo Abrão Cancer Hospital in Campo Grande. Symptoms began Sunday after tick exposure at his grandmother's home. By Wednesday, he had fever, red macules on the hands, legs and oral region, and later oral vesicles. He waited nearly a day for a hospital bed; the patient remains stable and under medical supervision. The case is registered in Sinan as suspected Brazilian spotted fever; lab confirmation is pending. The last confirmed case in Mato Grosso do Sul was in 2018, a 34-year-old man from Campo Grande who had visited a rural area in Sidrolândia. Brazilian spotted fever is tickborne and can cause fever, severe headache, myalgias, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and petechial rashes; prompt evaluation and treatment are advised while awaiting labs.

triage.headline_ja: ロッキー山紅斑熱疑いの2歳児、カンポグランデへ搬送予定
triage.triage_reason: 単発の疑い症例で、ヒト-ヒト感染性がなく国際的拡大リスクも低いため、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: ダニ媒介性のリケッチア感染症（ブラジル紅斑熱）で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない。単発の疑い症例であり、地域的な散発発生としての既知の疾患。2018年以来の確定例が同地域であったとの記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Com casos crescentes de dengue, moradores de Ivinhema terão de intensificar limpeza de terrenos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With rising dengue cases, residents of Ivinhema will have to intensify cleaning of land plots.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak prompts land-clearing obligations in Ivinhema, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. 581 confirmed dengue cases were reported between 2025 and 2026, with about 77% in rural areas and in the Água Azul, Itapoã, Vitória, and Triguenã neighborhoods. The Public Ministry of Mato Grosso do Sul (MPMS) issued a recommendation for mandatory sanitary measures and intensified mosquito-control efforts. The city must notify owners of vacant lots and increase inspections in high-incidence areas; if residents fail to comply, the municipal Secretariat will perform compulsory cleaning and bill the costs to the IPTU (property tax). The municipality will also clean public areas within one year and present a maintenance schedule in January. It has 15 days to confirm compliance and provide an execution plan. Recommendation signed by Promoter of Justice Allan Thiago Barbosa Arakaki.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例の増加に伴い、イビンヘマ住民は土地の清掃を強化する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定的なデング熱流行で行政対応は取られているが、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクを示す情報はなく、ルーチン的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: ブラジル・マトグロッソドスル州イビンヘマ市における地域的なデング熱流行。検察当局（MPMS）が衛生対策の強化を勧告しており、地方自治体レベルでの対応事案。重症度や死亡者数についての記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Unu din opt cazuri noi de cancer are legătură cu o infecție
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One in eight new cancer cases is linked to an infection.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 2.3 million new cancers diagnosed worldwide in 2024 were attributed to infections, about 1 in 8 cases, according to IARC (WHO) analysis published in The Lancet Oncology. Five infectious agents drive the majority: Helicobacter pylori (~760,000 cancers), human papillomavirus (HPV) (~750,000), hepatitis B virus (HBV) (~360,000), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) (~260,000), and hepatitis C virus (HCV) (~160,000). EBV is linked to various cancers, including gastric cancer, lymphomas, and nasopharyngeal cancer, with no effective vaccine yet. East Asia accounts for 42% of infection-attributed cancers, mainly due to H. pylori and HBV; Sub-Saharan Africa is also burdened. Over 75% occur in low- and middle-income countries with limited access to prevention and treatment. Preventive measures highlighted include HPV and HBV vaccination, testing/treatment for H. pylori and hepatitis infections, HIV care, and HPV-related cancer screening, though uptake is hampered by cost and health-system constraints.

triage.headline_ja: 新規がん症例の8件に1件は感染症と関連
triage.triage_reason: WHO/IARCによる世界的な研究報告であり、特定の国・地域での急性の公衆衛生事象ではないため、感染症イベントのトリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は世界全体の統計分析（IARC/WHOによるLancet Oncology掲載研究）に関するもので、特定国での発生事象ではない。発生地域にShanghai/Chinaが付与されているが、記事本文中に中国特有の事象は記載されておらず、東アジア全体の傾向として言及されているのみのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão da dengue identifica 68 criadouros na região do Jardim Lagoa Nova, em Limeira - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue blitz identifies 68 breeding sites in the Jardim Lagoa Nova area, Limeira - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Dengue vector-control blitz in Limeira, Brazil identified 68 Aedes aegypti breeding sites in Jardim Lagoa Nova and surrounding neighborhoods. On Saturday, September 26, 84 vector-control agents surveyed 2,669 properties from 7:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. across Jardim Lagoa Nova; Jardim Residencial Luiz Regitano; Residencial Las Palmas; Residencial São Miguel; and Residencial Alto do Lago. Inspectors found 68 breeding sites; 31 had standing water, and seven contained larvae. The municipality urged residents to permit entry for inspections and to conduct weekly checks to remove containers and other objects that can collect water. This operation aims to prevent dengue transmission by eliminating larval habitats of Aedes aegypti and reinforces community engagement in vector control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラ市ジャルジン・ラゴア・ノバ地区でデング熱蚊対策活動、68カ所の発生源を特定
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的ベクター対策活動の報告であり、症例急増や異常事態を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的な蚊幼虫発生源調査・防除活動に関するもので、症例数や感染拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'anthrax responsable de la mort d'hippopotames dans le Parc national des Virunga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Anthrax responsible for the death of hippopotamuses in Virunga National Park.
article.articleSummary: As of 30 September 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Virunga National Park reports an outbreak of anthrax among hippopotamuses in the Semuliki River, North Kivu. Provisional counts point to about twenty hippos dead, with field investigations continuing. Laboratory analyses by ICCN and Virunga Doctors confirmed bacterial anthrax as the cause. A sanitary protocol is in place to limit spread; residents are urged not to touch carcasses, and to avoid selling or consuming bush meat, while keeping children, livestock, and domestic animals away from carcasses and nearby water. Authorities ask communities to report new carcasses or unusual mortalities to local authorities, veterinary services, or ICCN relays, and to seek health care promptly if symptoms appear after contact with an affected animal or consumption of suspected meat. Conservation voices advocate a One Health approach and community alert systems.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ビルンガ国立公園でカバの大量死の原因は炭疽菌
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ）における炭疽の集団死亡が確認されているが、人への感染例は報告されておらず、ブッシュミート経由の曝露リスクを注視する段階。
triage.notes: 現時点では人への感染例は報告されていないが、ブッシュミート消費や水源汚染を通じた人獣共通感染症リスクがあり、ICCNによるOne Healthアプローチでの監視が行われている。続報で人への感染拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: PEG-Coated Zinc Oxide Nanoparticles Boost Crop Growth and Kill Bacterial
article.articleSummary: India-based researchers report a green synthesis of zinc oxide nanoparticles from Tephrosia purpurea leaves, PEG-coated with PEG 400, yielding core-shell particles (bare 30–40 nm; PEGylated 60–70 nm) with hexagonal wurtzite ZnO crystallites ~21.3 nm. Synthesis used ZnSO4 0.01 M, Tephrosia leaf extract, pH 12, 40°C, 2 h; PEGylation in 10% PEG 400 for 24 h. UV-Vis shows ZnO at 240 nm and phytochemical peak at 350 nm; FTIR confirms PEG conjugation; XRD confirms pure phase. Antibacterial tests against E. coli, Enterobacter sp., Pseudomonas sp., Klebsiella sp., and Staphylococcus aureus show PEG-coated ZnO outperforms uncoated across all strains. The formulation also promotes seedling growth in two legume crops. Authors suggest PEGylated ZnO as a sustainable alternative to chemical pesticides and fertilizers amid drug-resistant pathogens and climate stress (Discover Biotechnology, India, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: PEGコーティング酸化亜鉛ナノ粒子、作物の成長促進と細菌病原体の殺菌に効果
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は農業用ナノ粒子技術に関する研究報告であり、ヒトの感染症発生事例ではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は農業・材料科学分野の研究（ナノ粒子によるE. coli等の抗菌試験と作物成長促進）であり、ヒトの感染症流行事例ではない。疾患名に'E. coli'とあるが文脈は農業用抗菌剤の実験室研究であり、公衆衛生イベントではないため該当国なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Escola na Grande BH suspende aulas após surto de sarna - 30/09/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in Greater Belo Horizonte suspends classes after scabies outbreak - September 30, 2026
article.articleSummary: In Lagoa Santa, Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Brazil, 20 confirmed scabies cases have been reported among students at Escola Municipal Professora Mércia Margarida Lacerda Machado in Moradas da Lapinha since 18 September, with a teacher also diagnosed. To interrupt transmission, the municipality suspended classes on Thursday and Friday (1–2 September) and will conduct a full cleaning, including the water tank. Parents are advised not to send children with symptoms in the coming weeks. Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and spreads mainly through direct prolonged skin contact in close settings such as homes and schools. Main symptoms are intense itching (often worse at night) with red lesions or blisters; some cases include small tunnels in the skin. Control measures include washing daily clothing, bed linens, and towels in hot water, cleaning personal items, and sealing unwashed items for at least a week.

triage.headline_ja: 大ベロオリゾンテの学校で疥癬の集団発生後、授業を休止 - 2026年9月30日
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は比較的軽症で管理可能な皮膚感染症であり、学校単位での局地的な発生に留まり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）は皮膚の寄生虫感染症で、重症度は低く、学校という閉鎖的な環境での感染拡大はあるが、地方自治体レベルで対応可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue outbreak declared in Agusan del Sur
article.articleSummary: Agusan del Sur, Philippines declares a dengue outbreak as cases reach 674 over seven months in 2026, the province’s highest in Caraga's five provinces. The Provincial Health Office warns of rising cases, hospitalizations, severe dengue, and deaths, prompting intensified surveillance, community mobilization, and health facility preparedness. From 206 cases in the first half to 674 as of Aug. 8—a 227% five-week surge (about 12 new cases daily). Region-wide Caraga totals 2,303 cases as of Aug. 8, 66% below 2025. On Sept. 23, entomological surveillance within a 300-meter radius of identified dengue hotspots in Sta. Cruz and Bayugan 3 (Rosario) targeted mosquito breeding sites and boosted community measures. Residents were urged to destroy breeding sites, practice bite prevention, seek early care, and support fogging. Dr. Jacqueline Frances Momville, PHO, urged activation of surge capacity and rapid referral pathways.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン・アグサン・デル・スル州でデング熱アウトブレイクを宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン国内の一地域における季節性デング熱の急増であり、重症例・死亡も報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、現時点では地域の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: Agusan del Sur州での局地的デング熱アウトブレイク。5週間で227%増（674例、7ヶ月累計）、Caraga地域全体では前年比66%減。昆虫学的サーベイランスと地域対策が開始されており、州保健局が主体的に対応中。国際的な拡大や支援要請の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Sleman Ingatkan Risiko Zoonosis di Balik Kedekatan Manusia dan Anabul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sleman Warns of Zoonosis Risk Behind the Close Bond Between Humans and Pets
article.articleSummary: Sleman Regency in Indonesia cautions about zoonotic disease risk from close human-pet bonds and urges rabies vaccination as a preventive measure. During the Rabies Vaccination Week on 30 September 2026 at the DP3 Sleman campus, 340 pet owners registered online, with about 40 of the animals being dogs and the rest cats. Although the DIY region is rabies-free, officials warn that vigilance remains necessary because animals can move across areas. The administration aims to achieve herd immunity among susceptible animals through periodic vaccination and to bolster surveillance to anticipate transmission. Pet owners are also urged to keep pets healthy, maintain clean housing and surroundings, and manage reproduction responsibly. A One Health approach underpins prevention, integrating human, animal, and environmental health, and emphasizes education on first aid after bites or scratches from animals that may transmit rabies via saliva.

triage.headline_ja: スレマン、人とペットの親密な関係の裏にある人獣共通感染症リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 予防的な狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する啓発記事であり、実際の症例発生や異常事態の報告はない。DIY地域は狂犬病フリーとされている。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種週間の啓発活動に関する内容で、実際の狂犬病発生事例は報告されていない。地域は狂犬病フリーと記載されているため、感染症イベントとしての対象国locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba registra 14 mortes por dengue e mais de 7,2 mil casos prováveis em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba records 14 dengue deaths and more than 7,200 probable cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Paraíba, Brazil, reports 14 dengue deaths and 7,296 probable cases through 30 September 2026, according to the Ministry of Health. The death toll marks a 55.2% increase from 2025. Fatalities occurred in Alagoa Nova, Bayeux, Brejo do Cruz, Campina Grande (2), Camalaú, Guarabira, João Pessoa, Monteiro, São Bento (4), and Sumé. Dengue virus circulating serotypes are DENV-1, DENV-2, and DENV-3, with DENV-3 the most prevalent in the state. Health authorities urge residents to remove sources of standing water to curb transmission: uncovered rainwater tanks, gutters, tires, plant pots, and containers in backyards. The data reflect ongoing dengue activity in Paraíba, underscoring the need for vector-control measures, community engagement, and continued surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、2026年にデング熱で14人死亡、確定例7,200件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の既知流行病（デング熱）の地域的拡大・死亡者増加の報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、前年比死亡増加と複数血清型流行により経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の疾患であり、前年比死亡増加はあるが国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。州レベルの継続的サーベイランス対象として注視。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue en Guayaquil: lluvias, basura y agua estancada complican la prevención
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Guayaquil: Rains, Garbage and Standing Water Complicate Prevention.
article.articleSummary: During week 36 of 2026 (Aug 31–Sep 6), Ecuador reported 34,058 dengue cases, up 0.68% from 2025, with severe dengue up 18%. In Guayas, and especially Guayaquil, dengue is driven by predominance of Dengue virus serotype 3 (DENV-3) with concurrent circulation of DENV-1 and DENV-2. The rainy season, standing water, blocked canals, and accumulating trash are fueling mosquito breeding; mortality has been registered in cantons Balzar, Durán, Milagro, Naranjal, and Salitre, with Tarqui parish identified as a lethality hotspot across ages. Following early Sept. rains, solid waste tangled on pedestrian bridges over the Las Orquías canal north of the city signals sanitation and contamination risks that could worsen vector proliferation. Experts warn fumigation is only a temporary fix; emphasis is on mass larval control and heavy cleaning before the first rains, including community-led mingas. Co-endemic risks include leishmaniasis (590), malaria (255), and Chagas disease (64).

triage.headline_ja: グアヤキルのデング熱：雨、ゴミ、滞留水が予防を困難に
triage.triage_reason: グアヤス州で重症デング熱が18%増加し複数地区で死亡例が報告されており、複数血清型（DENV-1/2/3）の同時流行と媒介蚊増殖要因（滞留水・ゴミ詰まり）が重なるため、WPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はエクアドル（グアヤキル市・グアヤス州）のデング熱流行であり、対象国リストにエクアドルは含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。発生地域にブラジル（Ceará）が含まれるが、記事本文はエクアドルの状況を主に扱っており、ブラジルは主題として言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Matupá promove ação de limpeza de quintais para combater a dengue - Só Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Matupá promotes backyard cleaning campaign to combat dengue - Só Notícias
article.articleSummary: Matupá, Brazil, is conducting a dengue-prevention campaign under the Meu Bairro Sem Dengue project, led by the Health and Urbanism secretariats with Health Surveillance. In the Cidade Alta neighborhood, activities run this week through Friday, October 2, 2026. Residents are urged to clean their backyards and leave discarded materials outside homes for collection by field teams. After the operation, property inspections will be performed, and those who do not comply may receive notices and fines under municipal law. The initiative aims to reduce dengue mosquito breeding sites and prevent transmission. No dengue case counts are reported; the emphasis is on environmental sanitation and enforcement to mitigate disease risk in Matupá.

triage.headline_ja: マトゥパ市、デング熱対策で裏庭清掃キャンペーンを実施 - Só Notícias
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的な環境衛生キャンペーンであり、症例数の報告や異常な流行拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マトゥパ市における通常のデング熱予防（蚊の発生源対策）キャンペーンの報道であり、感染者数や流行状況の言及はない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事はルーチンの公衆衛生活動でありシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Nia-Nia: 313 confirmed cases, including 209 deaths and 88 recoveries - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Nia-Nia health zone, Mambasa territory, North-East Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, totals 313 confirmed cases, 209 deaths and 88 recoveries. Dr. Joseph Pemanakue, chief medical officer of the Nia-Nia health zone, says the epidemiological curve remains alarmingly upward. Four health areas—Juhudi, Bafwabango, Bafwambaya and Alimasi—are currently in the midst of an epidemic, with Juhudi reporting the highest number of new cases, followed by Bafwabango. Deaths occurring in the community remain a concern; Red Cross teams conducting post-mortem examinations have consistently yielded positive Ebola results. This update is current as of September 30, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ニア・ニアでのエボラ出血熱：確定症例313件、うち死亡209件、回復88件
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大傾向にあり、複数地域で流行が継続しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約67%（209/313）と非常に高く、コミュニティ内での死亡例も多いことから感染拡大・公衆衛生対応の困難さが懸念される。続報・WHO対応状況の確認が必要。
