article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes: Influenza A Bukan Wabah Baru, Kasus Masih Ikuti Pola Musiman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister: Influenza A Is Not a New Outbreak, Cases Still Follow a Seasonal Pattern.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A in Indonesia is not an outbreak; cases follow the usual seasonal pattern with no deaths reported. As of 30 September 2026, the Ministry of Health records a 56% influenza positivity rate in sentinel surveillance week 38, categorized as medium risk. WHO notes rising influenza activity in Southeast Asia; in week 37 of 2026, Western Pacific region positivity reached 16% (up from 14%), with influenza A(H3) dominant regionally. The virus strains detected are new but not more dangerous, and influenza is largely self-limiting. Typically cases rise before the rainy season and fall around February–March. Officials urge against panic buying oseltamivir, reserving treatment for severe or high-risk patients. Emphasizes decisions based on epidemiologic surveillance rather than social media. WHO continues to monitor seasonal influenza separately from avian influenza A(H5N1).

triage.headline_ja: 保健省副大臣:インフルエンザAは新規流行ではなく、季節性パターンに従っている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア保健省が季節性インフルエンザであり新規の流行ではないと明言し、死亡例もなく通常のサーベイランス範囲内であるため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 疾患名にH5N1が含まれるが、記事内容は季節性インフルエンザA(H3)に関するものであり、WHOも鳥インフルエンザとは別に監視していると明記。米国(Missouri等)の地域情報は記事主題と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna humana em escola faz prefeitura suspender aulas na Grande BH
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of human scabies at a school prompts the city to suspend classes in Greater Belo Horizonte.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-one confirmed cases of human scabies at Escola Municipal Mércia Margarida Lacerda in Lagoa Santa, part of the Greater Belo Horizonte area in Minas Gerais, prompted suspension of classes on Sept 1–2 to halt transmission and allow cleaning, pest control, and sanitization of the water tank. The first case was identified on Sept 18; the outbreak now includes students and a teacher. Local epidemiology teams from Lagoa Santa’s Health Secretariat assessed the school, with the Minas Gerais State Health Secretariat issuing control guidelines. Parents were advised to monitor for itching and skin lesions; students with intense itching or skin lesions should stay home and seek health care. Transmission occurs via prolonged direct contact or sharing clothing, towels, or bed linens; intense itching is the main symptom. Ongoing monitoring and sanitation measures are in place to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 学校での疥癬アウトブレイクにより、ベロオリゾンテ都市圏の市が授業を一時休止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低い局地的な学校内アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 疥癬（ヒゼンダニによる皮膚感染症）は接触感染で重症度は低く、学校内での局所的流行。地方保健当局が対応しており国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: זינוק בתמותה מכולרה: הנתון המדאיג שלא נראה מאז 1999
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spike in cholera deaths: the alarming figure not seen since 1999.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreaks continue to claim lives globally. In 2025, 47 countries reported 451,499 cholera cases and 7,870 deaths, the highest annual death toll since 1999, though incidence reportedly declined that year. The seven countries—Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan, and Yemen—together accounted for about 90% of both cases and deaths. Africa's WHO region registered the sharpest rise, with cases up 34% and deaths up 58% from the prior year. Cholera, caused by Vibrio cholerae and transmitted via contaminated water or food, can be fatal without prompt rehydration; over a fifth of deaths occurred outside health facilities, though those treated in facilities had CFRs under 1%. Vaccination expanded, with oral cholera vaccine production rising from about 30 million doses in 2022 to roughly 80 million in 2025. Prevention requires vaccines alongside safe water, sanitation, early detection, and rapid care. Data reflect reported cases; true burden likely higher.

triage.headline_ja: コレラによる死亡者数が急増：1999年以来最悪の数値
triage.triage_reason: 2025年のコレラ死亡者数が1999年以来最多となり、複数国にわたる深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大が確認されるため、IHR基準で2つ以上該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は2025年の世界的コレラ流行の統計的総括報告であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。対象国リストのうちDRCのみが言及されている（Sudan, Angola, Yemen, Bangladesh, Nigeriaは対象国リスト外）。'Africa'は大陸区分のため国として扱わず除外。

article.articleHeadline: DKI kemarin, aturan ganjil genap hingga kasus Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jakarta yesterday: the odd-even rule and Influenza A cases.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infections in Jakarta’s DKI Jakarta remain low despite a recent uptick, according to Governor Pramono Anung Wibowo. The remarks indicate ongoing monitoring of influenza activity but no escalation to outbreak status as of September 30, 2026. The article provides no case counts, laboratory confirmation, or symptom details. Separately, there is no decision yet on changing Jakarta’s odd-even traffic rule, per Kadishub DKI Transportation head Budi Awaluddin. The roundup also notes plans to offer free public transport for participants of the Jakarta Running Festival on October 24–25, 2026. Location focus remains Jakarta, Indonesia. Source: ANTARA; published October 1, 2026. Keywords: influenza A, Jakarta, DKI Jakarta, public health, outbreak monitoring, transportation policy.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ特別州、昨日のニュース：偶数奇数ナンバー規制からインフルエンザA型の症例まで
triage.triage_reason: ジャカルタ州知事がインフルエンザA型の感染は増加傾向にあるものの依然として低水準であり、アウトブレイクには至っていないと述べており、重症度や異常性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの日常的な監視報告であり、症例数・検査確定・症状の詳細も記載されていない。公共交通政策に関する話題が中心で、感染症イベントとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémies au Kasaï : d'actualité d'un sénateur au ministre national de la Santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasai Epidemics: A Senator's Update to the National Minister of Health - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 30 September 2026 — Senator Clément Muya has filed a parliamentary inquiry to the Minister of Public Health on three Kasai province concerns in the Democratic Republic of Congo: resurgence of Monkeypox (Mpox), the response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, and delays in operationalizing the province’s newly created health provinces after the 2025 split. Since October 2025, Kasai has been divided into two health provinces. On 17 September, the provincial government confirmed Monkeypox across five health zones—Mushenge, Kanzala, Dekese, Luebo, and Ilebo. In coordination with the Ministry of Public Health, the Public Health Emergency Operations Center, and technical partners, authorities deployed an emergency action plan to halt transmission. The senator seeks precise government measures and reassurance for affected populations, emphasizing the health minister’s duty to inform Parliament.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ州の疫病流行：上院議員から保健大臣への最新報告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国カサイ州で第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応継続中に加え、Mpox（サル痘）が5つの保健ゾーンで再燃しており、議会レベルでの懸念も表明されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCカサイ州における第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクとMpoxの再燃（Mushenge, Kanzala, Dekese, Luebo, Ileboの5保健ゾーン）に関する上院議員の議会質問を報じている。ケニア（Busia）は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なく除外。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無は記事内で明記されていないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade do interior de SP suspende aulas após surto com coceira e manchas na pele | Portal Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City in São Paulo's interior suspends classes after outbreak of itching and skin rashes | Portal Band
article.articleSummary: Brodowski, a municipality in interior São Paulo, suspended all municipal classes until Monday, 5 October, after an outbreak of itching and skin rashes. A total of 76 people—students and staff—were triaged and evaluated for symptoms including intense itching and red skin lesions. The Municipal Health Surveillance is investigating two main possibilities: a viral infection or scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei infestation). Biological samples were collected and sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz in São Paulo capital for laboratory analysis; results have not yet been released. Until the cause is identified, health authorities advise anyone developing skin changes to seek medical care. Schools will be cleaned and sanitized to ensure normal reopening for the elections scheduled for Sunday. No fatalities are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州内陸の都市、かゆみと皮膚発疹の集団発生で授業を休止
triage.triage_reason: 学校休校を伴う集団発生だが、疥癬またはウイルス感染の可能性が示唆されるのみで原因未確定、重症例・死亡なし。国際的拡大リスクは低いが地域的な公衆衛生対応として続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 原因（疥癬かウイルス感染か）が未確定のため、検査結果の続報を要する。76人が症状評価を受けたが死亡例はなく、重症度は低いとみられる。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Decline
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, per WHO, is improving with new cases down 20.3% and deaths down 24.2% over the latest two 14-day periods. As of 26 September, 8,067 confirmed cases, 3,901 deaths, and 2,070 recoveries have been reported across 63 health zones in seven provinces. In Ituri, numbers have declined from a mid-August peak, though transmission remains elevated in hotspots Mandima, Nia Nia, and Mongbwalu. Early treatment greatly improves survival, yet many patients die at home or in communities before reaching clinics. The report highlights ongoing transmission but provides no details on infection sources or exported/imported cases. Publication date 2026-09-30 reflects recent trend rather than an all-clear, underscoring the need to strengthen access to care to reduce fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例数が減少
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は死者3,901人・確定例8,067人と大規模で、依然として一部地域で伝播が継続しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクを有するため、フルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模流行の継続報告であり、新規性は低いが規模・致死率の高さからフルRRA継続監視が妥当。感染源や輸出入症例の詳細は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: What will it take to end the Ebola disease outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo?
article.articleSummary: Most deadly Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 8,000 confirmed cases and about 3,900 deaths as of 1 October 2026, amid prolonged conflict and humanitarian crisis hindering response. Bundibugyo virus drives the current outbreak. Ending it requires simultaneous actions: rapid case finding, safe isolation and transfer, thorough contact tracing, and prevention of transmission in health facilities and communities. Key pillars are surveillance to track cases and exposures; infection prevention and control with PPE, safe waste and blood handling; water, sanitation and hygiene to reduce environmental transmission; and robust community engagement to build trust and encourage care seeking. Early supportive care can save lives, though no specific cure or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo virus. Bringing care closer to communities via isolation centres linked to health facilities improves access and helps control spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱流行を終息させるには何が必要か？
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）が8,000例超・死者約3,900人に達し、紛争下で対応が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・特効薬が存在しないブンディブギョウイルスによる流行であり、紛争により封じ込めが困難。国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: ZMB: Epidemic - 08-2026 - Cholera outbreak (2026-09-30) - Zambia
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Zambia (ZMB) as of 29 September 2026 shows 304 cases across seven districts in five provinces, with 62 laboratory-confirmed, 35 patients in treatment and 11 deaths (8 community, 3 in health facilities). The outbreak strains health systems through increased demand for case management, surveillance, lab testing, emergency response and WASH services. Delayed treatment-seeking is evidenced by community deaths. Response emphasizes active case finding, rapid laboratory testing, and treatment, plus safe water provision, household chlorine, water-quality monitoring, super-chlorination of shallow wells, disinfection, and establishment of oral rehydration and treatment points. Ongoing transmission drives risk communication and community engagement to promote safe water use, handwashing, sanitation, early treatment and prompt reporting. The Ministry advocates involvement of community leaders, churches, civil society and media to ensure accurate information reaches affected communities, with concurrent maintenance of routine health services.

triage.headline_ja: ZMB：疫病発生 - 2026年8月 - コレラの発生（2026年9月30日）- ザンビア
triage.triage_reason: ザンビア国内5州7地区にわたり304症例・11死亡（致死率約3.6%）と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、水系感染症としてのヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクとWASH体制の脆弱性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 複数州への拡大、治療遅延による地域死亡例の存在、WASHインフラの脆弱性が懸念される。国際支援要請の有無は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يفلت من السيطرة.. ثلاث عقبات تحطم جهود الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus slips out of control... three obstacles derail containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 8,067 confirmed cases and 3,901 deaths. The outbreak has spread to seven provinces, with Ituri accounting for 76% of cases and hosting about 1 million of the 5 million IDPs in the east. It is the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC, more than double the 2018–2020 epidemic. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the current strain, and detection is hampered by limited diagnostics and late case finding. Transmission occurs in conflict affected areas where population movement and displacement camps complicate tracing and isolation; attacks on health workers further hinder response. Protection monitors logged 369 incidents from March–June 2026, including 178 assaults and 38 gender-based violence cases. In Blink Savo camp, latrines work for only a third of shelters, and only one borehole serves about 80,000 residents. Cross-border movement with Uganda, South Sudan, and Rwanda raises import/export risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが制御不能に…封じ込めを阻む3つの障害
triage.triage_reason: DRCで8,067症例・3,901死亡という過去最大規模のエボラ流行が7州に拡大し、有効なワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争地域での対応困難と越境リスクも存在するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダ・南スーダン・ルワンダとの越境移動によるリスクに言及しているが、これらは発生国ではなく輸入リスクとしての言及のため verified_locations には含めなかった。ワクチン・治療法が存在しない株であることが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Meningkat, Ini Gejala dan Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the Rise: Here Are the Symptoms and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising in Indonesia. As of 26 September 2026 (week 37), influenza positivity among ILI surveillance reached 58.59%, up from 53.71% the prior week. Of 198 specimens tested, 105 were Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 and 7 were Influenza A(H3N2). The A(H3N2) subclade K has been detected in the country. By week 37, 188 cases have been reported across 20 provinces, highest in Jakarta, East Java, and South Kalimantan. Subclade K predominates in children aged 0–4, 5–9, and 10–17 years. Allianz Life Indonesia reports influenza-related hospitalisations up 47% in Jan–Aug 2026 vs 2025, with claims over Rp13.8 billion for 1,857 cases through early September 2026. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, headache, myalgia, fatigue; children may have nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, masking when ill, good ventilation, vaccination, and seeking medical care for warning symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが増加中：症状と予防法について
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでインフルエンザ陽性率が急上昇し、新規サブクレードK検出や入院件数の大幅増加（前年比47%増）が報告されており、WPRO基準で複数該当かつ社会的関心（保険会社データ引用等）も確認されるため。
triage.notes: 新規サブクレードK（H3N2）の検出と小児における優位な拡大、保険金請求データによる入院増加の裏付けが特徴的。死亡率や重症度の詳細、政府の公式対応状況は記事内で明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Agusan del Sur health officials declare dengue outbreak
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak declared in Agusan del Sur, Philippines on Sept 29, 2026 after rising dengue activity, hospitalizations, severe cases, and deaths. As of 01 Oct 2026, 674 dengue cases have been recorded in just over seven months, with a surge since August. The declaration triggers intensified response activities in collaboration with DOH-CHD Caraga, local government units, health facilities, and partner organizations, including enhanced dengue surveillance, case investigation, vector control, community mobilization, and risk communication. Authorities are implementing the 4S Strategy as part of the collective response to prevent further transmission in the province. The article highlights ongoing outbreak status and underscores coordinated public health efforts to curb dengue in Agusan del Sur.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:アグサン・デル・スル州保健当局がデング熱の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はフィリピンで季節的に発生する風土病であり、本事例も地域内での通常の流行対応に該当するが、重症例・死亡例の詳細や国際的拡大の可能性など情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアで季節性に発生する風土病であり、本件は地方自治体レベルでの通常のアウトブレイク宣言・対応強化（4Sストラテジー等）に該当する。重症度や死亡者数の具体的数値、国際的な広がりの兆候など詳細情報が不足しているため、フルリスク評価の前に続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Five-Year Study Reveals How Respiratory Pathogens Resurged After COVID-19
article.articleSummary: China-based five-year retrospective study of 9,674 patients with acute respiratory infection treated 2021–2025, from Hebei General Hospital and Hebei Medical University, shows suppression of pathogen circulation during strict NPIs, then a surge after relaxation, following China's December 2022 lifting of non-pharmaceutical interventions. Using a uniform multiplex fluorescence PCR panel detecting 11 respiratory viruses plus Mycoplasma pneumoniae and Chlamydia, lower respiratory tract infections (LRTI) accounted for 5,289 cases (54.67%), upper RTIs 4,385 (45.33%). Pathogens were detected in 2,939/5,289 LRTI (55.57%) vs 677/4,385 URTI (15.44%). In LRTI, Mycoplasma pneumoniae led at 954/5,289 (18.04%), rhinovirus 618 (11.68%), influenza A 456 (8.62%). In URTI, rhinovirus predominated with 224/4,385 (5.11%). After NPIs ended, positivity rose from 27.63% in 2021 to 24.38% in 2022, then 34.62% in 2023, 54.68% in 2024, and 42.11% in 2025. Odds of detection rose in 2023–2025 vs 2021. The authors discuss immunity debt and frame findings as descriptive surveillance; no direct mechanism proven.

triage.headline_ja: 5年間の研究が明らかにする、COVID-19後の呼吸器病原体の再流行
triage.triage_reason: 過去5年間の後ろ向き研究論文であり、新規の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常な発生を示すものではない。学術的サーベイランス報告であり、現在進行形のシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2021-2025年の後ろ向きコホート研究の結果報告であり、免疫負債（immunity debt）の議論を含む学術的サーベイランス論文。現在進行中のアウトブレイクではないため対象国の指定は見送る。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa gia tăng, virus liên tục biến đổi: Người mắc bệnh nền cần lưu ý
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu on the rise, viruses continually mutating: People with underlying conditions should take note.
article.articleSummary: As of 1 October 2026, seasonal influenza is rising in the Western Pacific as viruses continually mutate. WHO surveillance shows week-33 2026 influenza activity increasing from about 12% to 13% over two weeks. Japan reports influenza activity since late August 2026, earlier than usual; Hong Kong records a similar trend, with severe cases mainly in the elderly and children. In Vietnam, people with underlying conditions (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, chronic lung or kidney disease, and immunodeficiency) are at high risk for influenza and its complications, and influenza can trigger or worsen chronic illnesses. A study of 364 myocardial infarction cases linked to influenza found roughly a sixfold increased risk within seven days of infection. With ongoing viral evolution, WHO updates the 2026–2027 vaccine composition to include A/H3N2 (subclade K) and B/Victoria. Preventive measures include updated vaccination for high-risk groups, hand hygiene, masking when needed, respiratory hygiene, and healthy living.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが増加、ウイルスの変異が続く：基礎疾患のある人は注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 西太平洋地域で季節性インフルエンザが例年より早期に増加し、ウイルス変異（A/H3N2亜系統K等）が報告されているが、重篤な集団発生や渡航制限等の深刻な公衆衛生上の影響は確認されておらず、通常の季節性流行情報の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの一般的な増加傾向と基礎疾患患者への注意喚起が主旨であり、特定の異常な集団発生や国際的な公衆衛生リスクを示す情報は含まれていない。日本・香港の流行時期の早まりについても言及されているが、対象国リストには日本は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Awas! Ini 7 Tanda Awal Kena Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning! Here are 7 early signs of contracting Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity is rising in Indonesia, including in DKI Jakarta. The Health Ministry monitors the outbreak through surveillance at 39 puskesmas (community health centers), 35 hospitals, and 14 health quarantine centers. By week 38, influenza activity was categorized as moderate with a 56% positivity rate, with the dominant circulating strain identified as H1N1 (Influenza A). Early signs to watch for include fever, cough, and fatigue. While flu symptoms can resolve on their own, persistent symptoms beyond a week without improvement warrant medical consult, especially for individuals at high risk (age 65 and older or immunocompromised), as influenza can lead to serious complications. Potential complications include ear infections, diarrhea, nausea and vomiting, abdominal pain, chest pain, asthma, pneumonia, bronchitis, and heart problems. Early recognition and care are essential; take appropriate steps when symptoms begin.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！インフルエンザA型感染の7つの初期サイン
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の活動増加に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、通常のサーベイランス報告の範囲内だが、継続的な動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1）の活動が中等度レベルで、保健省による定常的なサーベイランス体制（プスケスマス、病院、検疫所）の下で監視されている。新規性や異常性は認められず、一般向け健康啓発記事の性格が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Fear Grips Upper West As Yellow Fever Confirmed 30 Deaths
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreak confirmed in Ghana’s Upper West Region, centered on Sissala East Municipal (Fulbe community) with 30 cases reported; Sissala West District has 2 cases at Jeffisi, Wa Municipal 4 cases, and Wa West District 3 cases at Nyoli. Health authorities confirmed the disease last Wednesday following investigations into mysterious deaths of about 21 Fulbe persons. Of four blood samples sent to Accra, one tested positive for yellow fever; six additional samples have since been collected for testing to determine linkage to other cases. Yellow fever is transmitted by infected mosquitoes, not via direct person-to-person contact. A reactive response is under way, including training clinicians to identify and manage suspected cases; vaccination decisions will be guided by Accra’s assessment. Suspected cases also reported in Sissala West and Wa West. Fulbe Chief reports over 30 sudden deaths in Fulbe communities, prompting engagement by health authorities. Residents urged to stay calm and report illnesses based on verified information.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病確認で西部上部州に恐怖広がる、死者30人
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ西部上部州で黄熱病アウトブレイクが確認され、30人以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States/Washingtonが含まれるが記事の主題とは無関係のためverified_locationsから除外。実際の感染確定は4検体中1件陽性のみで、残り死亡例との関連性は調査中。ワクチン接種判断はアクラの評価待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Hai bệnh nhân nguy kịch vì Whitmore, cảnh báo nguy cơ sau mưa lũ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two patients critically ill from Whitmore's disease (melioidosis), warning of post-flood risks
article.articleSummary: Two patients at Nghe An Friendship General Hospital in Vietnam were diagnosed with Whitmore's disease (melioidosis) from Burkholderia pseudomallei. A 53-year-old woman developed acute kidney injury, liver injury, and coagulopathy; blood cultures confirmed B. pseudomallei after 3 days. She required mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, and continuous renal replacement therapy, was extubated after 12 days, and stabilized after three weeks of treatment. A male patient (born 1982) presented after four days of fever with rigors, cough, and dyspnea, developing septic shock, severe respiratory failure, AKI, and metabolic disturbances; blood cultures grew B. pseudomallei after 2 days. He was ventilated for 5 days and vasopressors were discontinued. Clinicians warn melioidosis can rapidly progress to pneumonia, bacteremia, and septic shock, especially during rainy seasons and floods; preventive measures include boots, gloves for mud/water, covering wounds, and prompt medical care for fever or respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ウィットモア病（類鼻疽）により2人の患者が重体、洪水後のリスクに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで類鼻疽による重症患者2例が報告されているが、地域的流行の急増や人-人感染のエビデンスはなく、季節性（洪水後）の既知リスクとしての注意喚起記事であるため、IHR基準には該当しないがWPRO重症度基準は満たす。
triage.notes: 類鼻疽（Melioidosis/Whitmore病）はベトナムの風土病であり、雨季・洪水後に増加する既知のパターン。本記事は個別症例報告と予防啓発が主旨であり、大規模アウトブレイクやヒト-ヒト感染の兆候はない。
